````json
"EventMemories":[
{"Kind":"LostProperty","Choice":0,"Text":"The drawer is quiet now. Someone inside it went home with you."},
{"Kind":"LostProperty","Choice":1,"Text":"The letter in the cabinet finally has someone to carry it."},
{"Kind":"LostProperty","Choice":2,"Text":"You took its heart gently. The cabinet remembers."},
{"Kind":"ImpossibleTailor","Choice":0,"Text":"That returning thread knows the way back to your hand."},
{"Kind":"ImpossibleTailor","Choice":1,"Text":"The tailor left a second heartbeat inside your swing."},
{"Kind":"ImpossibleTailor","Choice":2,"Text":"A little shelter, stitched into something you chose to keep."},
{"Kind":"Understudy","Choice":0,"Text":"Your reflection blinked first. You did not become it."},
{"Kind":"Understudy","Choice":1,"Text":"Your shadow is borrowed, not sold. We remember the difference."},
{"Kind":"Understudy","Choice":2,"Text":"You left the mirror without fighting yourself. That was allowed."},
{"Kind":"ContrabandTrain","Choice":0,"Text":"That ticket has a destination where the customer cannot follow."},
{"Kind":"ContrabandTrain","Choice":1,"Text":"The contraband thread was not on his inventory."},
{"Kind":"ContrabandTrain","Choice":2,"Text":"You faced the collector. This visitor is not your first."},
{"Kind":"ThirteenthHour","Choice":0,"Text":"The thirteenth hour was borrowed. Dawn is not."},
{"Kind":"ThirteenthHour","Choice":1,"Text":"A debt can be repaid. You are not collateral."},
{"Kind":"ThirteenthHour","Choice":2,"Text":"What you trusted to the bank still carries your name, not his."},
{"Kind":"SleepingGarden","Choice":0,"Text":"The garden kept one small light awake for you."},
{"Kind":"SleepingGarden","Choice":1,"Text":"You settled a promise beneath the sleeping lamp."},
{"Kind":"SleepingGarden","Choice":2,"Text":"A dream friend is still a friend, even after visiting hours."},
{"Kind":"EmptyTheatre","Choice":0,"Text":"The paper audience learned to applaud instead of whisper."},
{"Kind":"EmptyTheatre","Choice":1,"Text":"You stood your ground when the leading actor stepped forward."},
{"Kind":"EmptyTheatre","Choice":2,"Text":"Two actors shared a stage. Neither could write your ending."},
{"Kind":"DeadLetters","Choice":0,"Text":"Your parcel has an address beyond these shelves."},
{"Kind":"DeadLetters","Choice":1,"Text":"Someone carries your letter close to their weapon."},
{"Kind":"DeadLetters","Choice":2,"Text":"Your invitation reached the other side of the curtain."}
],
"NarrativeTables":{"Layers":[["Welcome! The little bell says you may stay.","Three fresh miracles. Please mind their teeth.","That one would suit your peculiar little family.","No charge for looking. Sit anywhere but the corner.","Sold! Take good care of that small impossibility.","It stopped trembling when you chose it.","Just a drop. We do not sell your last heartbeat.","Keep enough blood to get everyone home.","No hurry. A small purse still belongs to a person.","Come back with coins, not apologies.","New stock! The old stock has gone for a nap.","Close your eyes. No, not all of them.","Listen. Three little bells have found one voice.","A family resemblance! Bigger shoes this time.","Follow the warm lights. I shall keep one for you.","See you after the noise. I will put the kettle on."],["You are back. Good. The street outside has gone quiet.","Do not mind the chair. It has always been empty.","That ribbon was tied differently a moment ago.","If it looks at you, look at a friend instead.","Sold. Something familiar to take into the dark.","Keep the receipt. It proves you were here.","The night can wait. Your heart cannot.","A small red promise. Nothing more.","You owe me nothing for standing in the light.","Not enough coins. There is still a place by the lamp.","A different shelf. The same little shop. Surely.","The bell rang twice. I only touched it once.","There. A clearer voice than anything outside.","They recognized each other before I did.","If the corridor changes, remember the way your friend walks.","I will still be here. Please come back."],["The shelves remember your footsteps now.","I wrote your name. The receipt wrote the rest.","They remember every crossing. Ask where they want to go.","The eye in the glass is not a price tag.","Sold. It is a companion to your story, not its ending.","The drawer sighed. I think it wanted you to choose that.","Blood is not a signature. Remember that.","Only the listed price. No hidden promises.","No. An empty wallet does not make you merchandise.","Keep your breath. I do not take that currency.","I moved the stock. Something moved the room.","Let us change the shelf before it changes us.","For a moment I remembered what morning sounded like.","That light was yours. The shop did not make it.","If you hear your name outside, let your friends answer first.","The warm cup is still real. I checked."],["You have seen the wrist. Please do not ask where it ends.","The shop keeps things because it is afraid of forgetting.","That seam was a door once. It might be again.","Some things are held together by being remembered.","Take it. Ownership is not the same as belonging.","Another line on the receipt. Not another chain.","I can count your heartbeats. I will not claim them.","Let this be the last thing the dark asks from you.","You are a guest. Whatever the other receipt says.","I would rather lose a sale than lose you.","Different objects. The same fear underneath.","The cupboard is larger inside. Please do not count the ribs.","They became stronger without forgetting who they were.","That is how a dream learns to let go.","The hand is trying to help. It has forgotten how to ask.","There is a handle somewhere. It must still open something."],["The last chair is occupied. Do not sign anything.","I kept the lamp lit. I did not know what else to do.","Choose what helps you leave. Not what helps me keep you.","That one is not afraid of morning anymore.","Sold. No one can buy the friends who choose to follow.","Keep it. I am learning the difference between a gift and a sale.","Your heart belongs on the other side of the door.","Only this price. Not your name. Never your name.","I will not let him put a price on you.","No more bargains with the part of you that wants to live.","One last shelf. Then we find the door.","I hear the kettle from the first room. Hold on to that.","There you are. Still yourselves. All of you.","The dark cannot agree on your names. Your friends can.","When the bell rings, walk toward the light together.","If I forget how to close, remind me that goodbye is not forgetting."]],"Dream":[["A small dream has hatched. Be gentle.","Look softly. That one startles easily.","The dream is yours. The friendship is its own.","Some dreams prefer an honest heartbeat.","Not enough. Your last heartbeat is not for sale.","Let the old dream sleep. Here are three more.","Three names, one bright little soul.","An egg is a promise with a shell. Carry yours gently."],["The windows have shut their eyes.","That one has heard the bell before.","Take a little certainty into the hall.","Leave enough warmth inside your chest.","Not enough. There is no shame in walking away.","I changed the dreams, not the price of being alive.","Listen. They remember the same song.","The empty chair dreamed of a hat. Do not wait for its owner."],["Do not confuse being watched with being known.","Its eyes open only when someone remembers it.","It chose to go with you. That matters.","A heartbeat is not proof of purchase.","Not enough. The dream can wait for your answer.","I put the sharp memories on a different shelf.","A small bright refusal to become forgotten.","The shelf is dreaming of a spine. Walk carefully."],["The hand remembers how small you are.","That ribbon once held the door open.","Let it belong beside you, not beneath you.","Keep the rest of your blood for the dawn.","Not enough. Do not pay with the part of you that wants to leave.","These dreams have not met the last customer yet.","He can count them. He cannot understand them.","The tongue was a carpet before the shop learned fear."],["He is here. He calls the whole shop inventory.","The eye is afraid to close. Help it remember morning.","Carry this beyond the edge of the receipt.","You are not the final item on his bill.","Not enough. Your last heartbeat is not for sale.","One more dream, then we wake the door.","He cannot buy what has become a family.","Choose your way out, little waking thing."]],"Whispers":[["The kettle is still warm.","The chair in the corner is facing you again.","A lantern on the road gutters, then holds.","Your friends know the way you walk."],["Somewhere down the platform, someone almost hums.","Dust settles on a shoulder that has not moved in years.","The rails are empty in both directions.","An unopened letter waits on every lap."],["The windows show the room you are standing in.","A pencil mark on the door frame is exactly your height, once.","The letterbox rattles, though there is no wind.","Footsteps in the hall stop a moment after yours."],["The sheets have been turned down for one.","The cup is exactly where your hand would reach.","A chair along the wall has your name on it.","Nobody in this room is asleep."],["The last lantern is still burning.","Somebody has left a light on.","The night goes on. So do you.","Hold on to the things that know you without a receipt."]],"Evidence":[["Three coins rest on the folded blanket. Nobody saw them arrive.","The receipt under the till is in a child's handwriting.","The shopkeeper never looks at the corner. Not once.","The warm chair is one step closer than it was."],["Every traveller on the platform sits in a chair that waited for them.","The lullaby on the speakers is older than you.","Your name is on the departure board. DEPARTURE: DAWN.","He tossed the coins through the window. They landed on the seat."],["The front door's lock was forced from the outside.","A reply was sewn shut and nailed into the letterbox.","Tally marks under the table. The last row is in your hand.","He wore a kind face that was too small for him."],["One bed. One cup. A chair along the wall with your name.","The brass key opens a door that was never in this wall.","His ledger's first entry is his own name.","The warm chair stands in front of the exit."],["The last lantern still holds a name.","Somebody came eight times.","The shop is still open for anyone who still has a choice.","Dawn came once. The night keeps its own hours."]]},
````

### Tài liệu tham chiếu: Docs/Content_Expansion_v5.md

Giữ nguyên nhãn/timestamp gốc; một số câu ‘chưa vào game’ đã lỗi thời. Số liệu runtime ở đầu hồ sơ là nguồn ưu tiên.

### Mở rộng nội dung — bản 5 (18/10/2026): sửa 10 vấn đề của lần rà soát thứ hai

Thay bản 4 (`Content_Expansion_v4.md`, đã bỏ). Vẫn dựa trên bản 3 (Content_Expansion_Proposal.md)
cho những gì không nhắc lại ở đây. Số lượng: **36 hero, 94 companion (+9 theo đề xuất agent), 60 vũ khí Arsenal, 33 bond (+3), 200 item**
(30 item mới gồm đủ 12 món agent đề xuất; bỏ các món đồ ăn/đồ uống Common yếu).
Nguồn dữ liệu: `Tools/Content/expansion_design.py` (kiểm tự động, hiện **0 lỗi**).

---

#### 1. Luật bộ cố định

Bộ của hero = companion thuộc **2 bond chủ đề** + toàn bộ thành viên **bond phụ đặc trưng** + item **Common** + item thuộc 2 chủ đề +
item thuộc **họ item** của hero.

| Luật | Giá trị |
|---|---|
| Bond chủ đề mỗi hero | 2 (Patchwork Host 3) |
| Bond phụ đặc trưng | 1 mỗi hero, tối đa 2 hero mỗi bond, chọn theo chất của hero |
| Họ item | **18 họ hẹp**, tối đa 3 hero mỗi họ |
| Hai hero cùng cặp chủ đề | phải khác nhau **≥3 companion** và **khác họ item** (kiểm tự động) |
| Cỡ bộ companion | 18–28 (Patchwork 36) — nới thêm 2 vì 9 companion mới |
| Họ của item | theo loại (món ăn / đồ uống) trước, rồi theo cơ chế, rồi theo chỉ số dương đầu tiên; bỏ qua chỉ số phạt (địch nhanh hơn, thêm quái, thêm máu quái, điểm số) |
| Mythic và Prismatic theo chủ đề | chia đều (Mythic hiện 3–4 món mỗi chủ đề; 6 Prismatic mới lấp Kỳ Lạ và Thủy Triều) |
| Companion Rare | **+1 thành viên cho bond phụ của nó khi bond đó đã kích hoạt** (thêm cấp, không tự bật bond) |
| Vũ khí đã khóa | mỗi companion Mythic/Prismatic luôn cầm vũ khí riêng (bảng §9), vũ khí đó bị loại khỏi vòng quay của companion khác; Rain Heron (Rare) không còn vũ khí cố định |

#### 3. Nội tại "+1 cấp bond đặc trưng" chỉ còn cho hero sống bằng bond

Giữ cho LanternKnight, VelvetRegent, VerdantMatron và 5 hero mới. Chín hero khác nhận lại nội tại riêng, theo họ item của mình:

| Hero | Nội tại đội mới |
|---|---|
| RootOracle | Rễ che chở: đồng đội đứng trong tầm 3 của hero đỡ một viên đạn bắn vào hero, mỗi 5s một lần |
| PetalCitadel | Relic nhân đôi: mua một relic đã có thì được hoàn 3 vàng |
| ThornTreasurer | Gai trả tiền: mỗi lần gai phản đòn có 10% rơi 1 xu |
| SoapSkater | Đồng đội đánh trúng địch đang bị làm chậm thì đóng băng nó 0.3s (mỗi địch một lần mỗi 4s) |
| MoonProwler | Đồng đội cận chiến đánh từ phía sau thì luôn chí mạng |
| TideSinger | Mỗi đồ uống mua được: +1 vàng thu nhập mỗi wave về sau (tối đa +5) |
| CopperCauldron | Mỗi đòn hero nhận trong wave: đồng đội +2 sát thương va chạm (tối đa +10) |
| LanternWeaver | Địch bị ghim chậm 15% |
| IvorySovereign | Mỗi Mythic hoặc Prismatic mua được: đội +5% sát thương cả run (tối đa +25%) |

#### 4. Bỏ kiểu "đánh dấu rồi +X%" và "quét một làn" ở chỗ không phải của chúng

| Ở đâu | Bản 4 | Bản 5 |
|---|---|---|
| Ivory — Coronation | đường phán quyết đánh dấu +15% | **đường phán quyết xử tử quái thường dưới 15% máu** |
| Tea Dragon | hơi trà đánh dấu +15% | **đặt một ấm trà phía trước; ấm reo rồi nổ hơi bỏng, lan sang địch kế bên** |
| The Endless Index | ký tự +20% cho Runic School | **mỗi đòn thứ 3, ký tự chép đòn đó sang 2 địch gần** |
| SonarHarpoon | đánh dấu và vọng âm | **không đánh dấu: tiếng vọng đánh địch gần nhất phía sau mục tiêu** |
| Velvet — Royal Parade | xung phong theo đường | **Phong tước: mọi đồng đội đánh như được thêm 1 sao trong 6s** |
| Iron Locomotive | xúc tuyết dọn làn | **còi băng: một luồng hơi lạnh phía trước đóng băng 3 địch đầu tiên 1s** |
| RollingPin | cán phẳng đẩy lùi theo làn | **để lại một dải bột dính giữ chân địch 0.5s** |
| Kite Admiral — biến hình | hạm đội diều quét làn | **Hạm đội diều: 4 diều bay trên 4 đồng đội tầm xa gần nhất; đạn của họ tách đôi khi diều còn bay** |

Đánh dấu chỉ còn ở: Postmaster (tem), Bell Diver (dò), Return Captain (neo) và họ item Đánh dấu.

| Ringmaster Jack (Jack-in-the-Box, giữ art đã vẽ) | **gây chú ý: mỗi 6s xoay bóng trên mũi, quái gần quay sang đánh nó 1.5s** |

| The First Seed | **mọc một bờ rào gai phía trước chặn đường quái 3s** |

| WateringCan | làm ướt; địch ướt trúng đòn băng thì đóng băng (không còn mầm) |
| SpinningTop | con quay đứng xoáy phía trước 2s, hút quái nhỏ vào giữa |

| Specimen Slime | Rare | Bộ Máy · Exhibit Hall | mẫu vật bảo tàng, chỉ ở bộ Archive Curator; hạ loài đã ghi thì tách slime nhỏ (tối đa 2) |
| Court Herald | Common | Thư Viện · Hat Society | kèn: đầu mỗi wave, đòn đầu của mọi đồng đội bắn thêm 1 viên |

Shell Postman chuyển từ Lantern Guild sang Sea Shanty (bưu tá ven biển) để Sea Shanty có đủ người ở các bộ Thủy Triều; Tin Tick chuyển từ
Clockwork Union sang Static Club. Shell Postman là nhân vật cốt truyện: nó vẫn chỉ xuất hiện theo luật cốt truyện, chỉ bond của nó đổi. Starter của
Ivory giữ là Ice Cream Owl (Court Herald chỉ vào game khi có art).

#### 6b. Ba mươi item mới (chốt sau lần rà thứ ba): giữ 200 item

| Bậc | Món (chủ đề · họ) |
|---|---|
| Common (3, dùng chung) | Tally Chalk — +1% sát thương mỗi 25 quái hạ trong wave, tối đa 8% · Coin Sash — +0.5 tầm nhặt khi đang chạy · Fish Cracker — món ăn, +6% chí mạng |
| Uncommon (5) | Postage Stamp — +10% sát thương lên địch bị đánh dấu (Thư Viện · Đánh dấu) · Frost Salt — đóng băng lâu hơn 0.3s (Sương Giá · Đóng băng) · **Refund Slip** — mỗi shop một lần bán lại một món đủ giá (Bếp Ấm · Shop) · Whetstone Wafer — món ăn: đòn cận chiến chém thêm 1 địch 40% (Kỳ Lạ · Đồ ăn + Cận chiến) · Late Fee — sát thương theo thời gian và trì hoãn +25% (Bộ Máy · Trì hoãn) |
| Rare (6) | Haggler's Abacus — mỗi lượt đổi: mọi món rẻ hơn 1, tối đa −30% (Thư Viện · Shop) · Slipstream Scarf — đồng đội +1% tốc đánh mỗi 5% tốc chạy cộng thêm của hero, tối đa 15% (Tinh Tú · Tốc độ) · Brain Freeze — chí mạng lên địch đóng băng vỡ thành 3 mảnh băng (Sương Giá · Đóng băng) · Wind Chime — mỗi 10 lần chí mạng của đội: 3 phát kế +1 xuyên (Bộ Máy · Chí mạng) · **Specimen Pin** — +1% chí mạng mỗi loài mới hạ trong run, tối đa 20% (Thư Viện · Theo loài) · **Star Polish** — đồng đội 3★ +1 viên đạn (Vườn Cây · Merge) |
| Mythic (11) | Kite Tail Ribbon (Tinh Tú · Tầm xa) · Melting Sundae (Sương Giá · Đóng băng) · Cuckoo Pendulum (Bộ Máy · Chí mạng) · Diving Bell Lantern (Thủy Triều · Đánh dấu) · Twin Ticket (Thư Viện · Merge) · Treasure Mimic (Vườn Cây · Rương) · Duelist's Ribbon (Kỳ Lạ · Cận chiến) · Frost Ledger (Sương Giá · Đóng băng + Theo loài) · **Undertow Anchor — mỗi 8s một con sóng từ tuyến đầu đẩy 5 địch gần nhất lùi 2 ô và làm ướt** (Thủy Triều) · **Funhouse Mirror — mỗi 10s vũ khí một đồng đội bị bóp méo: to gấp đôi, chậm một nửa trong 3s** (Kỳ Lạ) · **Splice Kit** — mỗi wave một lần, ba đồng đội 1★ khác loài gộp thành một con 2★ ngẫu nhiên (Bếp Ấm · Merge) |
| Prismatic (5) | The Endless Encore (Kỳ Lạ · Thủy Triều) · Moon Clock Key (Tinh Tú · Bộ Máy) · Mirror of Twins (Bếp Ấm · Kỳ Lạ) · Storybook Ending (Vườn Cây · Thủy Triều) · Dream Loom (Sương Giá · Thư Viện) |

Bỏ: Last Wish Coin (chỉ là kinh tế, không đủ Prismatic), Lucky Penny, Grafting Tape (mạnh hơn kit Lone Jelly), cùng các món đã bỏ ở
lần trước. Đổi: Window Seat Ticket → Refund Slip (trùng nội tại Penny), Tailwind Scarf → Coin Sash (trùng Slipstream Scarf).

#### 8. Quyết định sau lần rà thứ ba

| Chủ đề | Quyết định |
|---|---|
| Họ item | item **gắn nhiều họ** (loại món + cơ chế + chỉ số), sửa họ của các món bị xếp sai; mọi họ có ít nhất 4 món không phải Common |
| Luật bond đối thủ | hai hero cùng cặp chủ đề: mỗi bên không thấy companion Common–Rare thuộc bond đặc trưng của bên kia; cặp đó phải cách nhau ≥6 companion |
| Static Club | thêm Tin Tick (bọ thiếc) làm thành viên thứ 4 |
| Rare | chỉ tính thêm 1 thành viên **khi bond đã kích hoạt** (thêm cấp, không tự bật bond) |
| Unbroken | đổi tác dụng thành **+hệ số sát thương** (không còn là bond sống sót thứ 3) |
| Starter | Root Oracle → Mushroom Librarian (Hood Wisp là nhân vật cốt truyện); Archive Curator → Fridge Wisp (Spindle Wren nằm ngoài bộ mới) |
| Court Herald | đầu mỗi wave, đòn đầu của mọi đồng đội bắn thêm 1 viên (không còn "đánh dấu +10%") |
| The Endless Index | mỗi loài mới bị hạ thêm một trang; ở 10 / 20 / 30 trang, đồng đội Runic School +1 tách đạn |
| SonarHarpoon | lao để lại một phao dò; địch đi qua phao bị dò |
| SpinningTop | xoáy tại chỗ, hất quái nhỏ văng **ra ngoài** |
| Bell Diver | địch đã dò nhận thêm 1 lần nảy từ đạn đồng đội (thay "đòn đầu chí mạng") |
| Root Oracle | mỗi 5s, địch gần hero nhất bị giữ chân 1s (thay "đồng đội đỡ đạn") |
| Lantern Weaver | đạn đồng đội xuyên qua địch bị ghim +1 xuyên |
| Sundae Duchess | địch đóng băng trúng chí mạng mất 5% máu tối đa |
| Lone Jelly | +2% sát thương mỗi lần merge (tối đa 25%) |
| Juggling Jester | thành viên Big Top tuyển vào có 10% là 2★ (thay "từ lượt đổi thứ 3 rẻ hơn 1") |
| Exhibit Hall | Pinned Beetle: đòn ghim địch 0.3s · Fossil Armadillo: cuộn tròn, địch đánh vào nó bị choáng 0.3s · Specimen Slime (Rare): hạ một loài đã ghi thì tách ra một slime nhỏ (tối đa 2) |
| Đổi hình (chưa vẽ) | Thunder Lamb → Storm Kitten, Conch Crooner → Shanty Sea Lion, Pressed Moth → Pinned Beetle, Fossil Tortoise → Fossil Armadillo |
| Giữ (đã vẽ) | Sundae Duchess dáng búp bê sứ, Ringmaster Jack, Harbor Whale (chỉ đổi tên) |

#### 7. Art

Danh sách việc vẽ `Docs/Expansion_Art_Worklist.json` đã cập nhật theo bản 5: icon 30 item theo danh sách mới; thêm ấm trà của Tea
Dragon và bờ rào gai của The First Seed; bỏ mầm của WateringCan; đổi tên Lighthouse Whale → Harbor Whale, Jack-in-the-Box →
Ringmaster Jack (art đã vẽ giữ nguyên); thêm 9 companion mới (3 sheet nhân vật) và 6 icon bond mới (Paper Wings, Sweet Tooth, Big
Top, Static Club, Sea Shanty, Exhibit Hall). Những ảnh đã vẽ xong không phải vẽ lại.

**Cơ chế nhỏ cho các Mythic chỉ cộng chỉ số** (giữ chỉ số cũ; Crimson Seal/Spring giảm chỉ số vì xuống Mythic):

| Món | Cơ chế |
|---|---|
| Tarnished Crown | mỗi đòn thứ 8 của hero là đòn vương giả: gấp 3 sát thương |
| Starlight Quilt | mỗi wave một lần, đòn hạ gục hero chỉ để lại 1 máu và 1.5s an toàn |
| Iron Apron | địch đánh hero ở gần bị hất lùi 1.5 ô (mỗi giây một lần) |
| Mending Moth | 3s không bị đánh: hồi máu mỗi giây của hero gấp 3 |
| Echo Postage | đòn thường của đồng đội hạ địch thì vọng sang địch gần nhất (50% sát thương vũ khí) |
| Shield Blower | đạn địch bị đồng đội chặn được thổi ngược lại thành đạn ta, gấp đôi sát thương |
| Emerald Invoice | mỗi relic đang có trả bớt hóa đơn: điểm trừ sát thương giảm 2% mỗi món (hết ở 10 món) |
| Crimson Seal | va chạm đóng một ấn đỏ; 1s sau ấn nổ gấp 3 sát thương va chạm quanh địch (hero +50%, va chạm +16) |
| Crimson Spring | mỗi 4s đòn kế của mỗi đồng đội bật hai lần (tốc đánh +25%, tầm +25%) |
| Key Oil | +12% sát thương đội (từ +24%) |
| Truce Bottle | thêm −30% tốc chạy của hero, chỉ giữ 1 cái |

**Bốn Prismatic cũ:** Borrowed Crown — đồng đội nhiều sao nhất bắn thêm vũ khí của hero (+15% sát thương) · Clockwork Heart — mỗi
lần merge lên dây cót: đội +3% tốc đánh cả run, tối đa +30% (+10% tốc đánh) · Impossible Prism — đạn tách của đồng đội thành ba màu
lửa / băng / huyền bí (tách +3) · Living Thread — đồng đội cận chiến được nối chỉ: đòn của một con kéo theo một nhát 50% của con cận
chiến gần nhất (+4 sát thương cận chiến, +30% đẩy lùi).

## 22. Phụ lục mã thực thi và xuất xứ

Đây là phần cho reviewer kỹ thuật tra cứu công thức chính xác, không cần đọc hết khi review nội dung. Nhúng các lớp chứa công thức chính về kinh tế, wave, quota, stat, kit, relic, đồng minh, truyện và ánh sáng; các file runtime còn lại được định danh bằng SHA256. Capture/fixture/test không được coi là nội dung người chơi. Mã chỉ được sao chép vào hồ sơ, không sửa gameplay.

<details>
<summary>Assets/ArcaneBrigade/Runtime/Core/ActOneRun.cs · SHA256 21934d9fa5e6177a5f77c1849107f1b3378c542b966077b5008cf4f1aa117675</summary>

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    /// <summary>Act I progress that is not journal text: the warm chair's hidden fight and the lanterns it relit.</summary>
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ActOneProgress
    {
        public const int None = 0, Fighting = 1, Won = 2, Lost = 3;
        public int Revision = 1;
        public int SitCloser;   // the warm chair: None, Fighting, Won (stood up), Lost (sat down: the run ended)
        public int SatWave;     // the shop where the traveller sat down
        public int RelitMask;   // lanterns burning again, by canon lamp index (0..7)
        public const int Undecided = 0, Refused = 1, Sold = 2;
        public int Offer;              // shop 8: the Last Customer's offer for a memory
        public string SoldMemory = ""; // the species the traveller no longer remembers
        public int PendingRelight;     // 1 after standing up from the warm chair: the traveller chooses which lost detail comes back
        public int HobRescued;         // shop 16: Hob sat down in a chair of its own; everyone pulled it up
    }
    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot { public ActOneProgress ActOne = new ActOneProgress(); }
    public sealed partial class CheckpointCatalog
    {
        public UnitDefinition[] StoryCompanions = new UnitDefinition[0];
        public float KnockDeadline; // SIT CLOSER: the Bedside must fall before the knocking stops
    }

    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        /// <summary>Hob, Latch, Postscript and Tally travel in their own places: they are not roster bodies, so they are
        /// never bought, merged, sold, counted toward quotas or bonds. Their strength follows the zone.</summary>
        private void PrepareStoryParty()
        {
            var party = new System.Collections.Generic.List<UnitDefinition>();
            bool shop = State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop;
            for (int index = 0; index < ActOneCanon.StoryIds.Length; index++)
            {
                if (!ActOneCanon.StoryPresent(index, State.Wave, shop, State.Endless)) continue;
                if (index == 0 && HobRescueNeeded) continue; // Hob is still sitting in the perfect room
                UnitDefinition source = catalog.Unit(ActOneCanon.StoryIds[index]);
                if (source == null || source.Weapon == null) continue;
                UnitDefinition unit = BuildUnit(source, source.Weapon, ActOneCanon.StoryTier(State.Wave), true);
                unit.DisplayName = ActOneCanon.StoryNames[index];
                ActOneArtwork.Apply(unit);
                party.Add(unit);
            }
            CombatCatalog.StoryCompanions = party.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>The four's kinds are never sold: a bought teapot beside Hob looks like a merge that left one behind.</summary>
        public static bool StorySpecies(string unitId) => Array.IndexOf(ActOneCanon.StoryIds, unitId) >= 0;

        public bool SitCloserAvailable => !State.Endless && State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && !SecretRoomOpen
            && State.Wave >= ActOneCanon.SitFrom && State.Wave <= ActOneCanon.SitUntil
            && (State.ActOne?.SitCloser ?? 0) == ActOneProgress.None && State.OutsideStage != OutsideStageStatus.Fighting && State.OutsideStage != OutsideStageStatus.Reward;

        /// <summary>The traveller sits in the warm chair. The fight happens on this same shop visit; the next wave is not used.</summary>
        public bool AcceptSitCloser()
        {
            if (!SitCloserAvailable) return false;
            State.ActOne ??= new ActOneProgress();
            State.ActOne.SitCloser = ActOneProgress.Fighting;
            State.ActOne.SatWave = State.Wave;
            State.Phase = SessionPhase.Combat;
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>THE NIGHT YOU HID: the Bedside and the seated travellers it wakes are as strong as a wave eight further on,
        /// and the knocking at the door is the clock.</summary>
        private void PrepareSitCloser()
        {
            if ((State.ActOne?.SitCloser ?? 0) != ActOneProgress.Fighting) return;
            int real = State.Wave;
            State.Wave = Mathf.Min(real + ActOneCanon.SitWaveBonus, 40);
            try
            {
                float scaling = (1f + (State.Wave - 1) * 0.10f) * JourneyBalance.EnemyHealth(State.Difficulty, State.Wave);
                UnitDefinition body = Array.Find(catalog.Bosses, boss => boss != null && boss.Id == "UmbraCradle") ?? catalog.Bosses[0];
                CombatCatalog.Boss = BuildEnemy(body, scaling);
                CombatCatalog.Boss.DisplayName = "THE BEDSIDE";
                CombatCatalog.Boss.Health *= WaveCadence.StoryBossBulk(real); // as much sturdier as the wave's own story boss
                CombatCatalog.MeleeEnemy = BuildEnemy(catalog.Enemies[(State.Wave - 1) % catalog.Enemies.Length], scaling);
                CombatCatalog.RangedEnemy = BuildEnemy(catalog.Enemies[State.Wave % catalog.Enemies.Length], scaling);
            }
            finally { State.Wave = real; }
            CombatCatalog.EnemyBudget = 140;
            CombatCatalog.BossSwarmBudget = 0;
            CombatCatalog.WaveDuration = ActOneCanon.KnockSeconds;
            CombatCatalog.KnockDeadline = ActOneCanon.KnockSeconds;
            CombatCatalog.ArenaSize = new Vector2(24, 13);
            CombatCatalog.EnableArenaToys = CombatCatalog.EnableSpectacles = CombatCatalog.EnableBossArenaPhase = false;
        }

        private bool SettleSitCloser(CombatSimulation simulation)
        {
            if ((State.ActOne?.SitCloser ?? 0) != ActOneProgress.Fighting) return false;
            State.Health = simulation.Champion.Health;
            State.CombatSeconds += simulation.Elapsed;
            State.LastDamageSource = simulation.LastDamageSource;
            State.LastDamageKind = simulation.LastDamageKind;
            State.LastDamageAmount = simulation.LastDamageAmount;
            ContributionLedger.Merge(State.Contributions, simulation.Contributions);
            if (simulation.Phase == RunPhase.Defeat) { State.ActOne.SitCloser = ActOneProgress.Lost; State.Phase = SessionPhase.Defeat; return true; }
            if (!simulation.BossDefeated) throw new InvalidOperationException("Standing up from the warm chair requires the Bedside to fall");
            State.ActOne.SitCloser = ActOneProgress.Won;
            if (!State.Items.Exists(stack => stack.Id == ActOneCanon.ThursdayShoesId)) State.Items.Add(new ItemStack { Id = ActOneCanon.ThursdayShoesId, Count = 1 });
            // the door opened: back in the shop the traveller chooses which lost detail of the visitor returns
            State.ActOne.PendingRelight = ActOneCanon.RelightTarget(State.Wave, State.ActOne.RelitMask) >= 0 ? 1 : 0;
            State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + simulation.Gold);
            State.Health = MaximumHealth();
            State.Phase = SessionPhase.Shop;
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>Shop 8, after the telephone: "Sell me your memory of one of them, and I'll light a lamp for you."</summary>
        public bool CustomerOfferAvailable => !State.Endless && State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && State.Wave == 8 && !SecretRoomOpen
            && (State.ActOne?.Offer ?? 0) == ActOneProgress.Undecided && ((State.MienCho?.ReadMask ?? 0) & (1 << 8)) != 0 && State.Roster.Exists(entry => Array.IndexOf(ActOneCanon.StoryIds, entry.UnitId) < 0);
        public bool SellMemory(string unitId)
        {
            if (!CustomerOfferAvailable || string.IsNullOrEmpty(unitId) || Array.IndexOf(ActOneCanon.StoryIds, unitId) >= 0 || !State.Roster.Exists(entry => entry.UnitId == unitId)) return false;
            State.ActOne.Offer = ActOneProgress.Sold; State.ActOne.SoldMemory = unitId;
            int lamp = ActOneCanon.RelightTarget(State.Wave, State.ActOne.RelitMask);
            if (lamp >= 0) State.ActOne.RelitMask |= 1 << lamp;
            RecountBonds();
            return true;
        }
        public bool RefuseCustomer()
        {
            if (!CustomerOfferAvailable) return false;
            State.ActOne.Offer = ActOneProgress.Refused; return true;
        }
        /// <summary>A companion whose memory was sold: still travelling, still kind, but a stranger who no longer counts toward bonds.</summary>
        public bool Stranger(string unitId) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(unitId) && (State.ActOne?.Offer ?? 0) == ActOneProgress.Sold && State.ActOne.SoldMemory == unitId;
        public static bool Stranger(RunSnapshot state, string unitId) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(unitId) && (state?.ActOne?.Offer ?? 0) == ActOneProgress.Sold && state.ActOne.SoldMemory == unitId;

        /// <summary>Shop 16: Hob sits in its own chair in the perfect room until the whole brigade pulls it up; the road waits.</summary>
        public bool HobRescueNeeded => !State.Endless && State.Wave == 16 && State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && (State.ActOne?.HobRescued ?? 0) == 0;
        public bool PullHobUp()
        {
            if (!HobRescueNeeded) return false;
            State.ActOne ??= new ActOneProgress();
            State.ActOne.HobRescued = 1; return true;
        }
        public bool RelightChoiceOpen => State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && (State.ActOne?.PendingRelight ?? 0) == 1;
        /// <summary>Relights one broken lantern of the traveller's choosing (its detail of the Thursday visitor comes back).</summary>
        /// <summary>Instead of a lantern, the colours: a rainbow gift opens in this shop (the Bedside's other reward).</summary>
        public bool ChooseColours()
        {
            if (!RelightChoiceOpen) return false;
            State.ActOne.PendingRelight = 0;
            if (OfferPrismGift(true)) return true;
            State.ActOne.PendingRelight = 1; return false; // nothing rainbow left to give: the lanterns stay the choice
        }
        public bool ColoursAvailable => RelightChoiceOpen && RainbowChoices(State.Wave * 7 + State.PrismShardDrops + 1000) != null;
        public bool ChooseRelight(int lamp)
        {
            if (!RelightChoiceOpen || ActOneCanon.LampState(lamp, State.Wave, State.ActOne.RelitMask) != 2) return false;
            State.ActOne.RelitMask |= 1 << lamp; State.ActOne.PendingRelight = 0;
            return true;
        }

        public static void ValidateActOne(RunSnapshot state)
        {
            ActOneProgress progress = state?.ActOne;
            if (progress == null) return;
            if (progress.Revision != 1 || progress.SitCloser < ActOneProgress.None || progress.SitCloser > ActOneProgress.Lost || progress.RelitMask < 0 || progress.RelitMask > 0x7f)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid Act I progress");
            if (progress.SitCloser == ActOneProgress.None ? progress.SatWave != 0 : progress.SatWave < ActOneCanon.SitFrom || progress.SatWave > ActOneCanon.SitUntil || progress.SatWave > state.Wave)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid warm chair visit");
            if (progress.SitCloser == ActOneProgress.Fighting && (state.Phase != SessionPhase.Combat || state.Wave != progress.SatWave))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The warm chair fight belongs to its own shop visit");
            if (progress.SitCloser == ActOneProgress.Lost && state.Phase != SessionPhase.Defeat)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Sitting down ends the journey");
            for (int lamp = 0; lamp < 8; lamp++)
                if ((progress.RelitMask & (1 << lamp)) != 0 && state.Wave < ActOneCanon.BreakWave[lamp]) throw new InvalidOperationException("A lantern cannot be relit before it breaks");
            if (progress.Offer < ActOneProgress.Undecided || progress.Offer > ActOneProgress.Sold || progress.Offer != ActOneProgress.Undecided && state.Wave < 8 && !state.Endless
                || (progress.Offer == ActOneProgress.Sold) == string.IsNullOrEmpty(progress.SoldMemory))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid Customer offer");
            if (state.Items != null && state.Items.Exists(stack => stack.Id == ActOneCanon.ThursdayShoesId) && progress.SitCloser != ActOneProgress.Won)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The Thursday Shoes are only given for standing up from the warm chair");
            if (progress.HobRescued < 0 || progress.HobRescued > 1 || progress.HobRescued == 1 && state.Wave < 16 && !state.Endless)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Hob cannot be pulled up before it sits down");
            if (progress.PendingRelight < 0 || progress.PendingRelight > 1 || progress.PendingRelight == 1 && progress.SitCloser != ActOneProgress.Won)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("A lantern can only be chosen after standing up from the warm chair");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum ArenaToyKind { StageBell, ToyCart, InkBottle, HangingHammer, SleepMirror, FloorMusicBox }
    public enum ArenaToyMode { Charging, Warning, Rolling, Cooldown }

    public sealed class ArenaToyState
    {
        public int Id { get; internal set; }
        public ArenaToyKind Kind { get; internal set; }
        public ArenaToyMode Mode { get; internal set; }
        public Vector2 Position { get; internal set; }
        public Vector2 PreviousPosition { get; internal set; }
        public Vector2 LaneStart { get; internal set; }
        public Vector2 LaneEnd { get; internal set; }
        public Vector2 ShiftDestination { get; internal set; }
        public int Charge { get; internal set; }
        public int RequiredCharge => Kind == ArenaToyKind.StageBell ? 3 : 2;
        public float Until { get; internal set; }
        public float Started { get; internal set; }
        public float Radius => Kind == ArenaToyKind.StageBell ? 2.4f : Kind == ArenaToyKind.InkBottle ? 2.5f : Kind == ArenaToyKind.HangingHammer ? 1.8f : Kind == ArenaToyKind.FloorMusicBox ? 4f : 0.55f;
        internal CombatCause Cause;
        internal readonly HashSet<int> Roots = new HashSet<int>();
        internal readonly HashSet<int> Victims = new HashSet<int>();
        internal float NextAutomatic;
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        public const float ArenaToyWarning = 1.2f;
        public const float ArenaToyCooldown = 5f;
        public const float ArenaToyRollDuration = 0.8f;
        private readonly List<ArenaToyState> arenaToys = new List<ArenaToyState>();
        private IReadOnlyList<ArenaToyState> arenaToyView;
        private int arenaToyWave;
        private bool arenaShiftConsumed;
        public IReadOnlyList<ArenaToyState> ArenaToys => arenaToyView ?? (arenaToyView = arenaToys.AsReadOnly());
        public bool ArenaShiftWarning { get; private set; }
        public bool ArenaShiftComplete { get; private set; }
        public float ArenaShiftUntil { get; private set; }
        public int ArenaToyActivations { get; private set; }

        public void ClearArenaToys()
        {
            arenaToys.Clear();
            ArenaShiftWarning = ArenaShiftComplete = arenaShiftConsumed = false;
            ArenaShiftUntil = 0f;
            ArenaToyActivations = 0;
        }

        /// <summary>The arena's fixed props (chair, landmarks, lanterns, architecture...): the same plan the presentation
        /// draws, computed from plain catalog data. Null when the catalog carries no scenery (sandbox, tests).</summary>
        public ArenaLayoutPlan ArenaLayout { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>A toy's painted body and shadow reach this far from its position.</summary>
        public const float ArenaToyFootprint = 0.85f;

        public void ResetArenaToys(int wave = 1)
        {
            ClearArenaToys();
            arenaToyWave = Mathf.Max(1, wave);
            ArenaLayout = catalog.Scenery is ArenaScenery scenery ? ArenaLayoutPlan.For(scenery.Resized(catalog.ArenaSize)) : null;
            if (!catalog.EnableArenaToys || Champion == null) return;
            var random = new System.Random(unchecked(catalog.Seed ^ arenaToyWave * 486187739 ^ 0x4A44));
            int count = arenaToyWave == 1 ? 1 : 2;
            if (catalog.ExpandedContent) count = Mathf.Min(6, 2 + (arenaToyWave - 1) / 2);
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                if (!TryArenaPlacement(random, out Vector2 position)) continue;
                arenaToys.Add(new ArenaToyState { Id = index + 1, Kind = (ArenaToyKind)index, Position = position, PreviousPosition = position, ShiftDestination = position });
            }
        }

        private bool SafeArenaPlacement(Vector2 position, ArenaToyState ignored = null)
        {
            Vector2 half = catalog.ArenaSize * 0.5f - Vector2.one * 1.1f;
            if (half.x <= 0f || half.y <= 0f || !FiniteArenaVector(position) || Mathf.Abs(position.x) > half.x || Mathf.Abs(position.y) > half.y) return false;
            if (ArenaLayout != null && ArenaLayout.Blocks(position, ArenaToyFootprint)) return false; // never on a prop
            foreach (UnitState unit in units)
            {
                if (!unit.Alive) continue;
                float clearance = unit.Definition.Radius + (unit.Faction == Faction.Champion ? 2f : 0.85f);
                if ((position - unit.Position).sqrMagnitude < clearance * clearance) return false;
                if (unit.Definition.IsBoss && unit.TelegraphUntil > Elapsed) return false;
            }
            foreach (PickupState pickup in pickups)
                if ((position - pickup.Position).sqrMagnitude < 1.2f * 1.2f) return false;
            foreach (ArenaToyState toy in arenaToys)
                if (toy != ignored && ((position - toy.Position).sqrMagnitude < 3f * 3f || (position - toy.ShiftDestination).sqrMagnitude < 3f * 3f)) return false;
            return true;
        }

        private bool TryArenaPlacement(System.Random random, out Vector2 position, ArenaToyState ignored = null)
        {
            Vector2 half = catalog.ArenaSize * 0.5f - Vector2.one * 1.1f;
            for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 96; attempt++)
            {
                position = new Vector2(((float)random.NextDouble() * 2f - 1f) * half.x, ((float)random.NextDouble() * 2f - 1f) * half.y);
                if (SafeArenaPlacement(position, ignored)) return true;
            }
            position = Vector2.zero;
            return false;
        }

        private static bool FiniteArenaVector(Vector2 value) => float.IsFinite(value.x) && float.IsFinite(value.y);

        public void NotifyArenaToyHit(CombatEvent impact)
        {
            if (impact.Kind != CombatEventKind.Hit || impact.Faction != Faction.Enemy || !float.IsFinite(impact.Value) || impact.Value <= 0f) return;
            NotifyArenaToyHit(impact.Position, impact.Direction, impact.Cause);
        }

        public void NotifyArenaToyHit(Vector2 point, Vector2 direction, CombatCause cause)
        {
            UnitState source = null;
            foreach (UnitState unit in units)
                if (unit.Id == cause.SourceUnitId) { source = unit; break; }
            NotifyArenaToyHit(source, point, point, 0f, direction, cause);
        }

        public void NotifyArenaToyHit(Vector2 point, CombatCause cause) => NotifyArenaToyHit(point, Vector2.right, cause);

        public void NotifyArenaToyHit(UnitState source, Vector2 start, Vector2 end, float impactRadius, Vector2 direction, CombatCause cause)
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableArenaToys || Phase != RunPhase.Combat || ArenaShiftWarning || source == null || !source.Alive ||
                (source.Faction != Faction.Champion && source.Faction != Faction.Companion) || cause.RootId == 0 || cause.Depth != 0 ||
                cause.SourceUnitId != source.Id || !FiniteArenaVector(start) || !FiniteArenaVector(end) || !FiniteArenaVector(direction) ||
                !float.IsFinite(impactRadius) || impactRadius < 0f) return;
            foreach (ArenaToyState toy in arenaToys)
            {
                if (toy.Mode != ArenaToyMode.Charging || SegmentCircle(start, end, toy.Position, impactRadius + 0.45f) < 0f || !toy.Roots.Add(cause.RootId)) continue;
                toy.Charge++;
                if (toy.Charge < toy.RequiredCharge) continue;
                toy.Cause = new CombatCause(cause.RootId, 0, "arena-" + toy.Kind.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(), 1);
                if (toy.Kind == ArenaToyKind.StageBell) toy.Cause = new CombatCause(cause.RootId, 0, "arena-stage-bell", 1);
                if (toy.Kind == ArenaToyKind.ToyCart) toy.Cause = new CombatCause(cause.RootId, 0, "arena-toy-cart", 1);
                toy.Mode = ArenaToyMode.Warning;
                toy.Started = Elapsed;
                toy.Until = Elapsed + ArenaToyWarning;
                toy.LaneStart = toy.Position;
                Vector2 heading = direction.sqrMagnitude > 0.0001f ? direction.normalized : Vector2.right;
                toy.LaneEnd = ClampPosition(toy.Position + heading * 4f, 0.65f);
            }
        }

        public void ProcessArenaToys(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableArenaToys || Phase != RunPhase.Combat || !float.IsFinite(deltaTime) || deltaTime <= 0f || deltaTime > 0.1f) return;
            ProcessArenaShift();
            if (ArenaShiftWarning) return;
            foreach (ArenaToyState toy in arenaToys)
            {
                toy.PreviousPosition = toy.Position;
                if (catalog.PatchSpring && toy.Mode == ArenaToyMode.Charging && Elapsed >= toy.NextAutomatic)
                {
                    toy.NextAutomatic = Elapsed + 3f;
                    NotifyArenaToyHit(Champion, toy.Position, toy.Position, 0, Vector2.right, NewCause(Champion.Id));
                }
                if (toy.Mode == ArenaToyMode.Cooldown && Elapsed >= toy.Until)
                {
                    toy.Mode = ArenaToyMode.Charging;
                    toy.Charge = 0;
                }
                if (toy.Mode == ArenaToyMode.Warning && Elapsed >= toy.Until)
                {
                    ArenaToyActivations++;
                    RecordActivation(toy.Cause);
                    toy.Victims.Clear();
                    if (toy.Kind >= ArenaToyKind.InkBottle)
                    {
                        ActivateExpandedToy(toy);
                        CoolArenaToy(toy);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (toy.Kind == ArenaToyKind.StageBell)
                    {
                        RingStageBell(toy);
                        CoolArenaToy(toy);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        toy.Mode = ArenaToyMode.Rolling;
                        toy.Started = Elapsed;
                        toy.Until = Elapsed + ArenaToyRollDuration;
                    }
                }
                if (toy.Mode != ArenaToyMode.Rolling) continue;
                float progress = Mathf.Clamp01((Elapsed - toy.Started) / ArenaToyRollDuration);
                toy.Position = Vector2.Lerp(toy.LaneStart, toy.LaneEnd, 1f - (1f - progress) * (1f - progress));
                DamageArenaToyArea(toy, toy.PreviousPosition, toy.Position, toy.Radius);
                if (Elapsed >= toy.Until) CoolArenaToy(toy);
            }
        }

        private void CoolArenaToy(ArenaToyState toy)
        {
            toy.Mode = ArenaToyMode.Cooldown;
            toy.Started = Elapsed;
            toy.Until = Elapsed + ArenaToyCooldown;
            toy.Charge = 0;
        }

        /// <summary>The stage bell rings out three chimes that fly at the nearest enemies (no ring round the bell).</summary>
        private void RingStageBell(ArenaToyState toy)
        {
            targetCandidates.Clear();
            foreach (UnitState u in units) if (u.Alive && u.Faction == Faction.Enemy && (u.Position - toy.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 36f) targetCandidates.Add(u);
            targetCandidates.Sort((a, b) => (a.Position - toy.Position).sqrMagnitude.CompareTo((b.Position - toy.Position).sqrMagnitude));
            Sprite chime = CombatVfxArtwork.Frame("BellChime", 0);
            var ring = new HashSet<int>(); // each enemy is struck once per ring
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
            {
                Vector2 aim = targetCandidates.Count > 0 ? targetCandidates[i % targetCandidates.Count].Position - toy.Position : new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(i * 2.1f), Mathf.Sin(i * 2.1f));
                aim = (aim.sqrMagnitude > 0.0001f ? aim.normalized : Vector2.right);
                if (targetCandidates.Count <= i) aim = (Vector2)(Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, (i - 1) * 14) * aim);
                projectiles.Add(new ProjectileState { Id = ++nextId, Faction = Faction.Companion, Position = toy.Position, PreviousPosition = toy.Position, Velocity = aim * 7f,
                    LaunchVelocity = aim * 7f, Remaining = 0.9f, Damage = 14f, Color = new Color(1, 0.86f, 0.5f), Element = DamageElement.Physical, SourceName = "Stage bell",
                    Sprite = chime, VisualWidth = 0.4f, Radius = 0.16f, IsFragment = true, Cause = toy.Cause, Volley = ring });
            }
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Support, toy.Position + Vector2.up * 0.5f, Faction.Companion, cause: toy.Cause));
        }

        private void ActivateExpandedToy(ArenaToyState toy)
        {
            if (toy.Kind == ArenaToyKind.InkBottle)
            {
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Ink, Champion, toy.Position, Vector2.zero, 2.5f, 0, 0, 2f, toy.Cause);
            }
            else if (toy.Kind == ArenaToyKind.HangingHammer)
            {
                // the hammer falls where it hangs: a painted slam, not a ring
                DamageArenaToyArea(toy, toy.Position, toy.Position, 1.8f);
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Detonation, toy.Position, Faction.Companion, 1.8f / 1.4f, Vector2.down, cause: toy.Cause));
            }
            else if (toy.Kind == ArenaToyKind.SleepMirror)
            {
                UnitState owner = units.Find(unit => unit.Alive && unit.Faction != Faction.Enemy && unit.Definition.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile);
                UnitState target = units.Find(unit => unit.Alive && unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy && (unit.Position - toy.Position).sqrMagnitude < 36f);
                if (owner != null && target != null)
                    projectiles.Add(new ProjectileState { Id = ++nextId, Faction = Faction.Companion, Position = toy.Position, PreviousPosition = toy.Position, Velocity = (target.Position - toy.Position).normalized * 6f, Remaining = 1.5f, Damage = owner.Definition.Weapon.Damage * 0.4f, SourceUnitId = owner.Id, Cause = toy.Cause, Color = owner.Definition.Weapon.ProjectileColor, Sprite = owner.Definition.Weapon.ProjectileSprite, VisualWidth = 0.18f, Element = DamageElement.Physical, SourceName = "Sleep mirror" });
            }
            else
            {
                // the music box plays to each friend nearby: a note gathers on each of them (no ring round the box)
                foreach (UnitState ally in units)
                    if (ally.Alive && ally.Faction != Faction.Enemy && (ally.Position - toy.Position).sqrMagnitude < 16f)
                    {
                        ally.NextAttack = Mathf.Max(Elapsed, ally.NextAttack - 0.2f);
                        events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Support, ally.Position + Vector2.up * 0.25f, ally.Faction, subject: ally, cause: toy.Cause));
                    }
            }
        }

        private void DamageArenaToyArea(ArenaToyState toy, Vector2 start, Vector2 end, float radius)
        {
            foreach (UnitState target in units)
            {
                if (!target.Alive || target.Faction != Faction.Enemy || toy.Victims.Contains(target.Id) ||
                    SegmentCircle(start, end, target.Position, radius + target.Definition.Radius) < 0f) continue;
                toy.Victims.Add(target.Id);
                float damage = toy.Kind == ArenaToyKind.StageBell ? 14f : 18f;
                if (target.Definition.IsBoss) damage = Mathf.Min(damage * 0.35f, target.Definition.Health * 0.08f);
                ApplyDamage(target, damage, Faction.Companion, toy.Cause.ItemId, (end - start).normalized, cause: toy.Cause);
            }
        }

        private void ProcessArenaShift()
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableBossArenaPhase) return;
            if (Boss == null || !Boss.Alive)
            {
                ArenaShiftWarning = false;
                return;
            }
            if (!arenaShiftConsumed && Boss.Health <= Boss.Definition.Health * 0.5f)
            {
                arenaShiftConsumed = true;
                ArenaShiftWarning = true;
                ArenaShiftUntil = Elapsed + ArenaToyWarning;
                var random = new System.Random(unchecked(catalog.Seed ^ arenaToyWave * 486187739 ^ 0xB044));
                foreach (ArenaToyState toy in arenaToys)
                {
                    toy.ShiftDestination = TryArenaPlacement(random, out Vector2 destination, toy) ? destination : toy.Position;
                    CoolArenaToy(toy);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (!ArenaShiftWarning || Elapsed < ArenaShiftUntil) return;
            foreach (ArenaToyState toy in arenaToys)
            {
                if (SafeArenaPlacement(toy.ShiftDestination, toy)) toy.Position = toy.ShiftDestination;
                toy.PreviousPosition = toy.Position;
                toy.ShiftDestination = toy.Position;
                CoolArenaToy(toy);
            }
            ArenaShiftWarning = false;
            ArenaShiftComplete = true;
        }

#if UNITY_EDITOR
        public void ArenaToyTickFixture(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (Phase != RunPhase.Combat || !float.IsFinite(deltaTime) || deltaTime <= 0f || deltaTime > 0.1f) return;
            Elapsed += deltaTime;
            ProcessArenaToys(deltaTime);
            spatial.Rebuild(units); MoveProjectiles(deltaTime); // the stage bell's chimes fly to their targets
        }
#endif
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class CarnivalBalance
    {
        public static float ShopPrice(int wave)
        {
            float stage = Mathf.Max(0, wave - 1);
            return Mathf.Min(10000, (1 + stage * 0.12f + stage * stage * 0.009f) * (1 + Mathf.Min(0.2f, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 3) * 0.01f)) * (1 + Mathf.Max(0, wave - 7) * .065f) * SwarmCoinPressure(wave));
        }
        /// <summary>Balance pass 19/10/2026: swarm coins grow far faster than prices after wave 5 (bot wallet / mean offer 5.6 at
        /// waves 1–5, 12.5 at 6–10, 16 at 11–19; 18 relics bought per late shop). Prices catch up to x2.2 by wave 13, keeping
        /// roughly the early game's "three slots and a couple of rerolls" per shop. Docs/Balance_Pass_2026-10-19.md.</summary>
        // round 2 (owner target: wallet / mean offer ~5-6 in waves 11-19): x1.9 at wave 8, x2.5 at wave 10, x3.4 from wave 13
        /// <summary>Round 3 (owner play-test: still too rich): gold credited per coin value, 0.75 (was 1). Coin drops and visuals unchanged.</summary>
        public const float CoinGoldValue = .75f;
        public static float SwarmCoinPressure(int wave) => 1 + Mathf.Min(2.4f, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 5) * .3f);

        public static float EnemyHealth(int wave) => 1.2f * (1 + Mathf.Pow(Mathf.Max(0, wave - 1) / 12f, 1.45f)) * (1 + Mathf.Pow(Mathf.Max(0, wave - 4) / 16f, 1.4f) * 1.4f);
        public static float EnemyDensity(int wave) => 1 + Mathf.Min(3, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 3) * 0.13f);
        public static float SpawnInterval(int wave) => Mathf.Max(0.25f, (1.4f - Mathf.Min(3, Mathf.Max(1, wave)) * 0.035f) / (1 + Mathf.Max(0, wave - 3) * 0.18f));
        public static float BossBulk(int wave) => Mathf.Lerp(4.6f, 7.5f, Mathf.Clamp01((wave - 4) / 16f));
        public static float EnemySpeed(int wave) => 1.08f * (1 + 1.8f * (1 - Mathf.Exp(-Mathf.Max(0, wave - 1) * 0.05f)));
        public static float EnemyDamage(int wave) => 1.15f * (1 + Mathf.Min(3, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 3) * 0.09f)) * (1 + Mathf.Min(1.4f, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 5) * 0.07f));
        public static float RecruitDamage(ItemRarity rarity) => 1 + (int)rarity * 0.18f;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    /// <summary>Mythic companions' own skills (Docs/Content_Expansion_Proposal.md §4.4, 18/10/2026): a Mythic friend must do
    /// something no other friend does. Each skill runs from the friend's own position or blows (nothing radiates from the
    /// hero), and its moment is inked with the identity strike glyphs.</summary>
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<int, float> skillAt = new Dictionary<int, float>();
        private readonly Dictionary<int, int> skillCount = new Dictionary<int, int>();
        private static readonly List<UnitState> skillTargets = new List<UnitState>();

        /// <summary>Companion skill ids, for checks and descriptions.</summary>
        public static readonly string[] CompanionSkillIds = { "PillowOracle", "ReelOwl", "ClockworkPiper", "CoilKettle", "IronLocomotive", "PaperInventor", "ReturnCaptain", "MirrorNewt",
            "TeaDragon", "LighthouseWhale", "JackInTheBox", "KiteDragon", "SundaeGolem", "LostCarousel", "EndlessIndex", "FirstSeed", "EclipseEgg",
            "StaticFerret", "StormKitten", "VoltEel", "ShantySeaLion", "PinnedBeetle", "FossilArmadillo", "CourtHerald" };
        public int CompanionSkillCasts { get; private set; }

        private bool SkillReady(UnitState u, float period)
        {
            if (skillAt.TryGetValue(u.Id, out float at) && Elapsed < at) return false;
            skillAt[u.Id] = Elapsed + period; return true;
        }
        private UnitState Strongest(Vector2 origin, float range)
        {
            UnitState best = null;
            foreach (UnitState u in units)
                if (CanHit(Faction.Champion, u) && (u.Position - origin).sqrMagnitude <= range * range && (best == null || u.Health > best.Health)) best = u;
            return best;
        }
        private UnitState Nearest(Vector2 origin, float range)
        {
            UnitState best = null; float d = range * range;
            foreach (UnitState u in units) if (CanHit(Faction.Champion, u)) { float s = (u.Position - origin).sqrMagnitude; if (s <= d) { d = s; best = u; } }
            return best;
        }
        /// <summary>Sleep or freeze: the enemy neither moves (EnemySleepScale) nor attacks for `seconds`; bosses only briefly.</summary>
        private void Sleep(UnitState enemy, float seconds)
        {
            if (enemy.Definition.IsBoss) seconds = Mathf.Min(seconds, .3f);
            enemy.SleepUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.SleepUntil, Elapsed + seconds);
            enemy.NextAttack = Mathf.Max(enemy.NextAttack, Elapsed + seconds); enemy.NextContact = Mathf.Max(enemy.NextContact, Elapsed + seconds);
        }
        private float EnemySleepScale(UnitState unit) => unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy && unit.SleepUntil > Elapsed ? 0 : 1;
        private float CompanionHaste(UnitState unit) => unit.Faction == Faction.Companion && unit.HasteUntil > Elapsed ? 1 / 1.3f : 1;
        /// <summary>Damage our friends deal to an anchored enemy (Return Captain).</summary>
        private float CompanionSkillDamage(UnitState target, float damage, Faction source, CombatCause cause)
        {
            if (target.Faction != Faction.Enemy || source == Faction.Enemy) return damage;
            UnitState attacker = UnitWithId(cause.SourceUnitId);
            if (attacker == null || attacker.Faction != Faction.Companion) return damage;
            if (target.AnchorUntil > Elapsed) damage *= 1.2f;
            if (catalog.BondRecordedDamage > 0 && Recorded(target)) damage *= 1 + catalog.BondRecordedDamage; // Exhibit Hall
            return damage;
        }
        private void Skill(UnitState u, MorphGeometry shape, Vector2 at, Vector2 end, float radius)
        {
            CompanionSkillCasts++;
            IdentityGlyph(shape, at, end, radius, .45f, 0, shape == MorphGeometry.Line ? HeroGlyphRole.Strike : HeroGlyphRole.Mark);
        }

        private void ProcessCompanionSkills()
        {
            int count = events.Count;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                CombatEvent e = events[i];
                if (e.Cause.Depth != 0) continue;
                UnitState actor = UnitWithId(e.Cause.SourceUnitId);
                if (actor == null || actor.Faction != Faction.Companion || !actor.Alive) continue;
                string id = actor.Definition.Id;
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Fire)
                {
                    skillCount.TryGetValue(actor.Id, out int n); skillCount[actor.Id] = ++n;
                    UnitState target = UnitWithId(actor.AttackTargetId);
                    if (id == "ReelOwl" && n % 4 == 0 && target != null && target.Alive)
                    {
                        // the reel replays the strongest friend nearby: its blow lands again on the owl's target
                        float best = 0;
                        foreach (UnitState f in units) if (f.Alive && f.Faction == Faction.Companion && f != actor && (f.Position - actor.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 9) best = Mathf.Max(best, f.Definition.Weapon.Damage);
                        if (best > 0) { ApplyWeaponDamage(target, best * .8f, Faction.Companion, DamageElement.Arcane, "Reel Owl", (target.Position - actor.Position).normalized, cause: NewCause(actor.Id).Child("reel-owl")); Skill(actor, MorphGeometry.Line, actor.Position, target.Position, 0); }
                    }
                }
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Hit && e.Faction == Faction.Enemy && e.Subject != null && catalog.BondChainChance > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < catalog.BondChainChance)
                {
                    // Static Club: the hit arcs on to the nearest other enemy for half the friend's weapon damage
                    UnitState next = null; float best = 2.5f * 2.5f;
                    foreach (UnitState u in units) if (u != e.Subject && CanHit(Faction.Champion, u)) { float d = (u.Position - e.Subject.Position).sqrMagnitude; if (d < best) { best = d; next = u; } }
                    if (next != null)
                    {
                        ApplyWeaponDamage(next, actor.Definition.Weapon.Damage * .5f, Faction.Companion, DamageElement.Arcane, "Static Club", (next.Position - e.Subject.Position).normalized, cause: NewCause(actor.Id).Child("static-club"));
                        IdentityGlyph(MorphGeometry.Line, e.Subject.Position, next.Position, 0, .25f, 0, HeroGlyphRole.Strike);
                    }
                }
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Hit && e.Faction == Faction.Enemy && e.Subject != null && e.Subject.Alive && id == "CoilKettle" && !e.Subject.CoilStruck)
                {
                    // the first blow on each new enemy springs it up: a short stun
                    e.Subject.CoilStruck = true; Sleep(e.Subject, .4f); Skill(actor, MorphGeometry.Disc, e.Subject.Position, e.Subject.Position, .35f);
                }
            }
            ProcessNewCompanionSkills();
            foreach (UnitState u in units)
            {
                if (!u.Alive || u.Faction != Faction.Companion) continue;
                switch (u.Definition.Id)
                {
                    case "PillowOracle":
                        if (Strongest(u.Position, 5) is UnitState sleeper && SkillReady(u, 8)) { Sleep(sleeper, 1.5f); Skill(u, MorphGeometry.Disc, sleeper.Position, sleeper.Position, .45f); }
                        break;
                    case "ClockworkPiper":
                        if (Nearest(u.Position, 7) != null && SkillReady(u, 6))
                        {
                            foreach (UnitState f in units) if (f.Alive && f.Faction == Faction.Companion && (f.Position - u.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 9) f.HasteUntil = Elapsed + 2;
                            Skill(u, MorphGeometry.Disc, u.Position, u.Position, .4f);
                        }
                        break;
                    case "IronLocomotive":
                        if (Nearest(u.Position, 4f) is UnitState ahead && SkillReady(u, 7)) FrostWhistle(u, ahead);
                        break;
                    case "PaperInventor":
                        if (!towerBuilt.Contains(u.Id) && Nearest(u.Position, 5f) is UnitState first) PaperTower(u, first);
                        break;
                    case "ReturnCaptain":
                        if (Strongest(u.Position, 6) is UnitState anchored && SkillReady(u, 5)) { anchored.AnchorUntil = Elapsed + 5; Skill(u, MorphGeometry.Disc, anchored.Position, anchored.Position, .4f); }
                        break;
                    case "MirrorNewt":
                        for (int p = projectiles.Count - 1; p >= 0; p--)
                        {
                            ProjectileState shot = projectiles[p];
                            if (shot.Faction != Faction.Enemy || shot.MirrorChecked || (shot.Position - u.Position).sqrMagnitude > .6f * .6f) continue;
                            shot.MirrorChecked = true;
                            if (combatRandom.NextDouble() >= .25) continue;
                            projectiles.RemoveAt(p);
                            UnitState back = Nearest(u.Position, 7);
                            if (back != null) ApplyWeaponDamage(back, Mathf.Max(shot.Damage, u.Definition.Weapon.Damage), Faction.Companion, shot.Element, "Mirror Newt", (back.Position - u.Position).normalized, cause: NewCause(u.Id).Child("mirror-newt"));
                            Skill(u, MorphGeometry.Line, u.Position, back != null ? back.Position : u.Position + Vector2.up, 0);
                        }
                        break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````
