````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum ExpandedFieldKind { Tea, Iron, Fuse, Strike, Link, Photo, Echo, OfficeHazard, ToyHazard, Curtain, Ink, Projector, MagnetCone, YoYoTether, SewingLink, Tentacle, Shockwave, FallingProp, ShadowPool, Roller }
    public sealed class ExpandedField
    {
        public ExpandedFieldKind Kind;
        public Vector2 Position;
        public Vector2 Start;
        public Vector2 Direction;
        public float Radius;
        public float At;
        public float Created;
        public float Until;
        public float NextTick;
        public float Damage;
        public UnitState Source;
        public UnitState Target;
        public CombatCause Cause;
        public bool Resolved;
        public ProjectileState Projectile;
        public WeaponDefinition ImpactWeapon;
        public bool Critical;
        public UnitState Anchor;
        public int SourceOrgan = -1;
        // a boss's moving piece (BossTrademarks): style = boss pattern, how it travels, and its path's numbers
        public int Style = -1;
        public TrademarkMotion Motion;
        public float Speed, Phase, Length, Reach, Moved;
        public Vector2 Center;
        public bool Spent;
        public readonly HashSet<int> CollateralVictims = new HashSet<int>();
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private readonly List<ExpandedField> fields = new List<ExpandedField>();
        public IReadOnlyList<ExpandedField> ExpandedFields => fields;
        public int ExpandedPayoffs { get; private set; }
        private float treasureUntil;
        private float nextRepair;
        private bool bossMotifConsumed;
        private void ResetExpansion() { ClearExpansion(); ExpandedPayoffs = 0; bossMotifConsumed = false; }
        private void ClearExpansion() { ClearArsenal(); fields.Clear(); flung.Clear(); ClearAirborne(); treasureUntil = nextRepair = 0; ClearSpectacle(); deathReactions.Clear(); ClearCooperation(); ClearEnemyVariants(); ClearBuildMorphs(); ClearOctoberBosses(); }

        private void Field(ExpandedFieldKind kind, UnitState source, Vector2 position, Vector2 direction, float radius, float damage, float delay, float duration, CombatCause cause, UnitState target = null)
        {
            int depth = kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Fuse || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Strike ? cause.Depth : cause.Depth + 1;
            // our area hits are a little tighter than authored (MeleeBalance.Area); tethers, beams and enemy hazards keep theirs
            if ((source == null || source.Faction != Faction.Enemy) && (kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Fuse || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Echo || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Strike || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Tea || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Iron || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Ink || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Photo))
                radius *= MeleeBalance.Area;
            fields.Add(new ExpandedField { Kind = kind, Source = source, Position = position, Start = source == null ? position : source.Position, Direction = direction, Radius = radius, Damage = damage, Created = Elapsed, At = Elapsed + delay, Until = Elapsed + delay + duration, NextTick = Elapsed + delay, Cause = new CombatCause(cause.RootId, cause.SourceUnitId, "expanded-" + kind.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(), depth), Target = target });
        }

        private bool ResolveExpandedAttack(UnitState source, float damage, bool critical, CombatCause cause)
        {
            ResolveCooperationAttack(source, damage, cause);
            WeaponDefinition weapon = source.Definition.Weapon;
            if (weapon.Arsenal != ArsenalWeapon.None && source.Faction != Faction.Enemy) return ResolveArsenalAttack(source, damage, critical, cause);
            if (weapon.Mechanic != CarnivalWeapon.None && source.Faction != Faction.Enemy) return ResolveCarnivalAttack(source, damage, critical, cause);
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.None || source.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return false;
            source.ExpandedBeat++;
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Tea || weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.TetherBow || weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Fish || weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.MusicBox)
            {
                EmitProjectile(source, damage, critical, cause); return true;
            }
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Alarm)
            {
                UnitState target = UnitWithId(source.AttackTargetId);
                if (target != null && !target.Alive) target = null;
                if (target != null) Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Fuse, source, ClampPosition(target.Position, 0.3f), source.AttackDirection, source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 ? 1.8f : 1.5f, damage, 0.9f, 0.25f, cause);
                return true;
            }
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Camera)
            {
                int count = 0;
                foreach (UnitState target in units)
                {
                    Vector2 delta = target.Position - source.Position;
                    if (!CanHit(source.Faction, target) || delta.sqrMagnitude > weapon.Range * weapon.Range || Vector2.Dot(delta.normalized, source.AttackDirection) < 0.55f || count >= (source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 ? 4 : 3)) continue;
                    target.CameraWeakUntil = target.ExposedUntil = Elapsed + 2f; target.WeaknessSourceId = source.Id;
                    ApplyDamage(target, damage, source.Faction, "Sleep camera", source.AttackDirection, weapon, critical, cause: cause);
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Photo, source, target.Position, source.AttackDirection, 0.42f, 0, 0, 0.22f, cause); count++;
                }
                RecordActivation(new CombatCause(cause.RootId, source.Id, "camera-weakspot", 1)); return true;
            }
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Scissors)
            {
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -18) * source.AttackDirection, weapon.Range, damage * 0.65f, 0, 0.05f, cause);
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 18) * source.AttackDirection, weapon.Range, damage * 0.65f, 0.12f, 0.1f, cause); return true;
            }
            foreach (UnitState target in units)
            {
                Vector2 delta = target.Position - source.Position;
                if (!CanHit(source.Faction, target) || delta.magnitude > MeleeTactics.Reach(source,target) || Vector2.Dot(delta.normalized, source.AttackDirection) < weapon.ConeDot) continue;
                bool burning = target.BurnUntil > Elapsed;
                ApplyWeaponDamage(target, damage, source.Faction, weapon.Element, weapon.Id, source.AttackDirection, weapon, critical, cause);
                if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Hammer && burning)
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, target.Position, source.AttackDirection, 1.1f, damage * 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.12f, cause);
            }
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Iron)
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Iron, source, source.Position + source.AttackDirection, source.AttackDirection, source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 ? 0.55f : 0.4f, damage * 0.3f, 0, 1.4f, cause);
            else if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Hammer)
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, source.Position + source.AttackDirection * 1.5f, source.AttackDirection, 1.2f, damage * 0.2f, 0.1f, 0.16f, cause); // the slam lands ahead, not round the wielder
            return true;
        }

        private int MoveExpandedProjectile(ProjectileState projectile, float delta)
        {
            if (projectile.Weapon == null) return 0;
            ExpandedWeapon family = projectile.Weapon.Family;
            projectile.Age += delta;
            if ((family == ExpandedWeapon.MusicBox || projectile.Weapon.HomingOutbound && !projectile.Returning) && projectile.Faction != Faction.Enemy)
            {
                UnitState nearest = null; float best = 16;
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    float distance = (enemy.Position - projectile.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                    if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy || projectile.Victims.Contains(enemy.Id) || distance >= best) continue;
                    nearest = enemy; best = distance;
                }
                if (nearest != null) projectile.Velocity = Vector2.Lerp(projectile.Velocity, (nearest.Position - projectile.Position).normalized * projectile.Weapon.ProjectileSpeed, Mathf.Clamp01(delta * 4));
            }
            if ((family != ExpandedWeapon.Fish && !projectile.Weapon.SecretRecall) || projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return 0;
            if (projectile.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.SatelliteDisc)
            {
                if (projectile.Age < 0.55f) return 0;
                if (projectile.Age < 1.55f)
                {
                    UnitState target = UnitWithId(projectile.OrbitTargetId);
                    if (target != null && !target.Alive) target = null;
                    if (target != null) projectile.OrbitCenter = target.Position;
                    Vector2 radius = projectile.Position - projectile.OrbitCenter;
                    Vector2 outward = radius.sqrMagnitude < 0.001f ? Vector2.right : radius.normalized;
                    Vector2 tangent = new Vector2(-outward.y, outward.x);
                    projectile.Velocity = (tangent + outward * Mathf.Clamp((0.85f - radius.magnitude) * 2, -1.5f, 1.5f)).normalized * projectile.Weapon.ProjectileSpeed;
                    return 0;
                }
            }
            if (projectile.Age > 0.7f && !projectile.Returning)
            {
                projectile.Returning = true;
                ProjectileAudioEvent(CombatEventKind.ProjectileReturn, projectile);
            }
            if (!projectile.Returning) return 0;
            UnitState owner = UnitWithId(projectile.SourceUnitId);
            if (owner != null && !owner.Alive) owner = null;
            if (owner == null) return -1;
            Vector2 offset = owner.Position - projectile.Position;
            if (offset.sqrMagnitude < Mathf.Pow(Mathf.Max(0.2f, projectile.Weapon.ProjectileSpeed * delta), 2) || projectile.Remaining <= 0) return -1;
            projectile.Velocity = offset.normalized * projectile.Weapon.ProjectileSpeed;
            return 0;
        }

        private void OnExpandedProjectileHit(ProjectileState projectile, UnitState target)
        {
            if (projectile.Weapon == null || projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return;
            UnitState source = UnitWithId(projectile.SourceUnitId);
            if (source == null) return;
            ApplyCarnivalProjectilePayoff(projectile, target, source);
            if (projectile.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.Magnet && !projectile.IsFragment && projectile.Cause.Depth == 0) MagnetBoltHit(projectile, target, source);
            if (projectile.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.BloomOrb && !projectile.IsFragment)
            {
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, target.Position, Vector2.zero, 1.5f, projectile.Damage * 0.45f, 0.28f, 0.35f, projectile.Cause.Child("moonseed-bloom"));
                fields[fields.Count - 1].Critical = projectile.Critical;
                fields[fields.Count - 1].ImpactWeapon = projectile.Weapon;
            }
            ExpandedWeapon family = projectile.Weapon.Family;
            if (projectile.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.Sewing && target.Alive)
            {
                bool freshlyPinned = target.ChillUntil <= Elapsed;
                target.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(target.ChillUntil, Elapsed + (target.Definition.IsBoss ? 0.15f : 0.35f));
                if (freshlyPinned) events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.StatusApplied, target.Position, target.Faction, element: DamageElement.Frost, cause: projectile.Cause));
            }
            if (family == ExpandedWeapon.Tea && !projectile.IsFragment)
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Tea, source, target.Position, Vector2.zero, 0.7f * (catalog.TeaCoasterStacks > 0 ? 1.4f : 1), projectile.Damage * 0.25f * (catalog.TeaCoasterStacks > 0 ? 0.8f : 1), 0, 1.8f, projectile.Cause);
            if (family == ExpandedWeapon.TetherBow && projectile.Victims.Count == 1)
            {
                UnitState previous = target; var visited = new HashSet<int> { target.Id };
                for (int link = 0; link < (source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 ? 3 : 2); link++)
                {
                    UnitState next = null; float best = 4;
                    foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                    {
                        float distance = (enemy.Position - previous.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                        if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy || visited.Contains(enemy.Id) || distance >= best) continue;
                        next = enemy; best = distance;
                    }
                    if (next == null) break;
                    var linkField = new ExpandedField { Kind = ExpandedFieldKind.Link, Start = previous.Position, Position = next.Position, At = Elapsed, Until = Elapsed + 0.24f, Resolved = true };
                    fields.Add(linkField); visited.Add(next.Id);
                    ApplyDamage(next, projectile.Damage * 0.25f, source.Faction, "Zipper tether", cause: projectile.Cause.Child("zipper-link")); previous = next;
                }
            }
            if (family == ExpandedWeapon.MusicBox && projectile.FinalNote)
            {
                StampState ownedMark = null;
                foreach (StampState mark in stamps.Values) if (mark.Target == target && mark.Expires > Elapsed) { ownedMark = mark; break; }
                if (ownedMark != null) ownedMark.Expires = Mathf.Max(ownedMark.Expires, Elapsed + 0.6f);
                if (catalog.ChorusStacks > 0)
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, target.Position, Vector2.zero, 1.3f, projectile.Damage * Mathf.Min(0.24f, 0.12f * catalog.ChorusStacks), 0.3f, 0.18f, projectile.Cause);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>The magnet bolt sticks in the foe it strikes and yanks it toward the wielder; up to 2 + tier of its
        /// neighbours (within 1.8) are dragged in after it and struck for 60%, each with a spark line to the bolt. Bosses resist.</summary>
        private void MagnetBoltHit(ProjectileState bolt, UnitState target, UnitState source)
        {
            WeaponDefinition weapon = bolt.Weapon;
            Vector2 heading = bolt.Velocity.sqrMagnitude > 0.0001f ? bolt.Velocity.normalized : source.AttackDirection;
            Vector2 anchor = target.Position;
            if (target.Alive)
            {
                float resistance = target.Definition.IsBoss ? 1 : Mathf.Clamp01(target.Definition.KnockbackResistance);
                Vector2 before = target.Position;
                target.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.MoveTowards(target.Position, source.Position + heading * 1.4f, 0.65f * (1 - resistance)), target.Definition.Radius);
                spatial.Move(target); anchor = target.Position;
                RegisterCooperationPull(source, target, before, bolt.Cause);
                PullBump(target, bolt.Damage, source.Faction, bolt.Cause); // V6
            }
            int pulled = 0, most = 2 + Mathf.Clamp(source.Definition.CombatTier, 1, 3);
            foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
            {
                if (enemy == target || !CanHit(source.Faction, enemy) || (enemy.Position - anchor).sqrMagnitude > 1.8f * 1.8f) continue;
                if (pulled++ >= most) break;
                float resistance = enemy.Definition.IsBoss ? 1 : Mathf.Clamp01(enemy.Definition.KnockbackResistance);
                Vector2 before = enemy.Position;
                enemy.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.MoveTowards(enemy.Position, anchor, 0.65f * (1 - resistance)), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                spatial.Move(enemy);
                PullBump(enemy, bolt.Damage, source.Faction, bolt.Cause); // V6
                fields.Add(new ExpandedField { Kind = ExpandedFieldKind.Link, Start = before, Position = anchor, At = Elapsed, Until = Elapsed + 0.26f, Resolved = true });
                ApplyWeaponDamage(enemy, bolt.Damage * 0.6f, source.Faction, weapon.Element, weapon.Id, (anchor - before).normalized, weapon, bolt.Critical, bolt.Cause);
                RegisterCooperationPull(source, enemy, before, bolt.Cause);
            }
        }

        private void ProcessExpansion(float delta)
        {
            ProcessCooperation();
            ProcessDeathReactions();
            ProcessExpandedRelics(); ProcessBossMotif(); ProcessArsenal(delta);
            for (int index = fields.Count - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                ExpandedField field = fields[index];
                if (Elapsed > field.Until) { fields.RemoveAt(index); continue; }
                if (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Roller) MoveRoller(field);
                bool ink = field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Ink;
                if (Elapsed < field.At || field.Resolved || Elapsed < field.NextTick || (field.Damage <= 0 && !ink)) continue;
                bool heat = field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Tea || field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Iron;
                if (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Strike && field.Source != null && field.Source.Definition.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.RibbonWheel) field.Position = field.Source.Position;
                field.NextTick = Elapsed + (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave || field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Roller ? 0.05f : 0.4f); field.Resolved = !heat && !ink && field.Kind != ExpandedFieldKind.Projector && field.Kind != ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave && field.Kind != ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool && field.Kind != ExpandedFieldKind.Roller;
                ExpandedPayoffs++;
                if (field.Source == null || field.Source.Faction != Faction.Enemy) RecordActivation(field.Cause);
                // fuse and echo blasts are heard and seen as explosions (presentation only; Value = blast radius)
                if ((field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Fuse || field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Echo) && field.Radius >= 1f && (field.Source == null || field.Source.Faction != Faction.Enemy))
                    events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Detonation, field.Position, field.Source == null ? Faction.Companion : field.Source.Faction, field.Radius, field.Direction, field.ImpactWeapon, cause: field.Cause));
                if (CarnivalHazards.IsHostile(field.Kind))
                {
                    ProcessHostileCollateral(field);
                    if (Champion.Alive && CarnivalHazards.Contains(field, Champion.Position, Champion.Definition.Radius, Elapsed))
                    {
                        ApplyDamage(Champion, Mathf.Min(field.Damage, Champion.Definition.Health * 0.08f), Faction.Enemy, field.Kind.ToString(), cause: field.Cause);
                        field.Resolved = true;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy) continue;
                    Vector2 offset = enemy.Position - field.Position;
                    bool inside = field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Iron ? SegmentCircle(field.Position - field.Direction, field.Position + field.Direction, enemy.Position, field.Radius + enemy.Definition.Radius) >= 0 : offset.sqrMagnitude <= (field.Radius + enemy.Definition.Radius) * (field.Radius + enemy.Definition.Radius);
                    if (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Strike) inside &= Vector2.Dot(offset.normalized, field.Direction) >= 0.8f;
                    if (!inside) continue;
                    if (ink) { enemy.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.ChillUntil, Elapsed + 0.6f); continue; }
                    if (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Projector && field.Source != null && field.Source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 && !enemy.Definition.IsBoss)
                    {
                        enemy.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.MoveTowards(enemy.Position, field.Position, 0.12f * (1 - Mathf.Clamp01(enemy.Definition.KnockbackResistance))), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                        enemy.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.ChillUntil, Elapsed + 0.25f); spatial.Move(enemy);
                        PullBump(enemy, field.Damage, Faction.Companion, field.Cause); // V6
                    }
                    // R15: fuses and echoes throw what they hit away from their centre
                    bool blast = field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Fuse || field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Echo;
                    float floor = impactWeightFloor; if (blast) impactWeightFloor = ImpactRules.BlastWeight;
                    Vector2 blastAway = blast && (enemy.Position - field.Position).sqrMagnitude > .0001f ? (enemy.Position - field.Position).normalized : field.Direction;
                    ApplyDamage(enemy, field.Damage, field.Source == null ? Faction.Companion : field.Source.Faction, field.Cause.ItemId, blastAway, field.ImpactWeapon != null ? field.ImpactWeapon : field.Cause.Depth == 0 && field.Source != null ? field.Source.Definition.Weapon : null, critical: field.Critical, cause: field.Cause); impactWeightFloor = floor;
                    if (heat && enemy.Alive)
                    {
                        enemy.BurnUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.BurnUntil, Elapsed + 0.6f); enemy.BurnCause = field.Cause.Child("heat-status");
                        if (catalog.ThermalInk && enemy.VisibleMarks > 0 && Elapsed >= enemy.NextThermal)
                        {
                            enemy.NextThermal = Elapsed + 0.9f; ApplyDamage(enemy, field.Damage * 0.4f, Faction.Companion, "Thermal ink", cause: field.Cause.Child("thermal-ink"));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private void ProcessExpandedRelics()
        {
            int original = events.Count;
            for (int index = 0; index < original; index++)
            {
                CombatEvent trigger = events[index];
                if (catalog.TreasureStacks > 0 && trigger.Kind == CombatEventKind.ChestOpened && trigger.Cause.Depth == 0)
                {
                    treasureUntil = Elapsed + 4; Heal(3 * catalog.TreasureStacks, trigger.Cause.Child("treasure-ribbon")); RecordActivation(trigger.Cause.Child("treasure-ribbon"));
                }
                if (catalog.RepairStacks > 0 && trigger.Kind == CombatEventKind.Kill && trigger.Faction == Faction.Enemy && trigger.Cause.ItemId != null && trigger.Cause.ItemId.StartsWith("arena-") && Elapsed >= nextRepair)
                {
                    nextRepair = Elapsed + 0.6f; Heal(catalog.RepairStacks, trigger.Cause.Child("repair-coupon")); RecordActivation(trigger.Cause.Child("repair-coupon"));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    /// <summary>What fills a hero's gauge (content expansion, Docs/Content_Expansion_Proposal.md §0–1, "comfortable gauges").</summary>
    public enum GaugeSource
    {
        Hit, Crit, Kill, Distance, Coin, Hurt, Time, NearEnemies, FriendHit, FriendNear, FriendCrit, FriendDistinct, FriendBond,
        NearMiss, Block, Turn, Rear, Pinned, Debt, Chest, NewSpecies, Sprouts, FarHit,
        /// <summary>An enemy felled while frozen (Sundae Duchess) / a personal hit on a probed enemy (Bell Diver).</summary>
        FrozenKill, Probed
    }

    /// <summary>Comfortable gauges (18/10/2026): every gauge fills from ordinary play, a hero's own conditions only fill it
    /// faster, nothing drains it, and the rhythm stays between ~18s (a per-second cap, however many enemies) and ~35s (a base
    /// trickle, however the hero plays). Each tier needs <see cref="GaugeTier"/> points; three tiers transform the hero.</summary>
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        public const float GaugeTier = 10f, GaugeTrickle = 30f / 35f, GaugeCap = 30f / 18f, GaugePrimeSeconds = 1f;
        private float gaugePending;

        /// <summary>Points per unit of each source for each hero (Docs/Content_Expansion_v5.md §1, "Nạp từ" and "Nhanh hơn khi").</summary>
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, (GaugeSource source, float points)[]> GaugeRecipes = new Dictionary<string, (GaugeSource, float)[]>
        {
            ["Postmaster"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f) },
            ["SupperMortar"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f) },
            ["TreasureAcorn"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Kill, 1.5f) },
            ["CopperCauldron"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Hurt, 2.5f) },
            ["CitrusMarshal"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Distance, .4f), (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f) },
            ["StormFencer"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.NearMiss, 2f) },
            ["SoapSkater"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Distance, .5f), (GaugeSource.Turn, 1.5f) },
            ["ButtonCavalier"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.NearMiss, 2f) },
            ["GlassDice"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Coin, 1f), (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f) },
            ["RainArchivist"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Time, .4f), (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Chest, 4f) },
            ["ArchiveCurator"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Kill, 1.5f), (GaugeSource.NewSpecies, 3f) },
            ["TinVirtuoso"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Crit, 1f) },
            ["MoonProwler"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Distance, .5f), (GaugeSource.Rear, .5f) },
            ["DrowsySeer"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Distance, .4f), (GaugeSource.Time, .4f) },
            ["HourglassStag"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Debt, .5f) },
            ["PennyBroker"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Coin, 1f) },
            ["LanternKnight"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.FriendNear, .5f), (GaugeSource.Time, .4f) },
            ["RootOracle"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Time, .4f), (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.NearEnemies, .4f) },
            ["VerdantMatron"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Time, .4f), (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Sprouts, .4f) },
            ["PetalCitadel"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Time, .4f), (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f) },
            ["ChinaMarionette"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Hurt, 2.5f) },
            ["TideSinger"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Time, .4f), (GaugeSource.Coin, 1f) },
            ["NightMaw"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Kill, 1.5f) },
            ["LoneJelly"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Kill, 1.5f) },
            ["PatchworkHost"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.FriendHit, .3f), (GaugeSource.FriendDistinct, .15f) },
            ["VelvetRegent"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.FriendHit, .3f), (GaugeSource.FriendBond, .15f) },
            ["IvorySovereign"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Hurt, 1.5f) },
            ["ThornTreasurer"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Hurt, 2.5f) },
            ["CometRunner"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Distance, .6f) },
            ["MirrorKeeper"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Block, 2f) },
            ["LanternWeaver"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Pinned, .5f) },
            // the new heroes (Docs/Content_Expansion_v5.md)
            ["KiteAdmiral"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.FarHit, 1.5f), (GaugeSource.Hit, .5f), (GaugeSource.Time, .3f) }, // FarHit: any own hit beyond 4 units (the kite string too)
            ["BonsaiClocksmith"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Time, .4f), (GaugeSource.Kill, .5f) },
            ["JugglingJester"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.FriendCrit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Hit, .5f) },
            ["BellDiver"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.NearEnemies, .5f), (GaugeSource.Hit, 1f), (GaugeSource.Probed, .5f) },
            // the sundae melts by itself (Proposal §1.2 "Tự tan theo thời gian"); blows taken and frozen kills melt it faster
            ["SundaeDuchess"] = new[] { (GaugeSource.Time, .5f), (GaugeSource.Hit, .5f), (GaugeSource.Hurt, 2f), (GaugeSource.FrozenKill, 2f) },
        };

        /// <summary>A gauge event: the hero's own recipe decides how much it is worth (nothing for a source it does not use).</summary>
        private void Fill(GaugeSource source, float units = 1)
        {
            if (!HeroIdentityEnabled || units <= 0 || !GaugeRecipes.TryGetValue(IdentityId ?? "", out var recipe)) return;
            foreach (var (s, points) in recipe) if (s == source) gaugePending += points * units;
        }
        private bool GaugeUses(GaugeSource source)
        {
            if (!GaugeRecipes.TryGetValue(IdentityId ?? "", out var recipe)) return false;
            foreach (var (s, _) in recipe) if (s == source) return true;
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>Once per step: the trickle plus what the hero earned, never faster than the cap; nothing while transformed
        /// or resting.</summary>
        private void SettleGauge(float delta)
        {
            if (HeroAwakening || HeroAwakenCooling || awakenMeter >= 1) { gaugePending = 0; return; }
            float earned = Mathf.Min(gaugePending, Mathf.Max(0, (GaugeCap - GaugeTrickle) * delta));
            gaugePending = Mathf.Min(gaugePending - earned, GaugeTier); // a short lull may not bank a whole transformation
            Charge(GaugeTrickle * delta + earned);
        }

        /// <summary>Late game: a transformation's area strikes grow with the crowd around the hero (up to +50% at 40 enemies
        /// within 6 units), so they still matter in a sea of enemies.</summary>
        private float CrowdScale
        {
            get
            {
                if (Elapsed < crowdAt) return crowdScale;
                crowdAt = Elapsed + .25f; int n = 0;
                foreach (UnitState u in units) if (u.Alive && u.Faction == Faction.Enemy && (u.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 36) n++;
                crowdScale = 1 + .5f * Mathf.Clamp01((n - 10) / 30f);
                return crowdScale;
            }
        }
        private float crowdAt = -1, crowdScale = 1;
        /// <summary>More than 80 enemies: the transformation's secondary ink (ambient glyphs and links) is left out.</summary>
        private bool Crowded => liveEnemyCount > 80;
        private int liveEnemyCount;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    /// <summary>The battle side of the hero kits (18/10/2026): conditional damage, attack speed and crit for the hero and its
    /// friends, damage the hero takes and dodges, enemy slows, hostile shot speed, coins and chests. Everything reads the hero's
    /// kit (HeroKits); a hero without a kit is untouched.</summary>
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private HeroKit kit;
        private HeroKit Kit => HeroIdentityEnabled ? kit ??= HeroKits.For(IdentityId) : null;
        private float KitValue(KitPassive kind) => Kit?.Value(kind) ?? 0;
        private bool KitHas(KitPassive kind) => Kit != null && Kit.Has(kind);
        private float kitHurtUntil = -100, kitDodgeUntil = -100, kitStillArmed = -1, kitCracks, kitHealAt, kitLeadHealAt, kitLidAt, kitRootAt, kitThornAt;
        private int kitKills, kitInjuryGold, kitChestsPaid, kitSpeciesPaid, kitHitsForHeal, kitRecorded;
        private readonly HashSet<string> kitSpecies = new HashSet<string>();

        private void ResetKit()
        {
            kit = null; kitHurtUntil = kitDodgeUntil = -100; kitStillArmed = -1; kitCracks = 0; kitHealAt = kitLeadHealAt = kitLidAt = kitRootAt = kitThornAt = 0;
            kitKills = kitInjuryGold = kitChestsPaid = kitSpeciesPaid = kitHitsForHeal = kitRecorded = 0; kitSpecies.Clear();
            kitProbedCoins = kitFrozenGold = 0; kitBallAt = 0;
        }

        private bool IsLead(UnitState u) => u != null && u.Faction == Faction.Companion && (identityLead == u || identityLead == null && u.Definition.Id == catalog.HeroLeadUnit);
        private bool Marked(UnitState u) { foreach (var m in identityMarks) if (m.Target == u) return true; return false; }
        private bool Recorded(UnitState u) => u != null && identitySpecimens.Exists(d => d.Id == u.Definition.Id);
        /// <summary>The attacker stands behind the target (against the way it faces).</summary>
        private static bool Behind(UnitState attacker, UnitState target)
        {
            if (attacker == null || target == null) return false;
            Vector2 toAttacker = attacker.Position - target.Position; if (toAttacker.sqrMagnitude < .0001f) return false;
            Vector2 facing = target.Facing.sqrMagnitude > .0001f ? target.Facing.normalized : Vector2.right;
            return Vector2.Dot(toAttacker.normalized, facing) <= -.25f;
        }
        private float kitRootGripAt; private int kitInjuries;
        private int CompanionsNear(Vector2 at, float radius) { int n = 0; foreach (var u in units) if (u.Alive && u.Faction == Faction.Companion && (u.Position - at).sqrMagnitude <= radius * radius) n++; return n; }
        private int PetalsGrown() { int g = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 4 && i < catalog.HeroPetals.Length; i++) if (catalog.HeroPetals[i] > 0) g++; return g; }

        /// <summary>Damage dealt by the hero and its friends, scaled by the kit's conditions.</summary>
        private float KitDamageDealt(UnitState target, float damage, Faction source, CombatCause cause)
        {
            HeroKit k = Kit; if (k == null || target.Faction != Faction.Enemy || source == Faction.Enemy) return damage;
            UnitState attacker = UnitWithId(cause.SourceUnitId);
            float scale = 1;
            // anything of ours
            if (k.Has(KitPassive.EnemyVulnerableNearHero) && (target.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 16) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.EnemyVulnerableNearHero);
            if (target.KitCrackedUntil > Elapsed) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.EnemyCrackOnHit);
            if (source == Faction.Champion && cause.SourceUnitId == Champion.Id)
            {
                if (Marked(target) && k.Has(KitPassive.Stamps)) scale += .1f;
                if (Recorded(target)) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.HeroDamageVsRecorded);
                scale += kitCracks * k.Value(KitPassive.CrackDamage);
                if (k.Has(KitPassive.DamageWithAllies) && CompanionCount >= 3) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.DamageWithAllies);
                if (cause.Depth == 0 && kitStillArmed > 0) { scale += k.Value(KitPassive.StillNextAttack); kitStillArmed = -1; }
                if (cause.Depth == 0 && k.Has(KitPassive.RearDamage) && (Behind(Champion, target) || HeroAwakening && k.Action == KitAction.Eclipse)) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.RearDamage);
                if (k.Has(KitPassive.DiceFaceBuff) && identityFace == 1) scale += .1f;
                if (k.Has(KitPassive.FarShotDamage) && (target.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude > 16) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.FarShotDamage);
            }
            else if (attacker != null && attacker.Faction == Faction.Companion)
            {
                if (Marked(target)) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsMarked) + k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsPinned);
                if (target == identityBounty) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsBounty);
                if (target.ChillUntil > Elapsed || target.KitSlowUntil > Elapsed) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsSlowed);
                if (target.Health < target.Definition.Health * .3f) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsLowHealth);
                if (Behind(attacker, target)) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsRear);
                if (Recorded(target)) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsRecorded);
                if (target.KitShockedUntil > Elapsed) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsShocked);
                if (target.KitWetUntil > Elapsed) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsWet);
                if (target.ProbedUntil > Elapsed) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageVsProbed);
                if ((target.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 2.2f * 2.2f) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageNearHero);
                if (Champion.Health >= Champion.Definition.Health * .5f) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageWhileHeroHealthy);
                scale += Mathf.Min(.1f, Mathf.Floor(catalog.HeroWallet / 50f) * k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamagePerGold));
                scale += Mathf.Min(.15f, catalog.HeroFood * k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamagePerFood));
                scale += PetalsGrown() * k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamagePerPetal);
                if (kitHurtUntil > Elapsed && (attacker.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 16) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageOnHeroHurt);
                Vector2 heading = identityHeading.sqrMagnitude > .01f ? identityHeading : Champion.Facing;
                if (Vector2.Dot(attacker.Position - Champion.Position, heading) < 0) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamageBehindHero);
                if (IsLead(attacker)) scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamLeadDamage);
                if (!target.KitStruck) { target.KitStruck = true; scale += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamFirstHitBonus); }
                if (HeroAwakening && k.Action == KitAction.Parade) scale += .5f; // Knighting: every friend fights one star higher
            }
            if (scale > 1)
            {
                // the hero's own conditional bonus is the hero's; a friend's is a team passive (measured apart)
                if (source == Faction.Champion && cause.SourceUnitId == Champion.Id) HeroIdentityBonusDamage += damage * (scale - 1);
                else HeroKitTeamBonusDamage += damage * (scale - 1);
            }
            return damage * scale;
        }

        /// <summary>The hero's dodge chance from the kit (ButtonCavalier's poise).</summary>
        private float KitDodge => Kit != null && Kit.Has(KitPassive.PoiseDodge) && IdentityId == "ButtonCavalier" ? Mathf.Min(3, identityCharge) * KitValue(KitPassive.PoiseDodge) : 0;

        /// <summary>How much of a blow the hero takes: armour from the kit, the transformation's guard, golden or royal immunity.</summary>
        private float KitDamageTaken(CombatCause cause)
        {
            HeroKit k = Kit; if (k == null) return 1;
            float scale = 1;
            if (k.Has(KitPassive.ArmorNearAllies) && CompanionsNear(Champion.Position, 3f) >= 2) scale *= 1 - k.Value(KitPassive.ArmorNearAllies);
            scale *= 1 - k.Value(KitPassive.HeroArmor);
            if (HeroAwakening)
            {
                scale *= k.HeroDamageTaken;
                if (k.Action == KitAction.Kintsugi && Elapsed - awakenStarted < 3) scale = 0;
            }
            return scale;
        }

        /// <summary>Attack cooldown multiplier for the hero or a friend (below 1 is faster).</summary>
        private float KitCycle(UnitState unit)
        {
            HeroKit k = Kit; if (k == null || unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return 1;
            float bonus = 0;
            if (unit == Champion)
            {
                if (HeroAwakening) bonus += k.HeroAttackSpeed;
                if (Elapsed < kitHurtUntil) bonus += k.Value(KitPassive.AttackSpeedWhenHurt);
                if (k.Has(KitPassive.DiceFaceBuff) && identityFace == 2) bonus += .1f;
            }
            else
            {
                bool near = (unit.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 16;
                if (HeroAwakening && k.TeamAttackSpeed > 0 && (k.Action != KitAction.Lighthouse || (unit.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 25)) bonus += k.TeamAttackSpeed;
                if (HeroAwakening && k.Action == KitAction.TimeGarden && (unit.Position - awakenPlot).sqrMagnitude <= GardenReach * GardenReach) bonus += .4f; // friends beside the bonsai
                if (near) bonus += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamAttackSpeedNearHero);
                if (Elapsed < 5) bonus += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamAttackSpeedWaveStart);
                bonus += Mathf.Min(.1f, kitKills * k.Value(KitPassive.TeamAttackSpeedPerKill));
                if (identityBank > 0) bonus += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamAttackSpeedWhileDebt);
                if (Elapsed < kitHurtUntil && near) bonus += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamAttackSpeedOnHeroHurt);
                bonus += Mathf.Min(.1f, Mathf.Floor(catalog.HeroWallet / 50f) * k.Value(KitPassive.TeamAttackSpeedPerGold));
                bonus += Mathf.Min(.2f, catalog.HeroRelics * k.Value(KitPassive.TeamAttackSpeedPerRelic));
                if (PetalsGrown() == 4) bonus += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamAttackSpeedFullGarden);
                if (k.Has(KitPassive.LeadStarAttackSpeed) && identityLead != null && identityLead.Definition.CombatTier >= 2) bonus += k.Value(KitPassive.LeadStarAttackSpeed);
                bonus += Mathf.Min(.15f, catalog.HeroBondLevels * k.Value(KitPassive.BondLevelAttackSpeed));
            }
            return 1f / (1f + Mathf.Max(0, bonus));
        }

        /// <summary>Lantern Weaver: a friend's shot passing through a pinned enemy pierces one more (once per shot).</summary>
        private bool KitPinnedPierce(ProjectileState projectile, UnitState hit)
        {
            HeroKit k = Kit;
            if (k == null || !k.Has(KitPassive.PinnedPierce) || projectile.PinnedPierced || projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy || !Marked(hit)) return false;
            if (UnitWithId(projectile.SourceUnitId)?.Faction != Faction.Companion) return false;
            projectile.PinnedPierced = true; return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Bell Diver: a friend's shot that strikes a probed enemy bounces once more (once per shot).</summary>
        private bool KitProbedBounce(ProjectileState projectile, UnitState hit)
        {
            HeroKit k = Kit;
            if (k == null || !k.Has(KitPassive.ProbedBounce) || projectile.ProbedBounced || projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy || hit.ProbedUntil <= Elapsed) return false;
            if (UnitWithId(projectile.SourceUnitId)?.Faction != Faction.Companion) return false;
            projectile.ProbedBounced = true; return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Shots a friend just fired (projectiles from `first` on): Kite Admiral's pierce while the gauge is full and the
        /// kite fleet's split shots for the friends a kite flies over.</summary>
        private void KitEmitted(UnitState unit, int first)
        {
            HeroKit k = Kit;
            if (k == null || unit.Faction != Faction.Companion || first >= projectiles.Count || unit.Definition.Weapon.Kind != WeaponKind.Projectile) return;
            bool pierce = k.Has(KitPassive.RangedPierceWhileFull) && (HeroAwakening || HeroAwakenPrimed);
            bool fleet = HeroAwakening && k.Action == KitAction.KiteFleet && awakenFleet.Contains(unit);
            int count = projectiles.Count;
            for (int i = first; i < count; i++)
            {
                ProjectileState p = projectiles[i];
                if (p.Faction != Faction.Companion) continue;
                if (pierce) p.ExtraPierce += Mathf.RoundToInt(k.Value(KitPassive.RangedPierceWhileFull));
                if (!fleet || p.IsFragment) continue;
                // the kite splits the shot: two shots (tight, long voyage) or three with lighter outer ones (wide formation)
                if (IdentityApproach == 1) { KitTwin(p, 16, .6f); KitTwin(p, -16, .6f); }
                else { KitTwin(p, 8, 1); p.Velocity = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -4) * p.Velocity; p.LaunchVelocity = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -4) * p.LaunchVelocity; }
            }
        }
        private void KitTwin(ProjectileState a, float degrees, float share)
        {
            if (projectiles.Count >= 4096) return;
            var turn = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, degrees);
            projectiles.Add(new ProjectileState { Id = ++nextId, Faction = a.Faction, Position = a.Position, PreviousPosition = a.PreviousPosition, Velocity = turn * a.Velocity,
                LaunchVelocity = turn * a.LaunchVelocity, Damage = a.Damage * share, Remaining = a.Remaining, Color = a.Color, Element = a.Element, SourceName = a.SourceName,
                LaunchSegment = a.LaunchSegment, Sprite = a.Sprite, VisualWidth = a.VisualWidth, Radius = a.Radius, Critical = a.Critical, SourceUnitId = a.SourceUnitId,
                Cause = a.Cause.Child("kite-split"), Weapon = a.Weapon, SplitCount = a.SplitCount, SplitOnImpact = a.SplitOnImpact, Pattern = a.Pattern, ExtraPierce = a.ExtraPierce,
                Arsenal = a.Arsenal, ArsenalStage = a.ArsenalStage, ArsenalTimer = a.ArsenalTimer, ArsenalHome = a.ArsenalHome, ArsenalTick = a.ArsenalTick,
                OrbitTargetId = a.OrbitTargetId, OrbitCenter = a.OrbitCenter, RicochetsRemaining = a.RicochetsRemaining, FinalNote = a.FinalNote, IsFragment = true });
        }
        /// <summary>Copper Cauldron: friends' collision damage grows with the blows the hero took this wave.</summary>
        private float KitHurtCollision(UnitState source)
            => source.Faction == Faction.Companion && Kit != null ? Mathf.Min(10, kitInjuries * Kit.Value(KitPassive.HurtCollision)) : 0;

        /// <summary>Extra crit chance for the hero or a friend against a target.</summary>
        private float KitCrit(UnitState unit, UnitState target)
        {
            HeroKit k = Kit; if (k == null || unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return 0;
            if (unit == Champion) return (HeroAwakening ? k.HeroCrit : 0) + (k.Has(KitPassive.DiceFaceBuff) && identityFace == 3 ? .1f : 0);
            float c = 0;
            if (Elapsed < kitDodgeUntil) c += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamCritOnHeroDodge);
            if (Recorded(target)) c += k.Value(KitPassive.TeamCritVsRecorded);
            if (k.Has(KitPassive.TeamRearCrit) && unit.Definition.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee && Behind(unit, target)) c += 1;
            return c;
        }

        /// <summary>How fast an enemy moves under the kit's slows (and the transformations that slow or stop the field).</summary>
        private float KitEnemySpeed(UnitState enemy)
        {
            HeroKit k = Kit; if (k == null || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy) return 1;
            float slow = 0;
            if (k.Has(KitPassive.EnemySlowNearHero) && (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 1.8f * 1.8f) slow = Mathf.Max(slow, k.Value(KitPassive.EnemySlowNearHero));
            if (enemy.KitSlowUntil > Elapsed) slow = Mathf.Max(slow, enemy.KitSlow);
            if (k.Has(KitPassive.Pins) && Marked(enemy)) slow = Mathf.Max(slow, .1f);
            if (k.Has(KitPassive.EnemySlowWithDebt) && enemy == identityDebtor && identityBank > 0) slow = Mathf.Max(slow, k.Value(KitPassive.EnemySlowWithDebt));
            if (HeroAwakening)
            {
                if (k.Action == KitAction.Rink) slow = Mathf.Max(slow, .4f);
                if (k.Action == KitAction.Tapestry && Marked(enemy)) slow = Mathf.Max(slow, .4f);
                if (k.Action == KitAction.Foreclosure && Elapsed - awakenStarted < 1.5f) slow = 1;
            }
            if (enemy.Definition.IsBoss) slow = Mathf.Min(slow, .3f);
            return 1 - Mathf.Clamp01(slow);
        }
        private void KitSlowEnemy(UnitState enemy, float amount, float seconds)
        {
            if (enemy == null || !enemy.Alive || amount <= 0) return;
            if (enemy.KitSlowUntil <= Elapsed || amount >= enemy.KitSlow) enemy.KitSlow = amount;
            enemy.KitSlowUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.KitSlowUntil, Elapsed + seconds);
        }

        private float KitHostileShotScale => 1 - KitValue(KitPassive.EnemyShotSlow);
        /// <summary>BULL MARKET: coins count double while it runs.</summary>
        private int KitCoinScale => HeroAwakening && Kit.Action == KitAction.BullMarket ? 2 : 1;
        /// <summary>Extra gold in the first chest of each wave.</summary>
        private int KitChestBonus()
        {
            if (kitChestsPaid > 0 || !KitHas(KitPassive.ChestBonusGold)) return 0;
            kitChestsPaid++; return Mathf.RoundToInt(KitValue(KitPassive.ChestBonusGold));
        }
        /// <summary>The hero's own move speed under its kit.</summary>
        private float KitHeroSpeed()
        {
            HeroKit k = Kit; if (k == null) return 1;
            float bonus = HeroAwakening ? k.HeroMoveSpeed : 0;
            if (k.Has(KitPassive.SprintSpeed) && identityRun >= 2) bonus += k.Value(KitPassive.SprintSpeed);
            if (k.Has(KitPassive.DiceFaceBuff) && identityFace == 4) bonus += .1f;
            return 1 + bonus;
        }
        private float identityRun;
        private void KitDropCoin(Vector2 at, int value = 1) { if (value > 0) DropLoot(LootKind.Coin, at, value); }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot
    {
        /// <summary>Hero kit bookkeeping (18/10/2026): purchases in the current shop (for first/second purchase discounts) and
        /// merges made in this run (for kits that grow with merging).</summary>
        public int KitPurchasesThisShop, KitMerges, KitRareBuys;
        /// <summary>Merges made while Clockwork Heart is owned (each winds the team's attack speed).</summary>
        public int HeartWinds;
    }

    public sealed partial class ShopOffer
    {
        /// <summary>The offer's price before hero-kit discounts (0 on offers saved before kits: the price is the base).</summary>
        public int BasePrice;
    }

    /// <summary>The run side of the hero kits: team stats folded into the run's bonuses, the shop, rerolls, interest and income,
    /// eggs, recruiting, merging and bonds. Every effect reads the hero's kit (HeroKits) and does nothing for other heroes.</summary>
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public HeroKit Kit => HeroKits.For(State?.ChampionId);
        private float KitValue(KitPassive kind) => Kit?.Value(kind) ?? 0;
        private bool KitHas(KitPassive kind) => Kit != null && Kit.Has(kind);
        private bool kitRarerRoll;

        /// <summary>Static team passives as run bonuses (they then show in stats and descriptions like any relic).</summary>
        private float KitBonus(ItemEffect effect, ModifierScope target)
        {
            HeroKit kit = Kit; if (kit == null) return 0;
            bool companions = target == ModifierScope.Companions, run = target == ModifierScope.Run;
            switch (effect)
            {
                case ItemEffect.CompanionDamage: return companions ? kit.Value(KitPassive.TeamDamage) + Mathf.Min(.25f, State.KitRareBuys * kit.Value(KitPassive.RareBuyDamage)) : 0;
                case ItemEffect.CompanionAttackSpeed: return companions ? kit.Value(KitPassive.TeamAttackSpeed) + (kit.Has(KitPassive.ThemeBondAttackSpeed) ? Mathf.Min(.16f, KitThemeBondLevels("clock", "orchard") * kit.Value(KitPassive.ThemeBondAttackSpeed)) : 0) : 0;
                case ItemEffect.Health: return target == ModifierScope.Champion ? Mathf.Min(40, State.OctoberFood * kit.Value(KitPassive.FoodHealth)) : 0; // Sundae Duchess: food fills the gown
                case ItemEffect.Crit: return companions ? kit.Value(KitPassive.TeamCrit) : 0;
                case ItemEffect.MoveSpeed: return companions ? kit.Value(KitPassive.TeamMoveSpeed) : 0;
                case ItemEffect.BulletSpeed: return companions ? kit.Value(KitPassive.TeamProjectileSpeed) : 0;
                case ItemEffect.BulletPierce: return companions ? kit.Value(KitPassive.TeamPierce) : 0;
                case ItemEffect.AttackRange: return companions ? kit.Value(KitPassive.TeamRange) : 0;
                case ItemEffect.Pickup: return run ? kit.Value(KitPassive.PickupRadius) : 0;
                case ItemEffect.Interest: return run ? kit.Value(KitPassive.InterestCap) : 0;
                case ItemEffect.Income: return run ? kit.Value(KitPassive.Income) + (kit.Has(KitPassive.DrinkIncome) ? Mathf.Min(kit.Value(KitPassive.DrinkIncome), State.OctoberDrinks) : 0) : 0;
                default: return 0;
            }
        }
        /// <summary>How much more a relic gives for this hero: a second copy is worth 50% more (PetalCitadel), food on the
        /// hero works better (NightMaw, SupperMortar).</summary>
        private float KitItemScale(ItemDefinition item, int count, ModifierScope target)
        {
            float scale = 1;
            if (count >= 2 && KitHas(KitPassive.DuplicateRelicBonus)) scale *= 1 + KitValue(KitPassive.DuplicateRelicBonus) * (count - 1) / count;
            if (item.Category == RelicCategory.Food && target == ModifierScope.Champion) scale *= 1 + KitValue(KitPassive.FoodPotency);
            return scale;
        }
        /// <summary>Kit adjustments made while a unit is compiled for battle.</summary>
        private void KitCompileUnit(UnitDefinition unit, UnitDefinition source, bool companion)
        {
            HeroKit kit = Kit; if (kit == null) return;
            if (!companion && kit.Has(KitPassive.MergeHeroDamage)) unit.Weapon.Damage *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.25f, State.KitMerges * kit.Value(KitPassive.MergeHeroDamage));
            if (companion && unit.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee && kit.Has(KitPassive.TeamMeleeAttackSpeed)) unit.Weapon.Cooldown /= 1 + kit.Value(KitPassive.TeamMeleeAttackSpeed);
            if (companion && (source.Id == "GrandSprout" || source.Id == "LittleSprout")) unit.Weapon.Damage *= 1 + kit.Value(KitPassive.SproutDamage);
            if (companion && unit.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile && kit.Has(KitPassive.RangedTeamRange)) unit.Weapon.Range *= 1 + kit.Value(KitPassive.RangedTeamRange); // Kite Admiral
        }
        /// <summary>Active levels of the named bonds (Bonsai Clocksmith: Clock and Orchard).</summary>
        private int KitThemeBondLevels(params string[] ids)
        {
            int levels = 0;
            foreach (string id in ids)
            {
                BondDefinition bond = Array.Find(catalog.Bonds, b => b.Id == id);
                if (bond != null && BondCounts.TryGetValue(id, out int count)) levels += bond.ActiveLevel(count);
            }
            return levels;
        }

        /// <summary>Recruiting: one more new species a wave (VelvetRegent).</summary>
        private int KitNewRecruits => Mathf.RoundToInt(KitValue(KitPassive.NewRecruitPlusOne));
        /// <summary>More offers on the shelf.</summary>
        private int KitExtraSlots => Mathf.RoundToInt(KitValue(KitPassive.ExtraShopSlot));

        /// <summary>The reroll price for this hero: the first in a shop is free, a full purse makes it cheaper.</summary>
        private int KitRerollCost(int cost)
        {
            if (KitHas(KitPassive.FreeFirstReroll) && State.RerollsThisShop == 0) return 0;
            if (KitHas(KitPassive.RerollCheaperWithGold) && State.Gold >= 50) cost = Mathf.Max(1, cost - Mathf.RoundToInt(KitValue(KitPassive.RerollCheaperWithGold)));
            return cost;
        }
        /// <summary>After a paid reroll: a 1 in 6 refund, or a 1 in 6 rarer roll (GlassDice).</summary>
        private bool KitRerollLuck(int paid)
        {
            if (!KitHas(KitPassive.RerollLuck)) return false;
            int face = Next(ref State.ShopRandom, 6);
            if (face == 0 && paid > 0) { State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + paid); Notice = "The dice rolled a one: this reroll was free."; }
            if (face == 5) { kitRarerRoll = true; return true; }
            return false;
        }
        private float KitRarityBonus => kitRarerRoll ? 2f : 0f;

        /// <summary>Hero-kit prices: discounts on the first or later purchases, drinks and food, the royal pick and the cheapest
        /// offer. Applied after every roll and every purchase, from each offer's base price.</summary>
        private void ApplyKitPrices()
        {
            HeroKit kit = Kit; if (kit == null) return;
            ShopOffer rarest = null, cheapest = null;
            foreach (ShopOffer offer in State.Offers)
            {
                if (offer.Sold || offer.Currency != ShopCurrency.Gold) continue;
                if (offer.BasePrice <= 0) offer.BasePrice = offer.Price;
                if (offer.Kind == OfferKind.Item && (rarest == null || catalog.Item(offer.Id).Rarity > catalog.Item(rarest.Id).Rarity)) rarest = offer;
                if (cheapest == null || offer.BasePrice < cheapest.BasePrice) cheapest = offer;
            }
            foreach (ShopOffer offer in State.Offers)
            {
                if (offer.Sold || offer.Currency != ShopCurrency.Gold || offer.BasePrice <= 0) continue;
                float off = 0;
                if (State.KitPurchasesThisShop == 0) off += kit.Value(KitPassive.FirstPurchaseDiscount);
                else off += kit.Value(KitPassive.SecondPurchaseDiscount);
                if (offer.Kind == OfferKind.Item)
                {
                    RelicCategory category = catalog.Item(offer.Id).Category;
                    if (category == RelicCategory.Drink) off += kit.Value(KitPassive.DrinkDiscount);
                    if (category == RelicCategory.Food) off += kit.Value(KitPassive.FoodDiscount);
                }
                if (offer == rarest) off += kit.Value(KitPassive.RoyalPick);
                int price = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.CeilToInt(offer.BasePrice * (1 - Mathf.Clamp(off, 0, .6f))));
                if (offer == cheapest && kit.Has(KitPassive.CheapestDiscountWithGold) && State.Gold >= 20) price = Mathf.Max(1, price - 1);
                if (State.RerollsThisShop > 0 && MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.HagglersAbacus) > 0) price = Mathf.Max(Mathf.CeilToInt(offer.BasePrice * .7f), price - State.RerollsThisShop);
                offer.Price = price;
            }
        }
        /// <summary>A purchase was made: count it and re-price the rest of the shelf.</summary>
        private void KitBought(ShopOffer offer)
        {
            if (offer == null) return;
            if (offer.Currency == ShopCurrency.Gold && State.Offers.Contains(offer)) State.KitPurchasesThisShop++;
            ItemRarity rarity = offer.Kind == OfferKind.Companion ? catalog.Unit(offer.Id)?.Rarity ?? ItemRarity.Common : catalog.Item(offer.Id)?.Rarity ?? ItemRarity.Common;
            if (rarity == ItemRarity.Mythic || rarity == ItemRarity.Rainbow) State.KitRareBuys++;
            if (offer.Kind != OfferKind.Companion && KitHas(KitPassive.DuplicateRelicGold) && (State.Items.Find(s => s.Id == offer.Id)?.Count ?? 0) >= 2)
            { State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + Mathf.RoundToInt(KitValue(KitPassive.DuplicateRelicGold))); Notice = "Twin petals: 3 gold back."; }
            ApplyKitPrices();
        }
        /// <summary>A recruit arriving: the greenhouse may raise a one-star to two (VerdantMatron).</summary>
        private void KitRecruited(RosterEntry recruited, bool alreadyOwned, List<WeaponDefinition> weapons)
        {
            HeroKit kit = Kit; if (kit == null) return;
            if (recruited.Tier == 1 && kit.Has(KitPassive.BuyTwoStarChance) && Next(ref State.WeaponRandom, 1000) < kit.Value(KitPassive.BuyTwoStarChance) * 1000) recruited.Tier = 2;
            // Juggling Jester: a Big Top friend may join the act at two stars
            if (recruited.Tier == 1 && kit.Has(KitPassive.BigTopTwoStar) && Array.IndexOf(catalog.Unit(recruited.UnitId)?.Tags ?? Array.Empty<string>(), "big-top") >= 0
                && Next(ref State.WeaponRandom, 1000) < kit.Value(KitPassive.BigTopTwoStar) * 1000) { recruited.Tier = 2; Notice = "Big Top: it arrives at two stars."; }
            if (alreadyOwned && kit.Has(KitPassive.DuplicateCopyChance) && Next(ref State.WeaponRandom, 1000) < kit.Value(KitPassive.DuplicateCopyChance) * 1000)
            {
                var spare = weapons.FindAll(w => w.Id != recruited.WeaponId && !State.Roster.Exists(e => e.UnitId == recruited.UnitId && e.WeaponId == w.Id));
                if (spare.Count > 0) { State.Roster.Add(new RosterEntry { UnitId = recruited.UnitId, Tier = recruited.Tier, WeaponId = spare[Next(ref State.WeaponRandom, spare.Count)].Id }); Notice = "Reflection: a second copy came with it."; }
            }
        }
        /// <summary>A merge happened.</summary>
        private void KitMerged()
        {
            State.KitMerges++;
            if (MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.ClockworkHeart) > 0) State.HeartWinds++;
            int gold = Mathf.RoundToInt(KitValue(KitPassive.MergeGold));
            if (gold > 0) State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + gold);
        }
        private void KitAbsorbed()
        {
            int gold = Mathf.RoundToInt(KitValue(KitPassive.AbsorbGold));
            if (gold > 0) State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + gold);
        }
        /// <summary>The purse interest is reckoned on (ThornTreasurer reckons it on 150%).</summary>
        private int KitInterestBase(int gold) => Mathf.FloorToInt(gold * (1 + KitValue(KitPassive.InterestOnGold)));
        /// <summary>Wave-end kit income: dividends, boss bounties, the end-of-wave die, dream eggs. Returns the gold added.</summary>
        private int KitWaveEnd(bool bossDefeated)
        {
            HeroKit kit = Kit; if (kit == null) return 0;
            int gold = 0;
            if (kit.Has(KitPassive.Dividends)) gold += Mathf.Min(Mathf.RoundToInt(kit.Value(KitPassive.Dividends)), State.Items.Count);
            if (bossDefeated) gold += Mathf.RoundToInt(kit.Value(KitPassive.BossGold));
            if (kit.Has(KitPassive.WaveEndDice) && Next(ref State.ShopRandom, 6) == 5) { gold += Mathf.RoundToInt(kit.Value(KitPassive.WaveEndDice)); Notice = "The end-of-wave die shows a six: +" + Mathf.RoundToInt(kit.Value(KitPassive.WaveEndDice)) + " gold."; }
            int every = Mathf.RoundToInt(kit.Value(KitPassive.EggEveryWaves));
            if (every > 0 && State.Wave % every == 0) State.Eggs = BoundedCounter((long)State.Eggs + 1);
            return gold;
        }
        /// <summary>Bond counting extras: the largest bond, friends in two bonds, the lead friend, named bonds.</summary>
        private readonly Dictionary<string, int> kitBondAdded = new Dictionary<string, int>();
        /// <summary>Members the hero's kit added to each bond on top of the bodies counted (checks and tools).</summary>
        public int KitBondExtra(string bond) => kitBondAdded.TryGetValue(bond, out int n) ? n : 0;
        public static readonly string[] ThemeBonds = { "hearth", "archive", "clock", "frost", "orchard", "astral", "tidal", "oddity" };
        private void KitBonds()
        {
            kitBondAdded.Clear();
            HeroKit kit = Kit; if (kit == null) return;
            void Add(string id, int amount)
            {
                if (amount <= 0 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)) return;
                BondCounts[id] = (BondCounts.TryGetValue(id, out int c) ? c : 0) + amount;
                kitBondAdded[id] = (kitBondAdded.TryGetValue(id, out int a) ? a : 0) + amount;
            }
            if (kit.Has(KitPassive.BondDualPlusOne))
            {
                var bonds = new HashSet<string>();
                foreach (RosterEntry entry in State.Roster)
                {
                    if (Stranger(entry.UnitId)) continue;
                    var tags = catalog.Unit(entry.UnitId).Tags;
                    if (tags != null && tags.Length >= 2) foreach (string tag in tags) bonds.Add(tag);
                }
                foreach (string id in bonds) Add(id, 1);
            }
            if (kit.Has(KitPassive.BondLeadDouble) && State.HeroIdentity != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(State.HeroIdentity.LeadUnit) && State.Roster.Exists(e => e.UnitId == State.HeroIdentity.LeadUnit))
                foreach (string tag in catalog.Unit(State.HeroIdentity.LeadUnit).Tags ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add(tag, 1);
            if (kit.Has(KitPassive.SignatureBondLevel))
            {
                // the hero's signature minor bond (its RecruitTheme that names a minor bond) counts one level higher
                string signature = Array.Find(catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).RecruitThemes ?? Array.Empty<string>(), t => !t.StartsWith("fam-") && Array.IndexOf(ThemeBonds, t) < 0);
                BondDefinition bond = signature == null ? null : Array.Find(catalog.Bonds, b => b.Id == signature);
                if (bond != null && BondCounts.TryGetValue(signature, out int members) && members > 0) Add(signature, Mathf.Max(1, bond.Threshold));
            }
            if (kit.Has(KitPassive.BondPlusOneSprout) && BondCounts.ContainsKey("sprout")) Add("sprout", 1);
            if (kit.Has(KitPassive.BondPlusOneRegal) && BondCounts.ContainsKey("regal")) Add("regal", 1);
            if (kit.Has(KitPassive.BondBiggestPlusOne))
            {
                string biggest = null; int most = 0;
                foreach (var pair in BondCounts) if (pair.Value > most || pair.Value == most && string.CompareOrdinal(pair.Key, biggest) < 0) { most = pair.Value; biggest = pair.Key; }
                if (biggest != null && most > 0) Add(biggest, 1);
            }
        }
        /// <summary>Active bond levels (for TinVirtuoso's harmony).</summary>
        public int KitBondLevels()
        {
            int levels = 0;
            foreach (BondDefinition bond in catalog.Bonds) if (BondCounts.TryGetValue(bond.Id, out int count)) levels += bond.ActiveLevel(count);
            return levels;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class JourneyBalance
    {
        public static float Ramp(int wave) => Mathf.Lerp(.4f, 1, Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, Mathf.Clamp01((wave - 1) / 7f)));

        // Balance pass round 2 (19/10/2026, Docs/Balance_Pass_2026-10-19.md): the six difficulties as a table of factors reached at
        // full ramp (wave 8+), eased in from wave 1 like before. Target bot win rate ~90/80/65/50/40/30%. The old curves (HP up to
        // x2.975, damage x1.95, density x1.6 over Peaceful) barely moved the bot's win rate: hero strength dominated and the extra
        // density paid for itself in coins. Peaceful is now gentler than the old base; density grows less (more enemies = more gold).
        // Iteration 2 table was health .8/1.05/1.35/1.75/2.25/2.9 and damage .6/.85/1.15/1.5/1.95/2.5.
        // Indexes: Peaceful, Wandering, Restless, Nightmare, Sleepless, Beyond the Lamp.
        // round 5: Restless only (78% bot wins vs ~65% target): health 1.3 -> 1.4, damage 1.15 -> 1.3
        public static readonly float[] HealthFactor = { .7f, 1f, 1.4f, 1.75f, 2.3f, 2.95f };
        public static readonly float[] DamageFactor = { .45f, .8f, 1.3f, 1.6f, 2.2f, 3f };
        public static readonly float[] DensityFactor = { 1f, 1.05f, 1.1f, 1.15f, 1.2f, 1.25f };
        private static float Level(float[] table, int difficulty) => table[Mathf.Clamp(difficulty, 0, table.Length - 1)];

        public static float EnemyHealth(int difficulty, int wave) => 1 + (Level(HealthFactor, difficulty) - 1) * Ramp(wave);
        public static float EnemyDamage(int difficulty, int wave) => .62f * (1 + (Level(DamageFactor, difficulty) - 1) * Ramp(wave));
        public static float EnemyDensity(int difficulty, int wave) => 1 + (Level(DensityFactor, difficulty) - 1) * Ramp(wave);
        public static float LoneJellyDamage(int wave) => 1.2f + .3f * OctoberBalance.Late(wave);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class K11HeroRules
    {
        public static bool Eligible(UnitDefinition champion, UnitDefinition companion)
        {
            if (companion.GiftOnly) return false;
            if (champion.HeroMechanic == HeroMechanic.SoloMaw && champion.ReferenceHero != "Capped Gallant") return false;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(companion.ExclusiveHero)) return companion.ExclusiveHero == champion.ReferenceHero;
            // every hero, the host included, recruits only from its own themes: its fixed pool (Docs/Content_Expansion_Pools.md)
            // rival-bond rule (content expansion v5): on a shared theme pair the partner's signature friends (Common to Rare) stay out
            if (companion.Rarity <= ItemRarity.Rare && companion.Tags.Length > 1 && Array.IndexOf(champion.RecruitThemes, "rival-" + companion.Tags[1]) >= 0) return false;
            foreach (string theme in champion.RecruitThemes)
                if (Array.IndexOf(companion.Tags, theme) >= 0) return true;
            return false;
        }
        /// <summary>The hero's fixed bond pool (Docs/Content_Expansion_Pools.md): its theme bonds, then every minor bond that
        /// enough of the hero's own companions (painted ones) share to be activated.</summary>
        public static List<BondDefinition> PoolBonds(RunCatalog catalog, UnitDefinition champion)
        {
            var counts = new Dictionary<string, int>();
            foreach (UnitDefinition ally in catalog.Companions)
                if (ally.Body != null && Eligible(champion, ally))
                    foreach (string tag in ally.Tags) counts[tag] = counts.TryGetValue(tag, out int n) ? n + 1 : 1;
            var pool = new List<BondDefinition>();
            foreach (BondDefinition bond in catalog.Bonds) if (Array.IndexOf(champion.RecruitThemes, bond.Id) >= 0) pool.Add(bond);
            foreach (BondDefinition bond in catalog.Bonds)
                if (Array.IndexOf(champion.RecruitThemes, bond.Id) < 0 && counts.TryGetValue(bond.Id, out int n) && n >= bond.Threshold) pool.Add(bond);
            return pool;
        }
        public static RosterEntry Starter(RunCatalog catalog, UnitDefinition champion)
        {
            // each hero's own starting friend and its complementing weapon (HeroLoadout); the older themed pick below is the fallback
            if (HeroLoadout.Heroes.TryGetValue(champion.Id, out HeroLoadout.Entry plan) && catalog.Unit(plan.Friend) is UnitDefinition friend
                && catalog.Weapon(plan.FriendWeapon) != null && Eligible(champion, friend) && Array.IndexOf(ActOneCanon.StoryIds, friend.Id) < 0)
                return new RosterEntry { UnitId = plan.Friend, WeaponId = plan.FriendWeapon };
            string unit = champion.Id == "LanternKnight" ? "TeapotPilgrim" : champion.Id == "Postmaster" ? "BrassAcorn" : "HoodWisp";
            string weapon = champion.Id == "LanternKnight" ? "SpoonSabre" : champion.Id == "Postmaster" ? "InkPistol" : "SnowGlobeOrb";
            if (champion.HeroMechanic >= HeroMechanic.RootedOracle || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(champion.ReferenceHero) && champion.Id != "LanternKnight" && champion.Id != "Postmaster" && champion.Id != "DrowsySeer")
            {
                UnitDefinition candidate = Array.Find(catalog.Companions, ally => !ally.SpecialRecruit && Eligible(champion, ally));
                if (candidate == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("No themed starter: " + champion.Id);
                unit = candidate.Id; weapon = champion.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee ? "SpoonSabre" : "InkPistol";
            }
            if (Array.IndexOf(ActOneCanon.StoryIds, unit) >= 0)
            {
                // Hob, Latch, Postscript and Tally travel as themselves; a second body of their kind in the brigade reads as a broken merge
                UnitDefinition candidate = Array.Find(catalog.Companions, ally => !ally.SpecialRecruit && Array.IndexOf(ActOneCanon.StoryIds, ally.Id) < 0 && Eligible(champion, ally));
                if (candidate != null) unit = candidate.Id;
            }
            if (catalog.Unit(unit) == null || catalog.Weapon(weapon) == null || !Eligible(champion, catalog.Unit(unit))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid themed starting brigade: " + champion.Id);
            return new RosterEntry { UnitId = unit, WeaponId = weapon };
        }
        public static string Describe(UnitDefinition champion) => Describe(champion.HeroMechanic);
        public static string Describe(HeroMechanic mechanic)
        {
            return mechanic switch
            {
                HeroMechanic.LanternStride => "LANTERN STRIDE: travel 12 units to charge a melee pulse within 2.4 units; deals 65% weapon damage, minimum 4-second cooldown. Holds one pulse until an enemy is nearby. No charge in shops or while paused.",
                HeroMechanic.ParcelExpress => "PARCEL EXPRESS: collect 6 gold to charge an automatic parcel volley; deals 70% weapon damage, minimum 4-second cooldown. Passive gold and income do not count.",
                HeroMechanic.DreamBreath => "DREAM BREATH: stand still for 2 seconds to chill enemies within 3 units and remove up to 3 nearby hostile bullets; 7-second cooldown. Waits for nearby danger. Moving interrupts charge; grants no invulnerability.",
                HeroMechanic.RootedOracle => "Stationary in combat. Whole-arena pickup and a slowing ward. Walks in shops.",
                HeroMechanic.SoloMaw => "Travels without roster companions; absorbs purchased companions' traits. Strong attacks and natural recovery support relic-focused builds.",
                HeroMechanic.GlassGambler => "Collect 6 gold to burst nearby enemies. High luck and critical chance; low health.",
                HeroMechanic.TideCollector => "Collect 8 gold to heal 3 health and push nearby enemies back.",
                HeroMechanic.ClockRunner => "Travel 10 units to release a slowing pulse. Moving charges it; shops do not.",
                HeroMechanic.MirrorGuard => "Stand still for 2 seconds to reflect up to 3 nearby bullets. Moving resets charge.",
                HeroMechanic.TreasureTax => "Every 10 collected gold grants 1 extra gold and a small healing pulse.",
                _ => ""
            };
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum SpectacleKind { PaperParade, GildedTrap, WanderingEclipse }
    public sealed class MidwaveSpectacle
    {
        public SpectacleKind Kind;
        public Vector2 Origin;
        public Vector2 Position;
        public float Started;
        public float NextReward;
        public float NextThreat;
        public bool Claimed;
        public bool Dangerous;
        public int RewardDrops;
        public const float Duration = 10;
        public float Age(float time) => Mathf.Max(0, time - Started);
        public bool Active(float time) => time >= Started && time < Started + Duration;
        public static bool Eligible(int wave, bool boss) => wave >= 5 && wave % 2 == 1 && !boss;
        public static SpectacleKind Select(int wave, int seed) => (SpectacleKind)((wave / 2 + (seed % 3 + 3) % 3) % 3);
        /// <summary>Where the show waits during its first two seconds, relative to its origin (the parade lines up six units
        /// left of it; the others start on it). Afterwards the parade and the eclipse move through the arena like any unit.</summary>
        public static Vector2 RestOffset(SpectacleKind kind) => kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade ? Vector2.left * 6 : Vector2.zero;
        /// <summary>What the waiting show covers around its rest point: the three couriers in a row, the trap with its bait,
        /// the eclipse's disc.</summary>
        public static Rect Sweep(SpectacleKind kind) => kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade ? Rect.MinMaxRect(-3.35f, -0.9f, 0.95f, 1.7f)
            : kind == SpectacleKind.GildedTrap ? Rect.MinMaxRect(-1.3f, -0.95f, 1.3f, 1.2f) : Rect.MinMaxRect(-1.4f, -1.4f, 1.4f, 1.4f);
        /// <summary>The origin nearest the wished one whose waiting show stands clear of the arena's props.</summary>
        public static Vector2 ClearOrigin(SpectacleKind kind, Vector2 wish, ArenaLayoutPlan layout, Vector2 arenaSize)
        {
            if (layout == null) return wish;
            Vector2 rest = RestOffset(kind), limit = arenaSize * 0.5f - Vector2.one * 2;
            Vector2 start = Vector2.Max(-limit, Vector2.Min(limit, wish + rest));
            return layout.ClearSpot(start, Sweep(kind), limit, ArenaLayoutPlan.Reach) - rest;
        }
        public bool Contains(Vector2 point)
        {
            Vector2 offset = point - Position;
            if (Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) if ((offset + Vector2.right * index * 1.2f).sqrMagnitude <= 0.75f * 0.75f) return true;
                return false;
            }
            return Kind == SpectacleKind.GildedTrap ? Mathf.Abs(offset.x) <= 1.15f && Mathf.Abs(offset.y) <= 0.8f : offset.sqrMagnitude <= (Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade ? 0.75f * 0.75f : 1.15f * 1.15f);
        }
    }
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        public MidwaveSpectacle Spectacle { get; private set; }
        private bool spectacleCompleted;
        private void ClearSpectacle() { Spectacle = null; spectacleCompleted = false; }
        private void ProcessSpectacle()
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableSpectacles || !MidwaveSpectacle.Eligible(catalog.RunWave, catalog.Boss != null) || spectacleCompleted) return;
            if (Spectacle == null)
            {
                if (Elapsed < catalog.WaveDuration * 0.4f) return;
                float side = (runSeed & 1) == 0 ? -1 : 1;
                Vector2 point = ClampPosition(Champion.Position + new Vector2(side * 3.8f, side * 1.8f), 2);
                SpectacleKind kind = MidwaveSpectacle.Select(catalog.RunWave, runSeed);
                point = MidwaveSpectacle.ClearOrigin(kind, point, ArenaLayout, catalog.ArenaSize); // never waiting on a prop
                Spectacle = new MidwaveSpectacle { Kind = kind, Origin = point, Position = point, Started = Elapsed, NextReward = Elapsed + 2, NextThreat = Elapsed + 2 };
            }
            MidwaveSpectacle show = Spectacle;
            float age = show.Age(Elapsed);
            if (age >= MidwaveSpectacle.Duration) { spectacleCompleted = true; show.Dangerous = false; return; }
            float travel = Mathf.Clamp01((age - 2) / 8);
            if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade) show.Position = ClampPosition(show.Origin + Vector2.right * Mathf.Lerp(-6, 6, travel), 0.8f);
            else if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.WanderingEclipse) show.Position = ClampPosition(show.Origin + new Vector2(Mathf.Lerp(-3, 3, travel), Mathf.Sin(travel * Mathf.PI * 2) * 1.1f), 1.2f);
            show.Dangerous = age >= 2 && (show.Kind != SpectacleKind.GildedTrap || Mathf.Repeat(age - 2, 2.4f) < 0.65f);
            bool inside = show.Contains(Champion.Position);
            if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.GildedTrap && age >= 2 && inside && !show.Claimed)
            {
                show.Claimed = true; DropLoot(LootKind.Chest, show.Position, 10); show.RewardDrops++;
            }
            if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade && Elapsed >= show.NextReward && show.RewardDrops < 12)
            {
                show.NextReward = Elapsed + 0.65f; show.RewardDrops++; DropLoot(LootKind.Coin, show.Position - Vector2.right * 0.9f, 1);
            }
            if (!inside || !show.Dangerous || Elapsed < show.NextThreat || !Champion.Alive) return;
            show.NextThreat = Elapsed + 1;
            ApplyDamage(Champion, Mathf.Min(show.Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade ? 5 : show.Kind == SpectacleKind.GildedTrap ? 4 : 2, Champion.Definition.Health * 0.05f), Faction.Enemy, "Midwave " + show.Kind, cause: NewCause(0).Child("spectacle"));
            if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.WanderingEclipse && show.RewardDrops < 8)
            {
                show.RewardDrops++; DropLoot(LootKind.Coin, show.Position, 2);
            }
        }
    }
}
````
