````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public bool EndingPending => State.Nightmare?.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn;
        public bool EndingChoicePending => EndingPending && State.Nightmare.NarrativeRevision > 0 && State.Nightmare.EndingPage == 0 && State.Nightmare.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.Unchosen;
        public bool ChooseFarewell(NightmareFarewell choice)
        {
            if (!EndingChoicePending || State.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory || choice != NightmareFarewell.CloseShop && choice != NightmareFarewell.LeaveLight) return false;
            State.Nightmare.Farewell = choice;
            return true;
        }
        private void RememberNightmareChoice(SecretEventKind kind, int option, bool resolved)
        {
            State.Nightmare ??= new NightmareProgress();
            State.Nightmare.Choices[(int)kind] = option;
            State.Nightmare.ChoiceMask |= 1 << (int)kind;
            if (resolved) State.Nightmare.ResolvedMask |= 1 << (int)kind;
        }
        private void PrepareNightmare()
        {
            State.Nightmare ??= new NightmareProgress();
            State.Nightmare.Depth = NightmareRules.Depth(State.Wave);
            NightmareAssets assets = NightmareAssets.Current;
            if (assets == null || assets.Customer == null || !NightmareRules.FinalHall(State,catalog)) return;
            State.Nightmare.NarrativeRevision = 1;
            State.Nightmare.Ending = NightmareEndingStage.Customer;
            CombatCatalog.Boss = BuildEnemy(assets.Customer,1 + State.Difficulty * .2f);
            CombatCatalog.Boss.Health = assets.Customer.Health * .8f * (1 + State.Difficulty * .2f) * WaveCadence.StoryBossBulk(20);
            CombatCatalog.EnemyBudget = 0;
            CombatCatalog.BossSwarmBudget = 42; // the waiting keep coming through the whole duel
            CombatCatalog.FinalDuel = true;     // and stand up in walls at 70% and 35%
            CombatCatalog.EnableArenaToys = CombatCatalog.EnableSpectacles = CombatCatalog.EnableBossArenaPhase = false;
            CombatCatalog.ExpandedContent = true;
            CombatCatalog.ArenaSize = new Vector2(28,20);
            CombatCatalog.WaveDuration = 0;
        }
        private void ValidateNightmare(RunSnapshot snapshot)
        {
            MienChoStory.Validate(snapshot);
            NightmareProgress progress = snapshot?.Nightmare;
            if (progress == null) return;
            int finalPage = progress.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.LeaveLight ? 5 : 4;
            if (progress.NarrativeRevision < 0 || progress.NarrativeRevision > 1 || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(NightmareFarewell), progress.Farewell) || progress.NarrativeRevision == 0 && progress.Farewell != NightmareFarewell.Unchosen) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid farewell revision");
            if (progress.Farewell != NightmareFarewell.Unchosen && (!progress.CustomerDefeated || snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory && !snapshot.Endless)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Farewell requires actual victory");
            if (progress.NarrativeRevision > 0 && progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn && progress.EndingPage > 0 && progress.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.Unchosen) throw new InvalidOperationException("Farewell must be chosen before dawn pages");
            if (progress.NarrativeRevision > 0 && progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Complete && progress.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.Unchosen || progress.Farewell != NightmareFarewell.Unchosen && progress.Ending != NightmareEndingStage.Dawn && progress.Ending != NightmareEndingStage.Complete) throw new InvalidOperationException("Inconsistent farewell stage");
            if (progress.Depth < 0 || progress.Depth > 4 || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(NightmareEndingStage),progress.Ending) || progress.EndingPage < 0 || progress.EndingPage > finalPage || progress.LastWhisperWave < 0 || progress.LastWhisperWave > snapshot.Wave || progress.WhisperCursor < 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid nightmare journal");
            if (progress.ChoiceMask < 0 || progress.ChoiceMask > 255 || progress.ResolvedMask < 0 || (progress.ResolvedMask & ~progress.ChoiceMask) != 0 || progress.Choices == null || progress.Choices.Length != 8 || Array.Exists(progress.Choices,choice => choice < -1 || choice > 2)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid nightmare memory");
            for (int index = 0; index < progress.Choices.Length; index++)
                if (((progress.ChoiceMask & (1 << index)) != 0) != (progress.Choices[index] >= 0)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Inconsistent nightmare choice memory");
            if (progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn && progress.EndingPage >= finalPage || progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Complete && progress.EndingPage != finalPage) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid ending page boundary");
            if ((progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn || progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Complete) && !progress.CustomerDefeated) throw new InvalidOperationException("Dawn requires defeating the Last Customer");
            if (progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid ending phase");
        }
        public bool AdvanceEnding()
        {
            if (!EndingPending || State.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory || EndingChoicePending) return false;
            int finalPage = State.Nightmare.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.LeaveLight ? 5 : 4;
            State.Nightmare.EndingPage = Mathf.Min(finalPage,State.Nightmare.EndingPage + 1);
            if (State.Nightmare.EndingPage == finalPage) State.Nightmare.Ending = NightmareEndingStage.Complete;
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class OctoberBalance
    {
        public const int AllySoftLimit = 15;
        public const float WaveSeconds = 45;
        public const float EnemyHealthRelief = .95f; // 18/10/2026: was .75; hero kits made the brigade stronger
        public const float EnemyDamageRelief = .96f; // 18/10/2026: was .8
        public const float BossHealthRelief = .6f;
        public const float BossDamageRelief = .7f; // round 3 (19/10/2026, play-test: boss waves too hard): was .9, -22% on everything a boss deals
        public const float NormalEnemyHealth = 1.1f; // round 3: ordinary (non-boss) enemies +10% health, normal waves felt a little easy
        public static float Crowd(int count) => Mathf.Clamp01((count - 10) / (float)(AllySoftLimit - 10));
        public static float NewAllyChance(int count, int wave = 4)
        {
            float crowd = Mathf.Clamp01((count - 6) / (float)(AllySoftLimit - 6));
            float chance = count < 6 ? .85f : Mathf.Lerp(.55f, .02f, 1 - (1 - crowd) * (1 - crowd));
            return wave <= 3 ? Mathf.Max(.7f, chance) : chance;
        }
        public static float RecruitChance(int count) => Mathf.Lerp(1, .32f, Crowd(count));
        public static float Late(int wave) => Mathf.Clamp01((wave - 8) / 12f);
        public static float Soften(float bonus, float knee, float slope) => bonus > knee ? knee + (bonus - knee) * slope : bonus;
        public static float MaximumHealth(float raw, int wave) => Mathf.Clamp(Soften(raw, 250, Mathf.Lerp(1, .25f, Late(wave))), 1, Mathf.Lerp(2000, 600, Late(wave)));
        public static float FlatDamage(float bonus, int wave) => Soften(bonus, 10, Mathf.Lerp(1, .35f, Late(wave)));
        public static float EndlessHealth(int wave, bool endless) => endless ? Mathf.Pow(1.16f, Mathf.Min(200, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 19))) : 1;
        public static float EndlessDamage(int wave, bool endless) => endless ? Mathf.Pow(1.075f, Mathf.Min(200, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 19))) : 1;
        public static float Push(UnitDefinition target, float requested) => target.IsBoss ? 0 : Mathf.Clamp(requested, 0, .45f) * (1 - Mathf.Clamp01(target.KnockbackResistance));
        public static void CompileAlly(UnitDefinition unit, int wave)
        {
            WeaponDefinition w = unit.Weapon; float late = Late(wave);
            w.Cooldown = Mathf.Max(.28f, w.Cooldown * Mathf.Lerp(1.12f, 1.35f, late));
            w.Windup = Mathf.Min(w.Windup, w.Cooldown * .35f); w.Recovery = Mathf.Min(w.Recovery, w.Cooldown * .4f);
            float before = w.Range;
            w.Range = Mathf.Clamp(w.Range * Mathf.Lerp(1, .86f, late), .4f, w.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee ? 3.4f : 8);
            w.Damage *= Mathf.Lerp(1, .83f, late) * (w.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee ? Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.Sqrt(2.2f / Mathf.Max(2.2f, before)), .68f, 1) : 1);
            w.SignatureRadius = Mathf.Min(w.SignatureRadius, 3.2f); w.PushDistance = Mathf.Clamp(w.PushDistance, 0, .45f);
            w.ProjectileCount = Mathf.Clamp(w.ProjectileCount, 1, 10);
            w.ProjectileLifetime = Mathf.Min(w.ProjectileLifetime, 9 / Mathf.Max(1, w.ProjectileSpeed));
            unit.Speed = Mathf.Min(unit.Speed, 10);
            unit.CollisionDamage = Mathf.Min(unit.CollisionDamage, Mathf.Lerp(200, 80, late));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    /// <summary>Hero offence is worth several ordinary bodies; relic investment can carry a smaller brigade.
    /// Applied to compiled damage, never to weapon assets or saved stacks.
    /// Balance pass round 3 (Docs/Balance_Pass_2026-10-19.md): per-hero power and vitality tuned from 186-campaign sweeps (all 31 heroes
    /// at Wandering and Nightmare, three seeds) toward a 55–80% / 30–60% win band. Vitality scales the hero's base maximum HP
    /// (before items, bonds and corrections); both live here so no asset builder can revert them.</summary>
    public static class PlayerBuildBalance
    {
        // before round 3: LoneJelly 6.5, GlassDice 3.6, RootOracle 3.6, PatchworkHost 4.5, everyone else 3; vitality 1 for all.
        // Round 3 baseline wins (Wandering + Nightmare, 6 runs): 6/6 Postmaster, RootOracle, GlassDice, MirrorKeeper, ChinaMarionette,
        // SoapSkater, ButtonCavalier, HourglassStag; 0/6 LoneJelly, IvorySovereign, ArchiveCurator; 1/6 DrowsySeer, CometRunner, PatchworkHost.
        // Trimming the 6/6 heroes (vitality x0.7, power 2.3) changed none of their results, so those trims were reverted: their
        // strength comes from the brigade they build, not from the hero's own HP or weapon (Docs/Balance_Pass_2026-10-19.md, round 3).
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, float> Power = new Dictionary<string, float>
        {
            ["LoneJelly"] = 6.5f, ["GlassDice"] = 3.6f, ["RootOracle"] = 3.6f, ["PatchworkHost"] = 5f,
            ["ArchiveCurator"] = 4f, ["IvorySovereign"] = 4f, ["DrowsySeer"] = 4f, ["CometRunner"] = 3.6f,
            ["TideSinger"] = 3.8f, ["NightMaw"] = 3.3f, ["PetalCitadel"] = 3.8f, ["StormFencer"] = 3.3f, ["SupperMortar"] = 3.3f,
            // the five expansion heroes (step 4c, 19/10/2026): start in the band of the newest heroes; balance by their mechanics
            ["KiteAdmiral"] = 3.3f, ["SundaeDuchess"] = 3.3f, ["BonsaiClocksmith"] = 3.3f, ["JugglingJester"] = 3.3f, ["BellDiver"] = 3.3f,
        };
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, float> Vitality = new Dictionary<string, float>
        {
            ["LoneJelly"] = 1.5f, ["ArchiveCurator"] = 1.3f,
            ["DrowsySeer"] = 1.5f, ["TideSinger"] = 1.5f, ["CometRunner"] = 1.45f, ["PatchworkHost"] = 1.45f,
            ["NightMaw"] = 1.3f, ["PetalCitadel"] = 1.45f, ["StormFencer"] = 1.3f, ["SupperMortar"] = 1.3f,
            ["VerdantMatron"] = 1.15f, ["CopperCauldron"] = 1.15f, ["MoonProwler"] = 1.15f,
            ["KiteAdmiral"] = 1.3f, ["SundaeDuchess"] = 1.3f, ["BonsaiClocksmith"] = 1.3f, ["JugglingJester"] = 1.3f, ["BellDiver"] = 1.15f,
        };
        /// <summary>Card Queen (Ivory Sovereign) royal health: each injury costs exactly 1. 12 before round 3, 16 in round 3 (still 1/6).</summary>
        public const int CardQueenHealth = 18;
        public static float HeroPower(string hero) => hero != null && Power.TryGetValue(hero, out float value) ? value : 3f;
        public static float HeroVitality(string hero) => hero != null && Vitality.TryGetValue(hero, out float value) ? value : 1f;
        public static float DamageSlope(bool companion) => companion ? .3f : .6f;
        public static float AttackSpeedSlope(bool companion) => companion ? .12f : .3f;
        public static float AttackSpeedCap(bool companion) => companion ? 2.2f : 4f;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public int NewRecruitLimit => 1 + KitNewRecruits;
        public int CompanionLimit => int.MaxValue;
        // Regular shop pacing (owner, 19/10/2026): one NEW species every two waves, and one more body of a species you already
        // have each wave. The dream shop keeps its own rules (one new species per wave, sharing the old wave-10 cadence).
        public const int CopyRecruitLimit = 1;
        public const int CompanionPurchaseLimit = 2; // the most regular companion purchases in one wave: one new + one copy
        public int CopyRecruitsRemaining => Math.Max(0, CopyRecruitLimit - (State.NewRecruitsThisWave - State.NewSpeciesRecruitsThisWave));
        public int CompanionPurchasesRemaining => NewRecruitsRemaining + CopyRecruitsRemaining;
        public bool NewSpeciesCooldown => State.Wave>=10 && State.LastNewShopSpeciesWave>=10 && State.Wave-State.LastNewShopSpeciesWave<2;
        /// <summary>The regular shop's new species rests the wave after one is recruited.</summary>
        public bool RegularNewSpeciesCooldown => State.LastRegularNewSpeciesWave >= 0 && State.LastRegularNewSpeciesWave < State.Wave && State.Wave - State.LastRegularNewSpeciesWave < 2;
        public int NewRecruitsRemaining => RegularNewSpeciesCooldown ? 0 : Math.Max(0, NewRecruitLimit - State.NewSpeciesRecruitsThisWave);
        /// <summary>Whether the regular shop could still sell this species this wave (a copy of one you have, or a new one).</summary>
        public bool RegularRecruitOpen(string id) => OwnsCompanionSpecies(id) ? CopyRecruitsRemaining > 0 : NewRecruitsRemaining > 0;
        public int SpecialNewRecruitsRemaining => NewSpeciesCooldown?0:Math.Max(0,1-State.SpecialNewSpeciesRecruitsThisWave);
        public bool OwnsCompanionSpecies(string id) => State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == id) || (State.AbsorbedSkills?.Contains(id) ?? false);
        // Source shop matters, not currency or the companion's catalog rarity.
        private bool CountsTowardRecruitLimit(ShopOffer offer) => offer != null && offer.Kind == OfferKind.Companion && !State.SpecialOffers.Contains(offer);
        private bool CountsAsNewRegularRecruit(ShopOffer offer) => offer != null && offer.Kind == OfferKind.Companion &&
            !State.SpecialOffers.Contains(offer) && !OwnsCompanionSpecies(offer.Id);
        public bool RecruitQuotaBlocks(ShopOffer offer) => offer!=null && offer.Kind==OfferKind.Companion &&
            (State.SpecialOffers.Contains(offer) ? !OwnsCompanionSpecies(offer.Id) && SpecialNewRecruitsRemaining==0 : !RegularRecruitOpen(offer.Id));
        private void RegisterNewShopSpecies(bool special)
        {
            if(special)State.SpecialNewSpeciesRecruitsThisWave++;else { State.NewSpeciesRecruitsThisWave++; State.LastRegularNewSpeciesWave=State.Wave; }
            if(State.Wave>=10)State.LastNewShopSpeciesWave=State.Wave;
        }
        public bool CompanionCapacityBlocks(ShopOffer offer)
        {
            return false; // Recruitment pacing uses purchase/species quotas, never a body cap.
        }
        public string RecruitmentSummary => "NEW SPECIES: " + (NewRecruitsRemaining > 0 ? NewRecruitsRemaining + " this wave" : "next in wave " + ((long)State.LastRegularNewSpeciesWave + 2))
            + " · one every two waves.\nCOPIES OF YOUR SPECIES: " + CopyRecruitsRemaining + "/" + CopyRecruitLimit + " this wave.\nDREAM SHOP: " + SpecialNewRecruitsRemaining + "/1 new species.";
        public string RecruitQuotaDenialFor(ShopOffer offer)
        {
            if (offer == null) return "";
            if (State.SpecialOffers.Contains(offer)) return NewSpeciesCooldown ? "NEW SPECIES AVAILABLE IN WAVE " + (State.LastNewShopSpeciesWave + 2) : "DREAM SHOP: 1 NEW SPECIES PER WAVE";
            if (OwnsCompanionSpecies(offer.Id)) return "1 COPY PER WAVE · BACK NEXT WAVE";
            return RegularNewSpeciesCooldown ? "NEW SPECIES IN WAVE " + (State.LastRegularNewSpeciesWave + 2) : "1 NEW SPECIES PER TWO WAVES";
        }
    }
}
````

<summary>Assets/ArcaneBrigade/Runtime/Core/RelicCombat.cs · SHA256 95ed3f69c3831e279db8c945a7fd26c7f994a8f96c317ca696c9aa73f5b4febd</summary>

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private float relicPulseAt;
        private float relicSecondAt;
        private float relicEchoAt;
        private int relicProcessedEvents;
        private bool relicMoved;
        private bool relicStanding;
        private int relicLastKills;
        private float relicDamageLoss;
        private bool lotusActive;
        private readonly List<UnitState> phantomWeapons = new List<UnitState>();
        public int RelicCount(RelicMechanic mechanic) => catalog.RelicStacks != null && (int)mechanic < catalog.RelicStacks.Length ? catalog.RelicStacks[(int)mechanic] : 0;

        private void ResetRelics()
        {
            relicQuiltUsed = false; relicQuiltUntil = -1; relicCrownHits = 0; relicApronAt = relicForwardAt = relicCrownAt = 0;
            ResetNewRelics();
            relicPulseAt = 3; relicSecondAt = 1; relicEchoAt = 0; relicMoved = false;
            relicLastKills = relicProcessedEvents = 0; relicDamageLoss = 0; phantomWeapons.Clear();
            lotusActive = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FreshLotus) > 0;
            if (lotusActive) AdjustLotus(1);
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive) > 0) Champion.Definition.Weapon.Cooldown = Mathf.Max(.1f,Champion.Definition.Weapon.Cooldown / 6);
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SixWeapons) == 0) return;
            for (int index = 0; index < 6; index++)
            {
                UnitDefinition template = catalog.RelicWeapons.Length == 6 ? catalog.RelicWeapons[index] : Champion.Definition;
                phantomWeapons.Add(new UnitState { Id = Champion.Id, Faction = Faction.Champion, Definition = template, Alive = true, NextAttack = index * .13f });
            }
        }

        private bool RelicBlocksAttack(UnitState unit)
        {
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return false;
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SixWeapons) > 0) return true;
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Champion && RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CollisionOnly) > 0) return true;
            return unit.Faction == Faction.Companion && RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive) > 0;
        }

        private void AdjustLotus(int direction)
        {
            int count = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FreshLotus);
            foreach (UnitState ally in units)
                if (ally.Faction != Faction.Enemy)
                {
                    ally.Definition.Weapon.ProjectilePierce += direction * 3 * count;
                    ally.Definition.CriticalChance += direction * .3f * count;
                }
        }

        private float RelicAttackDamage(UnitState unit, float damage)
        {
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return damage;
            float flat = !relicMoved ? 16 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StillPower) : 0;
            float hoard = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.HoardPower);
            float purse = 1 + hoard * ((catalog.RelicWallet + (long)Gold) / 5) * .01f;
            float initial = 1 + hoard * (catalog.RelicWallet / 5) * .01f;
            float result = Mathf.Max(0,damage + flat) * Mathf.Max(.05f,1 - relicDamageLoss) * purse / initial;
            result *= RelicAttackScale(unit);
            return RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StatFloor) > 0 ? Mathf.Max(damage,result) : result;
        }

        private void RelicGain(ItemEffect effect, float value, ModifierScope? scope = null)
        {
            if (value == 0) return;
            catalog.RelicGain?.Invoke(new StatModifier { Effect = effect, Value = value, Scope = scope ?? RunModifierRules.DefaultScope(effect) });
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Health) { Champion.Definition.Health += value; Champion.Health = Mathf.Min(Champion.Definition.Health,Champion.Health + Mathf.Max(0,value)); }
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Armor) catalog.Armor += value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Heal) catalog.PassiveHeal += value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Luck) catalog.Luck += value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Crit) foreach (UnitState ally in units) if (ally.Faction != Faction.Enemy) ally.Definition.CriticalChance += value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Damage)
                foreach (UnitState ally in units) if (ally.Faction != Faction.Enemy) ally.Definition.Weapon.Damage *= Mathf.Max(.05f,1 + value);
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Proc,Champion.Position,Faction.Champion,value,cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-growth")));
        }

        private void RelicHit(UnitState target, Faction source, CombatCause cause)
        {
            if (target == Champion)
            {
                RelicApron(cause); RelicSundae();
                if (lotusActive) { AdjustLotus(-1); lotusActive = false; }
                relicDamageLoss += .05f * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FragilePower);
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FragilePower) > 0) catalog.RelicGain?.Invoke(new StatModifier { Effect = ItemEffect.Damage, Scope = ModifierScope.Team, Value = -.05f * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FragilePower) });
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.PanicMagnet) > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .05) foreach (PickupState pickup in pickups) pickup.Attracting = true;
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.RetortVolley) > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .3) RelicVolley(8,12 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.RetortVolley));
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.HurtGrowth) > 0)
                {
                    ItemEffect[] effects = { ItemEffect.Health, ItemEffect.Heal, ItemEffect.Armor, ItemEffect.Damage, ItemEffect.Luck, ItemEffect.Crit };
                    int choice = combatRandom.Next(effects.Length);
                    float[] values = { 4,.08f,.015f,.02f,.02f,.01f };
                    RelicGain(effects[choice],values[choice] * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.HurtGrowth));
                }
            }
            else if (target.Faction == Faction.Enemy && source == Faction.Champion && RelicCount(RelicMechanic.IncomePoison) > 0 && cause.Depth == 0)
            {
                if (target.RelicPoisonUntil <= Elapsed) target.RelicPoisonAt = Elapsed + 1;
                target.RelicPoisonUntil = Elapsed + 4;
            }
        }

        private void RelicPickup(PickupState pickup)
        {
            if (pickup.Kind != LootKind.Coin) return;
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CoinMending) > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .15) Heal(2 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CoinMending),NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-coin-heal"));
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CoinLightning) > 0) RelicStrike(Mathf.Max(4,catalog.Luck * 50) * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CoinLightning),1,"curio-coin-strike");
        }

        private void RelicChest()
        {
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestOnlyRecovery) > 0) Heal(30 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestOnlyRecovery),NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-chest-heal"));
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestLuck) > 0) RelicGain(ItemEffect.Luck,.06f * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestLuck));
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestLightning) > 0) RelicStrike(Mathf.Max(8,catalog.TreasureDetection * 100) * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestLightning),combatRandom.Next(1,4),"curio-chest-strike");
        }

        private void RelicStrike(float damage, int count, string id)
        {
            var enemies = new List<UnitState>();
            foreach (UnitState enemy in units) if (enemy.Alive && enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && enemy.EntranceUntil <= 0) enemies.Add(enemy);
            for (int index = 0; index < count && enemies.Count > 0; index++)
            {
                int choice = combatRandom.Next(enemies.Count); UnitState enemy = enemies[choice]; enemies.RemoveAt(choice);
                CombatCause cause = NewCause(Champion.Id).Child(id);
                ApplyDamage(enemy,damage,Faction.Champion,id,cause:cause);
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.SignaturePulse,enemy.Position,Faction.Champion,damage,cause:cause));
            }
        }

        private void RelicVolley(int count, float damage)
        {
            WeaponDefinition weapon = Champion.Definition.Weapon;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                float angle = index * Mathf.PI * 2 / count; Vector2 direction = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(angle),Mathf.Sin(angle));
                projectiles.Add(new ProjectileState { Id = ++nextId,Faction = Faction.Champion,Position = Champion.Position,PreviousPosition = Champion.Position,Velocity = direction * 5,Damage = damage,Remaining = 2,Color = new Color(.55f,.9f,1),Sprite = catalog.Projectile,VisualWidth = .35f,Radius = .12f,SourceUnitId = Champion.Id,Weapon = weapon,Cause = NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-retort") });
            }
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire,Champion.Position,Faction.Champion,weapon:weapon,cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-retort")));
        }

        private void StepRelics(float deltaTime, Vector2 movement)
        {
            relicProcessedEvents = events.Count;
            relicStanding = movement.sqrMagnitude < .001f;
            if (!relicStanding) relicMoved = true;
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StillRecovery) > 0 && relicStanding) Heal(3 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StillRecovery) * deltaTime,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-still-heal"));
            if (Kills / 10 > relicLastKills && RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive) > 0) Heal((Kills / 10 - relicLastKills) * 3,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-overdrive-heal"));
            relicLastKills = Kills / 10;
            foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                if (enemy.Alive && enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && enemy.RelicPoisonUntil > Elapsed && enemy.RelicPoisonAt <= Elapsed)
                { enemy.RelicPoisonAt = Elapsed + 1; ApplyDamage(enemy,Mathf.Max(1,catalog.RelicIncome) * RelicLateFee,Faction.Champion,"curio-poison",cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-poison")); }
            if (Elapsed >= relicSecondAt)
            {
                relicSecondAt = Elapsed + 1;
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.BleedingAlarm) > 0) ApplyDamage(Champion,RelicCount(RelicMechanic.BleedingAlarm),Faction.Enemy,"Bleeding alarm",cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-cost"),injectedDamage:true);
            }
            if (Elapsed >= relicPulseAt)
            {
                relicPulseAt = Elapsed + 3;
                int gamble = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.GambleRecovery);
                if (gamble > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .5) Heal(20 * gamble,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-gamble"));
                if (gamble > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .5) ApplyDamage(Champion,8 * gamble,Faction.Enemy,"Gamble sandwich",cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-cost"),injectedDamage:true);
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                    if (enemy.Alive && enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && enemy.EntranceUntil <= 0)
                    {
                        float damage = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SorrowPulse) * Champion.Definition.Health * .2f + RelicCount(RelicMechanic.VoidPulse) * enemy.Health * .15f;
                        if (damage > 0) ApplyDamage(enemy,damage,Faction.Champion,"Curio pulse",cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-pulse"));
                    }
            }
            RelicSeals(); RelicBorrowedCrown(); StepNewRelics();
            foreach (UnitState phantom in phantomWeapons)
            {
                if (Elapsed < phantom.NextAttack) continue;
                WeaponDefinition weapon = phantom.Definition.Weapon;
                UnitState target = FindTarget(Champion,Mathf.Max(5,weapon.Range));
                if (target == null) continue;
                phantom.Position = Champion.Position; phantom.AttackDirection = (target.Position - Champion.Position).normalized;
                phantom.NextAttack = Elapsed + Mathf.Max(.2f,weapon.Cooldown);
                if (weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile) EmitProjectile(phantom,RelicAttackDamage(phantom,weapon.Damage),false,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-sixfold"));
                else
                    foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                        if (CanHit(Faction.Champion,enemy) && (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).magnitude <= weapon.Range + enemy.Definition.Radius)
                            ApplyWeaponDamage(enemy,RelicAttackDamage(phantom,weapon.Damage),Faction.Champion,weapon.Element,"Phantom weapon",(enemy.Position - Champion.Position).normalized,weapon,false,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-sixfold"));
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire,Champion.Position,Faction.Champion,direction:phantom.AttackDirection,weapon:weapon,cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-sixfold")));
            }
        }

        private void ProcessRelicEchoes()
        {
            int end = events.Count;
            for (int index = relicProcessedEvents; index < end; index++)
            {
                CombatEvent action = events[index];
                RelicItemEvent(action); RelicNewItemEvent(action);
                if (action.Kind != CombatEventKind.Fire || action.Faction != Faction.Champion || action.Cause.Depth != 0 || Elapsed < relicEchoAt || RelicCount(RelicMechanic.PrismEcho) == 0) continue;
                relicEchoAt = Elapsed + .15f;
                RelicStrike(Mathf.Max(2,catalog.RelicRanged * 2) * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.PrismEcho),1,"curio-prism");
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class RelicLease
    {
        public RelicMechanic Mechanic;
        public int Wave;
        public int Count;
    }

    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public int MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic mechanic)
        {
            int count = 0;
            foreach (ItemStack stack in State.Items)
            {
                if (SecretItemSuspended(stack.Id)) continue;
                ItemDefinition item = catalog.Item(stack.Id);
                if (item.Mechanic == mechanic) count += item.EffectiveStacks(stack.Count);
            }
            return count;
        }

        private float RelicBonus(ItemEffect effect, ModifierScope target, float value)
        {
            foreach (StatModifier gain in State.RelicGains ?? new List<StatModifier>())
                if (gain.Effect == effect && RunModifierRules.Applies(gain.Scope, target)) value += gain.Value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Damage && target != ModifierScope.Run) value += MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.HoardPower) * (State.Gold / 5) * .01f;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Health) value += MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.LuckToHealth) * Mathf.Max(0, Bonus(ItemEffect.Luck)) * 100;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.CollisionDamage && target == ModifierScope.Champion)
                value += MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.MeleeToCollision) * Mathf.Max(0, Bonus(ItemEffect.MeleeDamage, target)) * .5f + MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.CollisionOnly) * Mathf.Max(0, Bonus(ItemEffect.Armor)) * 10;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Armor) value += MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.SlowToArmor) * Mathf.Max(0, -Bonus(ItemEffect.MoveSpeed, ModifierScope.Champion));
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Income) value += MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.DamageToIncome) * Mathf.Floor(Mathf.Max(0, Bonus(ItemEffect.Damage, ModifierScope.Champion)) / .04f);
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Discount && State.RelicDiscountWave == State.Wave) value += .3f;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Discount && State.PromiseDiscountWave == State.Wave) value += .15f; // a promise kept
            if (effect == ItemEffect.AttackSpeed && target != ModifierScope.Run && MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.ClockworkHeart) > 0) value += Mathf.Min(.3f, State.HeartWinds * .03f);
            if (effect == ItemEffect.AttackSpeed && target == ModifierScope.Companions && MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.SlipstreamScarf) > 0)
                value += MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.SlipstreamScarf) * Mathf.Min(.15f, Mathf.Floor(Mathf.Max(0, Bonus(ItemEffect.MoveSpeed, ModifierScope.Champion)) / .05f + .001f) * .01f);
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Crit && target != ModifierScope.Run && MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.SpecimenPin) > 0)
                value += MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.SpecimenPin) * Mathf.Min(.2f, (State.KilledSpecies?.Count ?? 0) * .01f);
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Damage && target != ModifierScope.Run && MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.InvoiceSettles) > 0)
            {
                int relics = 0; foreach (ItemStack s in State.Items) relics += s.Count;
                value += MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.InvoiceSettles) * Mathf.Min(.2f, relics * .02f);
            }
            foreach (RelicLease lease in State.RelicLeases ?? new List<RelicLease>())
            {
                if (lease.Wave != State.Wave) continue;
                if (effect == ItemEffect.EnemyCount && lease.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.CrowdedTape) value += .1f * lease.Count;
                if (effect == ItemEffect.Armor && lease.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.ExposedRecovery) value -= .8f * lease.Count;
                if (effect == ItemEffect.TreasureDetection && lease.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.TreasureLease) value += lease.Count;
            }
            foreach (StatModifier floor in State.RelicFloors ?? new List<StatModifier>())
                if (floor.Effect == effect && floor.Scope == target) value = Mathf.Max(value, floor.Value);
            return value;
        }

        private void GainRelic(ItemEffect effect, float value, ModifierScope? scope = null)
        {
            if (value == 0) return;
            ModifierScope target = scope ?? RunModifierRules.DefaultScope(effect);
            StatModifier existing = State.RelicGains.Find(modifier => modifier.Effect == effect && modifier.Scope == target);
            if (existing == null) State.RelicGains.Add(new StatModifier { Effect = effect, Value = value, Scope = target });
            else existing.Value = Mathf.Clamp(existing.Value + value, -100000, 100000);
        }

        private void BeginRelicWave()
        {
            if (State.Phase != SessionPhase.Combat || State.RelicWave == State.Wave) return;
            State.RelicWave = State.Wave;
            State.RelicLeases.RemoveAll(lease => lease.Wave < State.Wave);
            SpliceFriends();
            int growth = MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.WaveGrowth);
            if (growth > 0) { GainRelic(ItemEffect.MeleeDamage,4 * growth); GainRelic(ItemEffect.RangedDamage,4 * growth); GainRelic(ItemEffect.Damage,.1f * growth); }
            int interest = MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.CompoundInterest);
            if (interest > 0) State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)Math.Min(int.MaxValue, State.Gold * Math.Pow(1.2, interest)));
            int chaos = MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.ChaosIncome);
            if (chaos > 0) State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + new System.Random(unchecked(State.Seed ^ State.Wave * 7919)).Next(25,76) * chaos);
        }

        private void BuyRelic(ItemDefinition item, int purchasedToken)
        {
            if (item.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.SixWeapons && State.RelicWeaponIds.Count == 0)
                for (int index = 0; index < 6; index++) State.RelicWeaponIds.Add(catalog.Weapons[Next(ref State.WeaponRandom,catalog.Weapons.Length)].Id);
            if (item.Category == RelicCategory.Drink)
            {
                GainRelic(ItemEffect.Health, 4 * MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.DrinkVitality));
                GainRelic(ItemEffect.AttackSpeed, .06f * MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.DrinkTempo));
            }
            if (item.Category == RelicCategory.Food)
            {
                int growth = MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.FoodGrowth);
                GainRelic(ItemEffect.Health, 10 * growth); GainRelic(ItemEffect.Heal, .5f * growth); GainRelic(ItemEffect.BodySize, .05f * growth);
            }
            if (item.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.CrowdedTape || item.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.ExposedRecovery || item.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.TreasureLease || item.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive)
                State.RelicLeases.Add(new RelicLease { Mechanic = item.Mechanic, Wave = State.Wave + 1, Count = 1 });
            if (item.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.EggGift) State.Eggs = BoundedCounter((long)State.Eggs + 3);
            if (item.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.TurnDiscount)
            {
                State.RelicDiscountWave = State.Wave;
                foreach (ShopOffer offer in State.Offers) if (offer.Token != purchasedToken && !offer.Sold && offer.Kind == OfferKind.Item && offer.Currency == ShopCurrency.Gold) offer.Price = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.CeilToInt(offer.Price * .7f));
            }
            if (item.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.CompanionGift && catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).HeroMechanic != HeroMechanic.SoloMaw)
                for (int index = 0; index < 2 && CompanionPurchasesRemaining > 0; index++)
                {
                    var available = new List<UnitDefinition>();
                    foreach (UnitDefinition ally in catalog.Companions)
                        if (!ally.SpecialRecruit && RegularRecruitOpen(ally.Id) && ally.UnlockWave <= State.Wave && (catalog.HeroRevision == 0 || K11HeroRules.Eligible(catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId),ally)) && Array.Exists(catalog.Weapons, weapon => RecruitWeaponEligible(ally.Id, weapon) && !State.Roster.Exists(entry => entry.UnitId == ally.Id && entry.WeaponId == weapon.Id))) available.Add(ally);
                    if (available.Count == 0) break;
                    UnitDefinition chosen = available[RecruitChoice(available)];
                    var weapons = new List<WeaponDefinition>();
                    foreach (WeaponDefinition weapon in catalog.Weapons) if (RecruitWeaponEligible(chosen.Id, weapon) && VariantFree(chosen.Id, weapon)) weapons.Add(weapon);
                    var recruit = new RosterEntry { UnitId = chosen.Id, WeaponId = BalancedWeapon(weapons, false).Id };
                    bool newSpecies = !OwnsCompanionSpecies(chosen.Id);
                    State.Roster.Add(recruit); RememberVariant(recruit); State.NewRecruitsThisWave++; if (newSpecies) RegisterNewShopSpecies(false); MergeTriples(chosen.Id);
                }
            if (item.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.StatFloor)
                foreach (ItemEffect effect in Enum.GetValues(typeof(ItemEffect)))
                    foreach (ModifierScope scope in Enum.GetValues(typeof(ModifierScope)))
                    {
                        float value = Bonus(effect, scope);
                        StatModifier floor = State.RelicFloors.Find(candidate => candidate.Effect == effect && candidate.Scope == scope);
                        if (floor == null) State.RelicFloors.Add(new StatModifier { Effect = effect, Scope = scope, Value = value }); else floor.Value = Mathf.Max(floor.Value,value);
                    }
        }

        private void ConfigureRelics()
        {
            CombatCatalog.RelicStacks = new int[Enum.GetValues(typeof(RelicMechanic)).Length];
            foreach (RelicMechanic mechanic in Enum.GetValues(typeof(RelicMechanic))) CombatCatalog.RelicStacks[(int)mechanic] = MechanicStacks(mechanic);
            CombatCatalog.RelicStacks[(int)RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive] = 0;
            foreach (RelicLease lease in State.RelicLeases) if (lease.Wave == State.Wave && lease.Mechanic == RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive) CombatCatalog.RelicStacks[(int)RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive] += lease.Count;
            CombatCatalog.RelicIncome = Mathf.Max(0,catalog.Income + Bonus(ItemEffect.Income));
            CombatCatalog.RelicMelee = Bonus(ItemEffect.MeleeDamage, ModifierScope.Champion);
            CombatCatalog.RelicRanged = Bonus(ItemEffect.RangedDamage, ModifierScope.Champion);
            CombatCatalog.RelicWallet = State.Gold;
            if (MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.SixWeapons) > 0)
            {
                var random = new System.Random(unchecked(State.Seed ^ 6151));
                CombatCatalog.RelicWeapons = new UnitDefinition[6];
                for (int index = 0; index < 6; index++)
                {
                    WeaponDefinition weapon = State.RelicWeaponIds.Count == 6 ? catalog.Weapon(State.RelicWeaponIds[index]) : catalog.Weapons[random.Next(catalog.Weapons.Length)];
                    UnitDefinition vessel = BuildUnit(catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId),weapon,1,false);
                    WeaponDefinition shared = BuildUnit(catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId),weapon,1,true).Weapon;
                    vessel.Weapon.Damage = Mathf.Max(vessel.Weapon.Damage,shared.Damage);
                    vessel.Weapon.ProjectileCount = Mathf.Max(vessel.Weapon.ProjectileCount,shared.ProjectileCount);
                    vessel.Weapon.ProjectilePierce = Mathf.Max(vessel.Weapon.ProjectilePierce,shared.ProjectilePierce);
                    vessel.Weapon.ProjectileSplit = Mathf.Max(vessel.Weapon.ProjectileSplit,shared.ProjectileSplit);
                    vessel.Weapon.ProjectileBounceChance = Mathf.Max(vessel.Weapon.ProjectileBounceChance,shared.ProjectileBounceChance);
                    vessel.Weapon.Range = Mathf.Max(vessel.Weapon.Range,shared.Range);
                    vessel.Weapon.ProjectileLifetime = Mathf.Max(vessel.Weapon.ProjectileLifetime,shared.ProjectileLifetime);
                    vessel.Weapon.Cooldown = Mathf.Min(vessel.Weapon.Cooldown,shared.Cooldown);
                    CombatCatalog.RelicWeapons[index] = vessel;
                }
            }
            CombatCatalog.RelicGain = modifier => GainRelic(modifier.Effect,modifier.Value,modifier.Scope);
            CombatCatalog.FreeFollowers = MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.FreeFollowers) > 0;
            if (CombatCatalog.FreeFollowers) CombatCatalog.CompanionRoamOuterRadius = catalog.WorldSize.magnitude * .5f;
            CombatCatalog.StaticFollowers = MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.StaticFollowers) > 0;
            if (MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.CloseFollowers) > 0) { CombatCatalog.CompanionLeash *= .65f; CombatCatalog.CompanionRoamOuterRadius *= .65f; }
            if (CombatCatalog.StaticFollowers)
                foreach (UnitDefinition ally in CombatCatalog.StartingCompanions) { ally.Speed = 0; ally.Weapon.Range *= 2; ally.Weapon.ProjectileLifetime *= 2; ally.Weapon.ProjectilePierce += 3; }
            if (MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.HalfHealthSeed) > 0 && State.Phase == SessionPhase.Combat) State.Health = Mathf.Min(State.Health,CombatCatalog.Champion.Health * .5f);
            if (MechanicStacks(RelicMechanic.ChestOnlyRecovery) > 0) { CombatCatalog.PassiveHeal = 0; CombatCatalog.HeartHealing = -100000; }
        }

        private void ValidateRelicState(RunSnapshot snapshot)
        {
            if (snapshot == null) return;
            if (snapshot.RelicWave < 0 || snapshot.RelicWave > snapshot.Wave || snapshot.RelicDiscountWave < 0 || snapshot.RelicDiscountWave > snapshot.Wave) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid relic wave journal");
            if (snapshot.RelicWeaponIds != null && (snapshot.RelicWeaponIds.Count != 0 && snapshot.RelicWeaponIds.Count != 6 || snapshot.RelicWeaponIds.Exists(id => catalog.Weapon(id) == null))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid phantom weapon journal");
            foreach (List<StatModifier> modifiers in new[] { snapshot.RelicGains,snapshot.RelicFloors })
            {
                if (modifiers == null) continue;
                if (modifiers.Count > 256) throw new InvalidOperationException("Relic stat journal too large");
                var keys = new HashSet<string>();
                foreach (StatModifier modifier in modifiers)
                    if (modifier == null || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ItemEffect),modifier.Effect) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ModifierScope),modifier.Scope) || !float.IsFinite(modifier.Value) || Mathf.Abs(modifier.Value) > 100000 || !keys.Add(modifier.Effect + "/" + modifier.Scope)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid relic stat journal");
            }
            if (snapshot.RelicLeases == null) return;
            if (snapshot.RelicLeases.Count > 128) throw new InvalidOperationException("Relic lease journal too large");
            foreach (RelicLease lease in snapshot.RelicLeases)
                if (lease == null || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(RelicMechanic),lease.Mechanic) || lease.Wave < 1 || (long)lease.Wave > (long)snapshot.Wave + 1 || lease.Count < 1 || lease.Count > 8) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid relic lease");
        }
    }
}
````
