using System;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        private void ApplySecretUnit(UnitDefinition unit, bool companion)
        {
            if (State.Secrets == null) return;
            WeaponDefinition weapon = unit.Weapon;
            foreach (SecretStitch stitch in Secret.Stitches)
            {
                if (StackCount(stitch.ItemId) == 0) continue;
                if (stitch.Pattern == 0 && weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile)
                {
                    weapon.SecretRecall = true; weapon.ProjectilePierce = 0; weapon.Damage *= 1.15f;
                    weapon.ProjectileLifetime = Mathf.Max(2, weapon.ProjectileLifetime);
                }
                if (stitch.Pattern == 1 && weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee) weapon.Cooldown *= 1.2f;
            }
            if (companion && Secret.AllyGifts.Exists(g => g.UnitId == unit.Id && g.WeaponId == weapon.Id)) weapon.Damage *= 1.2f;
        }
        private void PrepareSecretCombat()
        {
            if (State.Secrets == null || SecretEventAssets.Current == null) return;
            SecretEventAssets assets = SecretEventAssets.Current;
            CombatCatalog.SecretMeleeEcho = Secret.Stitches.Exists(t => t.Pattern == 1 && StackCount(t.ItemId) > 0);
            CombatCatalog.SecretWard = Secret.Stitches.Exists(t => t.Pattern == 2 && StackCount(t.ItemId) > 0);
            CombatCatalog.SecretMirrorEcho = StackCount("SecretMirror") > 0 && !SecretItemSuspended("SecretMirror");
            if (!SecretSolo)
            {
                var allies = CombatCatalog.StartingCompanions.ToList();
                if (Secret.Contracts.Exists(c => c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow))
                {
                    UnitDefinition shadow = BuildUnit(catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId), catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).Weapon, 1, true);
                    shadow.Id = "SecretTemporaryShadow"; shadow.DisplayName = "Borrowed Reflection"; shadow.Tint = new Color(.58f, .8f, 1, .8f);
                    shadow.HeroMechanic = HeroMechanic.None; shadow.Weapon.Damage *= .5f; shadow.Passive = PassiveKind.None; allies.Add(shadow);
                }
                if (Secret.Contracts.Exists(c => c.Kind == SecretContractKind.DreamFriend))
                {
                    UnitDefinition friend = assets.Rescues[2]; allies.Add(BuildUnit(friend, friend.Weapon, 1, true));
                }
                CombatCatalog.StartingCompanions = allies.ToArray();
            }
            if (!SecretFighting) return;
            CombatCatalog.EnableArenaToys = CombatCatalog.EnableSpectacles = CombatCatalog.EnableBossArenaPhase = false;
            CombatCatalog.ArenaSize = new Vector2(22, 12); CombatCatalog.ExtendedLoot = false; CombatCatalog.GoldPerKill = 0;
            CombatCatalog.ChestInterval = 100000; CombatCatalog.EnemyBudget = 0; CombatCatalog.BossSwarmBudget = 0; CombatCatalog.WaveDuration = 0; // no boss-night swarm in a secret fight
            CombatCatalog.EnemyPool = Array.Empty<UnitDefinition>(); CombatCatalog.AffixedEnemies = Array.Empty<UnitDefinition>();
            CombatCatalog.Boss = null;
            int encounter = Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.LostProperty ? 1 : Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.Understudy ? 2 : Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.ContrabandTrain ? 3 : 4 + Secret.Option;
            CombatCatalog.SecretEncounter = encounter;
            if (encounter == 4)
            {
                UnitDefinition paper = catalog.Enemies.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Material == BodyMaterial.Paper && !e.IsBoss) ?? catalog.Enemies[0];
                UnitDefinition enemy = BuildEnemy(paper, 1 + State.Wave * .12f);
                enemy.Health *= .65f; enemy.SpecialEnemy = SpecialEnemyKind.None; enemy.Behavior = EnemyBehavior.Standard;
                CombatCatalog.MeleeEnemy = CombatCatalog.RangedEnemy = enemy; CombatCatalog.EnemyPool = new[] { enemy };
                CombatCatalog.EnemyBudget = 32; CombatCatalog.SpawnInterval = .7f; CombatCatalog.WaveDuration = 28; return;
            }
            UnitDefinition source = encounter == 2 ? CombatCatalog.Champion : assets.Guardian;
            UnitDefinition actor = Clone(source); actor.Weapon = Clone(source.Weapon);
            actor.Id = encounter == 2 ? "SecretUnderstudy" : "SecretCabinetActor";
            actor.DisplayName = encounter == 2 ? "The Understudy" : encounter == 3 ? "The Contraband Collector" : encounter == 5 ? "The Leading Actor" : encounter == 6 ? "The Hostile Duet" : "The Cabinet Warden";
            actor.IsBoss = true; actor.HeroMechanic = HeroMechanic.None; actor.SpecialEnemy = SpecialEnemyKind.None; actor.Mutation = EnemyMutation.None;
            actor.Health = (650 + State.Wave * 140) * .8f * (1 + State.Difficulty * .2f) * (encounter == 5 ? 1.3f : 1);
            actor.BodyHeight = encounter == 2 ? 1.5f : 2.3f; actor.Radius = .65f; actor.Speed = encounter == 2 ? 1.15f : .6f;
            actor.ContactDamage = (5 + State.Wave * .12f)*1.08f*1.6f; actor.ContactInterval = 1.17f; actor.KnockbackResistance = 1;
            actor.Weapon.Damage*=1.08f;
            actor.Tint = encounter == 2 ? new Color(.65f, .8f, 1) : Color.white;
            CombatCatalog.Boss = actor;
            if (encounter == 6)
            {
                UnitDefinition partner = BuildEnemy(catalog.Enemies.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile) ?? catalog.Enemies[0], 1 + State.Wave * .1f);
                partner.Id = "SecretSupportingActor"; partner.DisplayName = "The Supporting Actor";
                partner.Health = actor.Health * .5f; partner.SpecialEnemy = SpecialEnemyKind.None; partner.Mutation = EnemyMutation.None;
                partner.Weapon.Cooldown = 2.8f; partner.Weapon.ProjectileCount = 2; partner.Weapon.Damage = 7;
                CombatCatalog.SecretPartner = partner;

        private bool SettleSecretCombat(CombatSimulation simulation)
        {
            if (!SecretFighting) return false;
            State.Health = Mathf.Min(MaximumHealth(), simulation.Champion.Health); State.CombatSeconds += simulation.Elapsed;
            State.LastDamageSource = simulation.LastDamageSource; State.LastDamageKind = simulation.LastDamageKind; State.LastDamageAmount = simulation.LastDamageAmount;
            ContributionLedger.Merge(State.Contributions, simulation.Contributions);
            if (simulation.Phase == RunPhase.Defeat) { State.Phase = SessionPhase.Defeat; return true; }
            Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Reward; State.Phase = SessionPhase.Shop;
            State.PrismShards = Mathf.Min(99, State.PrismShards + 1); // a secret fight won leaves a prism shard
            Secret.Result = "THE PERFORMANCE IS OVER\nClaim your chosen gift. Your normal shop, stock and wave are waiting unchanged. Health spent in this encounter stays spent.";
            RecordSecret("Won the optional encounter."); return true;
        }
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private float secretChampionAttack = -100, secretMirrorAt;
        private Vector2 secretMirrorDirection;
        private UnitState secretSecondActor;
        private float secretNextEcho;
        private void StartSecretCombat()
        {
            secretChampionAttack = -100; secretMirrorAt = 0; secretNextEcho = 0; secretSecondActor = null;
            if (catalog.SecretPartner != null)
            {
                secretSecondActor = Spawn(catalog.SecretPartner, Faction.Enemy, new Vector2(-3, 2));
                secretSecondActor.NextAttack = 3.5f;
            }
        }
        private bool SecretVictoryReady() => catalog.SecretEncounter == 6 ? BossDefeated && (secretSecondActor == null || !secretSecondActor.Alive) : catalog.Boss == null ? Elapsed >= catalog.WaveDuration : BossDefeated;

        private bool ProcessSecretBoss(UnitState boss)
        {
            if (catalog.SecretEncounter == 0) return false;
            boss.BossPoseTime = Elapsed;
            if (catalog.SecretEncounter == 2)
            {
                if (secretMirrorAt == 0 && Champion.AttackStarted > secretChampionAttack && Champion.AttackStarted > .05f)
                {
                    secretChampionAttack = Champion.AttackStarted; secretMirrorAt = Elapsed + .65f;
                    secretMirrorDirection = -Champion.AttackDirection;
                    boss.TelegraphDirection = secretMirrorDirection; boss.TelegraphUntil = secretMirrorAt; boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed; boss.AttackWindup = .65f;
                    events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
                }
                if (secretMirrorAt > 0 && Elapsed >= secretMirrorAt)
                {
                    secretMirrorAt = 0; boss.TelegraphUntil = 0; boss.AttackDirection = secretMirrorDirection;
                    WeaponDefinition w = boss.Definition.Weapon;
                    if (w.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile)
                        EmitProjectile(boss, Mathf.Min(12, 5 + catalog.RunWave * .25f), false, NewCause(boss.Id));
                    else
                        Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, boss, boss.Position, secretMirrorDirection, Mathf.Clamp(w.Range, 1.8f, 4), 8, 0, .2f, NewCause(boss.Id));
                    boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed; boss.BossOrganReleaseAt = Elapsed;
                    events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
                }
                return true;
            }
            if (boss.TelegraphUntil > 0 && Elapsed >= boss.TelegraphUntil)
            {
                boss.TelegraphUntil = 0; boss.BossOrganReleaseAt = Elapsed;
                if (boss.BossVolley++ % 2 == 0)
                {
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, boss.AbilityTarget, 1.2f, .45f, .3f);
                    if (catalog.SecretEncounter == 5) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, boss.AbilityTarget, 2.8f, .7f, .9f);
                }
                else for (int k = -1; k <= 1; k++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, boss, boss.AbilityTarget + Vector2.right * k * 1.7f, .35f, .35f + (k + 1) * .18f, .3f);
                boss.NextBossPattern = Elapsed + (catalog.SecretEncounter == 6 ? 4.2f : 3.5f); boss.BossRecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 1.1f;
                if (secretSecondActor != null) secretSecondActor.NextAttack = Elapsed + 1.5f;
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
            }
            if (Elapsed >= boss.NextBossPattern && boss.TelegraphUntil == 0)
            {
                boss.AttackWindup = 1.1f; boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed; boss.TelegraphUntil = Elapsed + 1.1f;
                boss.AbilityTarget = Champion.Position; boss.TelegraphDirection = (Champion.Position - boss.Position).normalized;
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
            }
            return true;
        }

        private void ProcessSecretEchoes()
        {
            if (!catalog.SecretMeleeEcho && !catalog.SecretMirrorEcho) return;
            // Snapshot events: secondary attacks never recursively create echoes.
            foreach (CombatEvent e in events.ToArray())
            {
                if (e.Kind != CombatEventKind.Fire || e.Faction == Faction.Enemy || e.Subject == null || e.Subject.Definition.Weapon == null) continue;
                UnitState source = e.Subject; WeaponDefinition w = source.Definition.Weapon;
                if (catalog.SecretMeleeEcho && w.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee)
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, source.AttackDirection, w.Range, w.Damage * .3f, .26f, .18f, NewCause(source.Id).Child("secret-aftershock"));
                if (catalog.SecretMirrorEcho && source.Faction == Faction.Champion && Elapsed >= secretNextEcho)
                {
                    secretNextEcho = Elapsed + 4;
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, source.AttackDirection, Mathf.Clamp(w.Range, 2, 5), w.Damage * .35f, .35f, .18f, NewCause(source.Id).Child("secret-mirror"));
                }
            }
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot { public SecretEventProgress Secrets = new SecretEventProgress(); }

    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public bool SecretRoomOpen => State.Secrets != null && State.Secrets.Stage != SecretEventStage.Idle;
        public bool SecretFighting => State.Secrets?.Stage == SecretEventStage.Fighting;
        private SecretEventProgress Secret => State.Secrets ?? (State.Secrets = new SecretEventProgress());
        private bool SecretSolo => catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).HeroMechanic == HeroMechanic.SoloMaw;
        public bool SecretItemSuspended(string id) => State.Secrets != null && (State.Secrets.Stitches.Exists(t => t.ItemId == id) || State.Secrets.Contracts.Exists(c => c.ItemId == id && (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow || c.Kind == SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel)));
        public bool SecretItemImproved(string id) => State.Secrets != null && State.Secrets.ImprovedItems.Contains(id);
        public IReadOnlyList<string> SecretTargets => State.Items.Where(s => !SecretItemSuspended(s.Id) && !Secret.Stitches.Exists(t => t.ItemId == s.Id) && !Secret.ImprovedItems.Contains(s.Id)).Select(s => s.Id).ToArray();

        public SecretEventKind[] SecretPortals()
        {
            if (SecretEventAssets.Current == null || State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || SecretRoomOpen || State.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Reward) return Array.Empty<SecretEventKind>();
            if (Secret.QueuedEvent >= 0 && Secret.VisitWave != State.Wave) return new[] { (SecretEventKind)Secret.QueuedEvent };
            // Act I: the middle of each zone (shops 3, 8, 13, 18), never a boss night's shop; endless keeps every fourth
            bool invited = !State.Endless && State.Wave <= ActOneCanon.Waves ? ActOneCanon.SecretShop(State.Wave) : State.Wave >= 3 && State.Wave % 4 == 3;
            if (Secret.Visits >= 2 || !invited || Secret.VisitWave == State.Wave) return Array.Empty<SecretEventKind>();
            var kinds = Enumerable.Range(0, 8).Where(k => (Secret.VisitedMask & (1 << k)) == 0).ToList();
            uint hash = unchecked((uint)State.Seed ^ (uint)State.Wave * 0x9e3779b9u);
            var result = new List<SecretEventKind>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 2 && kinds.Count > 0; i++)
            {
                hash = unchecked(hash * 1664525 + 1013904223); int pick = (int)(hash % (uint)kinds.Count);
                result.Add((SecretEventKind)kinds[pick]); kinds.RemoveAt(pick);
            }
            return result.ToArray();
        }

        public bool EnterSecretEvent(SecretEventKind kind)
        {
            if (!Array.Exists(SecretPortals(), k => k == kind)) return false;
            bool queued = Secret.QueuedEvent == (int)kind;
            Secret.Kind = kind; Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Choosing; Secret.Option = -1;
            Secret.VisitWave = State.Wave; Secret.VisitedMask |= 1 << (int)kind;
            Secret.RoomNights ??= new List<int>(); Secret.RoomNights.Add(State.Wave * 16 + (int)kind); // the next night's journal page remembers it
            if (queued) Secret.QueuedEvent = -1; else Secret.Visits++;
            Secret.TargetItem = SecretTargets.FirstOrDefault() ?? "";
            RosterEntry first = State.Roster.FirstOrDefault();
            Secret.TargetUnit = first?.UnitId ?? ""; Secret.TargetWeapon = first?.WeaponId ?? "";
            Secret.RewardId = ""; Secret.Result = "";
            return true;
        }

        public bool SetSecretTarget(string id, string weapon = "")
        {
            if (Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Choosing || State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop) return false;
            if (weapon.Length > 0)
            {
                if (!State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == id && r.WeaponId == weapon)) return false;
                Secret.TargetUnit = id; Secret.TargetWeapon = weapon;
            }
            else
            {
                if (!SecretTargets.Contains(id)) return false;
                Secret.TargetItem = id;
            }
            return true;
        }

        private SecretChoice Choice(string title, string copy, bool enabled = true, string reward = "") => new SecretChoice { Title = title, Copy = copy + (catalog.Item(reward) == null ? "" : "\n\n" + catalog.Item(reward).Description), Enabled = enabled, RewardId = reward, Icon = catalog.Item(reward)?.Icon ?? catalog.Unit(reward)?.Body };
        public SecretChoice[] SecretChoices()
        {
            string item = Secret.TargetItem; bool owned = SecretTargets.Contains(item);
            bool contract = Secret.Contracts.Count == 0;
            string name = catalog.Item(item)?.Name ?? "Select an owned relic";
            int price = SecretTrainPrice;
            switch (Secret.Kind)
            {
                case SecretEventKind.LostProperty:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("THE HEART IN THE DRAWER", "Fight the cabinet warden. Rescue the Forgotten Patchwork; solo heroes receive its Wooden Heart. Defeat ends the run.", true, SecretSolo ? "SecretWoodHeart" : "SecretPatchBear"),
                        Choice("THE LETTER THAT KNOCKS", "Fight the cabinet warden. Rescue Folded Courier; solo heroes receive its Dead-Letter Key. A later letter remembers your choice. Defeat ends the run.", true, SecretSolo ? "SecretLetter" : "SecretPaperBird"),
                        Choice("TAKE THE ABANDONED HEART", "Leave the prisoners asleep and take a Wooden Heart relic. No battle. Team health support; no second claim.", CanSecretItem("SecretWoodHeart"), "SecretWoodHeart") };
                case SecretEventKind.ImpossibleTailor:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("RECALL STITCH", name + ": replace this relic's stat modifiers with returning projectiles and +15% ranged damage; team projectiles lose pierce. One stitch per relic.", owned && HasSecretRanged),
                        Choice("AFTERSHOCK STITCH", name + ": replace its stat modifiers with a delayed melee echo at 30% damage; melee attacks take 20% longer. One stitch per relic.", owned && HasSecretMelee),
                        Choice("SHELTER STITCH", name + ": replace its stat modifiers with +18 maximum HP and 15% less incoming damage; team damage -8%. One stitch per relic.", owned) };
                case SecretEventKind.Understudy:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("FIGHT YOUR REFLECTION", "Your current build becomes a hostile understudy. It repeats your champion's basic attacks after 0.65s at their locked direction. Win: Glass Understudy relic. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretMirror"), "SecretMirror"),
                        Choice("LEND A RELIC", "Lend " + name + " for two normal victories. Its effects sleep while a temporary shadow ally fights with you. It returns automatically. Solo heroes gain +20% hero damage instead of an extra body.", owned && contract),
                        Choice("LEAVE A KIND REFLECTION", "Recover 20% maximum HP, then return. No battle or payment.") };
                case SecretEventKind.ContrabandTrain:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("THE BRASS-LOCKED CRATE", "Pay " + price + " gold for Smuggler's Ticket. See the relic below before buying. One deal only.", State.Gold >= price && CanSecretItem("SecretTicket"), "SecretTicket"),
                        Choice("THE THREAD-BOUND CRATE", "Trade one copy of " + name + " for Living Contraband Thread. The offered copy is consumed. One deal only.", owned && CanSecretItem("SecretThread"), "SecretThread"),
                        Choice("THE OWNER'S CRATE", "Challenge the train's collector. Win: Theatre Crown. No gold fee or ordinary-wave payout. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretCrown"), "SecretCrown") };
                case SecretEventKind.ThirteenthHour:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("BORROW AN EXTRA HOUR", "Borrow an Hourglass Advance relic for three normal victories. It vanishes when the third wave is settled. Only one active contract.", contract && StackCount("SecretHour") == 0, "SecretHour"),
                        Choice("ADVANCE ON TOMORROW", "Receive " + SecretLoan + " gold now. The bank takes 25% of normal-wave base income and interest for the next two victories. Kill loot is untouched.", contract),
                        Choice("DEPOSIT A RELIC", "Send " + name + " to the vault for two normal victories. Its stat effects sleep until it returns with +25% positive stat modifiers for this run.", contract && owned && CanImproveSecretItem(item)) };
                case SecretEventKind.SleepingGarden:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("WAKE THE PORCELAIN HEALER", "Restore all HP and gain a Sleeping-Lamb Brooch. No hidden payment or curse.", CanSecretItem("SecretDream"), "SecretDream"),
                        Choice("WAKE THE CONTRACT KEEPER", "Settle your current secret contract immediately: return lent/deposited relics, cancel income debt and release temporary gifts. No payment.", Secret.Contracts.Count > 0),
                        Choice(SecretSolo ? "WAKE A DREAM IN YOUR HEART" : "WAKE THE SLEEPING FRIEND", SecretSolo ? "Borrow a champion-damage dream for two normal victories. No companion is added." : "A porcelain Dream Lamb joins for two normal victories, then goes peacefully home. Solo heroes gain +20% hero damage instead of an extra body.", contract) };
                case SecretEventKind.EmptyTheatre:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("THE PAPER CHORUS", "Survive a 28-second swarm performance. Reward: Theatre Crown. No ordinary income or kill loot is paid. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretCrown"), "SecretCrown"),
                        Choice("THE LEADING ACTOR", "Defeat one enlarged cabinet actor with deliberate, heavy attacks. Reward: Hourglass Advance to keep. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretHour"), "SecretHour"),
                        Choice("THE HOSTILE DUET", "Defeat a cabinet actor and its ranged supporting performer. Their volleys alternate. Reward: Living Contraband Thread. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretThread"), "SecretThread") };
                default:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("ADDRESS IT TO YOURSELF", "Post one copy of " + name + ". After two normal victories, it returns with +25% positive stat modifiers. Its effects sleep while away.", owned && contract && CanImproveSecretItem(item)),
                        Choice("ADDRESS IT TO A FRIEND", "Consume one copy of " + name + " to give " + (catalog.Unit(Secret.TargetUnit)?.DisplayName ?? "a chosen companion") + " / " + Secret.TargetWeapon + " +20% weapon damage for this run. This gift stays with that unit/weapon pairing; it does not follow a different weapon after merging.", owned && !SecretSolo && State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == Secret.TargetUnit && r.WeaponId == Secret.TargetWeapon) && !Secret.AllyGifts.Exists(g => g.UnitId == Secret.TargetUnit && g.WeaponId == Secret.TargetWeapon)),
                        Choice("ADDRESS IT OUTSIDE THE STAGE", (Secret.RescuedToy && !Secret.ThankYouClaimed ? "The rescued resident enclosed a thank-you: 15 gold. " : "") + "Send an invitation and receive a Dead-Letter Key. A secret theatre encounter waits in a later shop, even after the two-visit limit. The Keeper remembers your letter.", !Secret.LetterSent && CanSecretItem("SecretLetter"), "SecretLetter") };
            }
        }

        public int SecretTrainPrice => 25 + Mathf.Min(State.Wave, 30) * 3;
        public int SecretLoan => 30 + Mathf.Min(State.Wave, 30) * 3;
        private bool HasSecretRanged => catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile || State.Roster.Exists(r => catalog.Weapon(r.WeaponId).Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile);
        private bool HasSecretMelee => catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee || State.Roster.Exists(r => catalog.Weapon(r.WeaponId).Kind == WeaponKind.Melee);
        private bool CanImproveSecretItem(string id) => catalog.Item(id) != null && catalog.Item(id).EffectiveModifiers.Any(m => m.Value > 0);
        private bool CanSecretItem(string id) => catalog.Item(id) != null && StackCount(id) < catalog.Item(id).StackLimit;
        private bool GiveSecretItem(string id)
        {
            if (!CanSecretItem(id)) return false;
            ItemStack stack = State.Items.Find(s => s.Id == id);
            if (stack == null) State.Items.Add(new ItemStack { Id = id, Count = 1 }); else stack.Count++;
            return true;
        }
        private void ConsumeSecretItem(string id)
        {
            ItemStack stack = State.Items.Find(s => s.Id == id); if (--stack.Count == 0) State.Items.Remove(stack);
        }
        private bool GiveSecretAlly(string id)
        {
            UnitDefinition unit = catalog.Unit(id); if (SecretSolo || unit == null) return false;
            RosterEntry existing = State.Roster.Find(r => r.UnitId == id && r.WeaponId == unit.Weapon.Id);
            if (existing != null) return false;
            var entry = new RosterEntry { UnitId = id, WeaponId = unit.Weapon.Id }; State.Roster.Add(entry); RememberVariant(entry); return true;
        }

        public bool ChooseSecretEvent(int option)
        {
            if (State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Choosing || option < 0 || option > 2) return false;
            SecretChoice choice = SecretChoices()[option]; if (!choice.Enabled) return false;
            Secret.Option = option; Secret.RewardId = choice.RewardId ?? "";
            RememberNightmareChoice(Secret.Kind,option,false);
            bool fight = Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.LostProperty && option < 2 || Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.Understudy && option == 0 || Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.ContrabandTrain && option == 2 || Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.EmptyTheatre;
            if (fight) { Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Fighting; State.Phase = SessionPhase.Combat; return true; }
            switch (Secret.Kind)
            {
                case SecretEventKind.LostProperty: GiveSecretItem("SecretWoodHeart"); break;
                case SecretEventKind.ImpossibleTailor: Secret.Stitches.Add(new SecretStitch { ItemId = Secret.TargetItem, Pattern = option }); break;
                case SecretEventKind.Understudy:
                    if (option == 2) State.Health = Mathf.Min(MaximumHealth(), State.Health + MaximumHealth() * .2f);
                    else Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow, Remaining = 2, ItemId = Secret.TargetItem });
                    break;
                case SecretEventKind.ContrabandTrain:
                    if (option == 0) State.Gold -= SecretTrainPrice; else ConsumeSecretItem(Secret.TargetItem);
                    GiveSecretItem(choice.RewardId); break;
                case SecretEventKind.ThirteenthHour:
                    if (option == 0) { GiveSecretItem("SecretHour"); Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.BorrowedRelic, Remaining = 3, ItemId = "SecretHour" }); }
                    else if (option == 1) { State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + SecretLoan); Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.IncomeDebt, Remaining = 2 }); }
                    else Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel, Remaining = 2, ItemId = Secret.TargetItem });
                    break;
                case SecretEventKind.SleepingGarden:
                    if (option == 0) { GiveSecretItem("SecretDream"); State.Health = MaximumHealth(); }
                    else if (option == 1) { foreach (SecretContract c in Secret.Contracts) FinishSecretContract(c); Secret.Contracts.Clear(); }
                    else Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.DreamFriend, Remaining = 2 });
                    break;
                case SecretEventKind.DeadLetters:
                    if (option == 0) Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel, Remaining = 2, ItemId = Secret.TargetItem });
                    else if (option == 1) { ConsumeSecretItem(Secret.TargetItem); Secret.AllyGifts.Add(new SecretAllyGift { UnitId = Secret.TargetUnit, WeaponId = Secret.TargetWeapon }); }
                    else
                    {
                        GiveSecretItem("SecretLetter"); Secret.LetterSent = true;
                        if (Secret.RescuedToy && !Secret.ThankYouClaimed) { State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + 15); Secret.ThankYouClaimed = true; }
                        if ((Secret.VisitedMask & (1 << (int)SecretEventKind.EmptyTheatre)) == 0) Secret.QueuedEvent = (int)SecretEventKind.EmptyTheatre;
                    }
                    break;
            }
            Secret.Result = choice.Title + "\n" + choice.Copy; Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Reward; Secret.RewardId = "";
            RecountBonds();
            State.Health = Mathf.Min(State.Health, MaximumHealth());
            RecordSecret(choice.Title);
            RememberNightmareChoice(Secret.Kind,option,true);
            return true;
        }

        public bool LeaveSecretEvent()
        {
            if (State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Choosing && Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Reward || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Secret.RewardId)) return false;
            RecordSecret(Secret.Stage == SecretEventStage.Reward ? "Returned to the unchanged shop." : "Left without a deal.");
            Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Idle; return true;
        }
        private bool SecretCompanionRewardUnavailable => catalog.Unit(Secret.RewardId) != null && (SecretSolo || State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == Secret.RewardId && r.WeaponId == catalog.Unit(Secret.RewardId).Weapon.Id));
        private string SecretCompanionFallback => Secret.RewardId == "SecretPaperBird" ? "SecretLetter" : "SecretWoodHeart";
        public string SecretRewardLabel => SecretCompanionRewardUnavailable ? CanSecretItem(SecretCompanionFallback) ? catalog.Item(SecretCompanionFallback).Name + " / RELIC INSTEAD" : "25 GOLD / ALTERNATE REWARD" : catalog.Item(Secret.RewardId)?.Name ?? catalog.Unit(Secret.RewardId)?.DisplayName;
        public bool ClaimSecretBattleReward()
        {
            if (State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Reward || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Secret.RewardId)) return false;
            string id = Secret.RewardId;
            bool success;
            if (SecretCompanionRewardUnavailable)
            {
                if (CanSecretItem(SecretCompanionFallback)) { id = SecretCompanionFallback; success = GiveSecretItem(id); }
                else { State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + 25); id = ""; success = true; }
            }
            else success = catalog.Item(id) != null ? GiveSecretItem(id) : GiveSecretAlly(id);
            if (!success) return false;
            if (Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.LostProperty) { Secret.RescuedToy = true; Secret.RescuedId = id ?? ""; }
            RememberNightmareChoice(Secret.Kind,Secret.Option,true);
            RecountBonds();
            Secret.RewardId = ""; RecordSecret("Received " + (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) ? "25 gold / alternate reward" : catalog.Item(id)?.Name ?? catalog.Unit(id)?.DisplayName));
            return true;
        }
        private void RecordSecret(string text)
        {
            Secret.Journal.Add("Hall " + State.Wave + " / " + SecretEventAssets.Titles[(int)Secret.Kind] + ": " + text);
            while (Secret.Journal.Count > 24) Secret.Journal.RemoveAt(0);
        }

        public float SecretBonus(ItemEffect effect, ModifierScope scope)
        {
            if (State.Secrets == null) return 0;
            float bonus = 0;
            foreach (SecretStitch stitch in Secret.Stitches)
            {
                if (StackCount(stitch.ItemId) == 0 || !RunModifierRules.Applies(ModifierScope.Team, scope)) continue;
                if (stitch.Pattern == 2 && effect == ItemEffect.Health && scope == ModifierScope.Champion) bonus += 18;
                if (stitch.Pattern == 2 && effect == ItemEffect.Damage) bonus -= .08f;
            }
            if (SecretSolo && Secret.Contracts.Exists(c => c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow || c.Kind == SecretContractKind.DreamFriend) && effect == ItemEffect.ChampionDamage && scope == ModifierScope.Champion) bonus += .2f;
            return bonus;
        }

        private void FinishSecretContract(SecretContract c)
        {
            if (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedRelic)
            {
                ItemStack stack = State.Items.Find(s => s.Id == c.ItemId); if (stack != null) ConsumeSecretItem(c.ItemId);
            }
            if (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel && !Secret.ImprovedItems.Contains(c.ItemId)) Secret.ImprovedItems.Add(c.ItemId);
        }
        private void SettleSecretContracts()
        {
            if (State.Secrets == null || Secret.LastContractWave >= State.Wave) return;
            Secret.LastContractWave = State.Wave;
            foreach (SecretContract c in Secret.Contracts.ToArray())
            {
                if (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.IncomeDebt)
                {
                    int charge = Mathf.CeilToInt((State.LastIncome + State.LastInterest) * .25f); State.Gold = Mathf.Max(0, State.Gold - charge);
                    Secret.Journal.Add("Hall " + State.Wave + ": bank repayment " + charge + " gold.");
                }
                if (--c.Remaining > 0) continue;
                FinishSecretContract(c); Secret.Contracts.Remove(c); RecordSecret("Contract completed: " + c.Kind);
            }
            State.Health = Mathf.Min(State.Health, MaximumHealth());
            while (Secret.Journal.Count > 24) Secret.Journal.RemoveAt(0);
        }

        private void ValidateSecretEvents(RunSnapshot snapshot)
        {
            if (snapshot?.Secrets == null) return; // old saves migrate lazily
            SecretEventProgress s = snapshot.Secrets;
            bool invalid = !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SecretEventStage), s.Stage) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SecretEventKind), s.Kind) || s.Visits < 0 || s.Visits > 2 || s.VisitedMask < 0 || s.VisitedMask > 255 || s.VisitWave < 0 || s.VisitWave > snapshot.Wave || s.LastContractWave < 0 || s.LastContractWave > snapshot.Wave || s.QueuedEvent < -1 || s.QueuedEvent > 7 || s.Option < -1 || s.Option > 2;
            invalid |= s.Contracts == null || s.Stitches == null || s.AllyGifts == null || s.ImprovedItems == null || s.Journal == null;
            if (invalid) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid secret-event save");
            if (s.Stage == SecretEventStage.Fighting && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Combat && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Defeat || (s.Stage == SecretEventStage.Choosing || s.Stage == SecretEventStage.Reward) && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid secret-event phase");
            if (s.Stage != SecretEventStage.Idle && snapshot.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Fighting || s.Contracts.Count > 1 || s.Stitches.Count > 8 || s.AllyGifts.Count > 8 || s.ImprovedItems.Count > 8 || s.Journal.Count > 24) throw new InvalidOperationException("Conflicting secret progress");
            foreach (SecretContract c in s.Contracts)
                if (c == null || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SecretContractKind), c.Kind) || c.Remaining < 1 || c.Remaining > 3 || (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedRelic || c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow || c.Kind == SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel) && (catalog.Item(c.ItemId) == null || !snapshot.Items.Exists(i => i.Id == c.ItemId))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid secret contract");
            var seen = new HashSet<string>();
            foreach (SecretStitch t in s.Stitches) if (t == null || catalog.Item(t.ItemId) == null || t.Pattern < 0 || t.Pattern > 2 || !seen.Add(t.ItemId)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid relic stitch");
            seen.Clear(); foreach (string id in s.ImprovedItems) if (catalog.Item(id) == null || !seen.Add(id)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid improved parcel");
            seen.Clear(); foreach (SecretAllyGift g in s.AllyGifts) if (g == null || catalog.Unit(g.UnitId) == null || catalog.Weapon(g.WeaponId) == null || !seen.Add(g.UnitId + "/" + g.WeaponId)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid ally letter");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.RewardId) && catalog.Item(s.RewardId) == null && catalog.Unit(s.RewardId) == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid secret reward");
        }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    /// <summary>Per-enemy state of the roster v2 enemies (Docs/Enemy_Roster_v2.md). Any enemy can also carry a PAID stamp.</summary>
    public sealed class WaitingEnemyState
    {
        public WaitingEnemyKind Kind;
        public int Step;               // what it is doing (per kind): 0 walking, then its wind-up and release steps
        public float StepAt;           // when the current step began
        public float NextAction;       // when it may start its move again
        public float ReleaseAt;        // end of the current wind-up (0 = none)
        public Vector2 Aim, Origin;    // locked aim (ring centre, cord end, landing spot) and leap origin
        public float Radius;           // the seat ring's radius
        public int Count;              // knocks landed, tally marks laid, casts made
        public int TargetId;           // the Notary's chosen ally
        public int Lantern = -1;       // the Snuffer's lantern
        public float Angle, Spin;      // the Hound's place on its circle and its turning sense
        public readonly Vector2[] Tallies = new Vector2[4];
        public readonly float[] KnockAt = { -1, -1, -1 };
        public int Slashes;
        public bool Tethered;          // the Sitter's ink thread is on the hero
        public float TetherUntil, NextTetherTick;
        public bool Paid;              // PAID: the next hit this enemy takes is halved
        public float PaidAt = -100;
    }

    public enum WaitingMarkKind { SeatRing, ClosedPatch, CordPreview, Cord, KnockRing, Tally, SlashLine, Slash, Thread }

    /// <summary>Something a roster v2 enemy draws on the floor: a warning (before At) or a live mark (At..Until).</summary>
    public sealed class WaitingMark
    {
        public WaitingMarkKind Kind;
        public UnitState Source;
        public Vector2 A, B;           // centre (A) or segment (A to B)
        public float Radius;
        public float Created, At, Until;
        public float NextTick;
        public int Index;
        public bool Hit;               // the ring caught the hero / the slash or cord struck
    }

    /// <summary>The Waiting Realm's eight new enemies. Every move targets the hero or the floor (the companions are immortal):
    /// Spare Chair pins, Waking Sitter tethers, Ink Notary stamps PAID on an ally and CLOSED on the floor, Sewn Letter bursts,
    /// Party Line pins a live cord, Door Knocker knocks three waves, Lamp Snuffer dims a lantern, Ledger Hound tallies then
    /// slashes. Each reads first (a wind-up pose and an inked mark), then lands.</summary>
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        public const float SeatTelegraph = 1f, SeatRoot = .6f, TetherSlow = .7f, TetherBreak = 5f, ClosedSlow = .75f, ClosedSeconds = 3f;
        public const float PaidShare = .5f, HalfShare = .35f, StampShare = .12f, CordRing = .9f, CordSeconds = 3f, KnockBeat = .7f, TallyBeat = .8f;
        private sealed class PendingPiece { public UnitDefinition Root; public bool Stamp; public Vector2 Position, Away; }
        private readonly List<WaitingMark> waitingMarks = new List<WaitingMark>();
        private readonly List<PendingPiece> waitingPieces = new List<PendingPiece>();
        private readonly Dictionary<UnitDefinition, UnitDefinition> letterHalves = new Dictionary<UnitDefinition, UnitDefinition>(), letterStamps = new Dictionary<UnitDefinition, UnitDefinition>();
        private readonly Dictionary<UnitDefinition, UnitDefinition> letterRoots = new Dictionary<UnitDefinition, UnitDefinition>();
        private readonly float[] lanternDim = new float[8];
        private Vector2[] lanternFixture;
        private int waitingGeneration = -1;
        private bool heroTethered;
        public IReadOnlyList<WaitingMark> WaitingMarks => waitingMarks;
        public float HeroRootedUntil { get; private set; }
        public float HeroClosedUntil { get; private set; }
        public bool HeroTethered => heroTethered;

        private void SyncWaiting()
        {
            if (waitingGeneration == Generation) return;
            waitingGeneration = Generation;
            waitingMarks.Clear(); waitingPieces.Clear(); System.Array.Clear(lanternDim, 0, lanternDim.Length);
            HeroRootedUntil = HeroClosedUntil = 0; heroTethered = false;
        }

        /// <summary>The hero's walk under the roster's holds: pinned by a seat ring, slowed by a taut thread or CLOSED ink.</summary>
        private float WaitingHeroScale
        {
            get
            {
                SyncWaiting();
                if (HeroRootedUntil > Elapsed) return 0;
                float scale = 1;
                if (heroTethered) scale *= TetherSlow;
                if (HeroClosedUntil > Elapsed) scale *= ClosedSlow;
                return scale;
            }
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------------ lanterns (Lamp Snuffer)
        /// <summary>How far a lantern has been dimmed by Lamp Snuffers (0 normal, 1 dark); the lantern field multiplies its light.</summary>
        public float LanternDimming(int index) => (Phase == RunPhase.Combat || Phase == RunPhase.Paused) && waitingGeneration == Generation && index >= 0 && index < lanternDim.Length ? lanternDim[index] : 0;
        public bool LanternDimmed(int index) => LanternDimming(index) > 0;
        /// <summary>Check fixture: these spots are the arena's lit lanterns (no scenery needed).</summary>
        public void ConfigureWaitingLanternFixture(Vector2[] spots) { lanternFixture = spots; }
        /// <summary>A lit lantern's floor spot: the arena layout's lantern foot, when its canon lamp still burns this wave.</summary>
        public bool WaitingLantern(int index, out Vector2 at)
        {
            at = Vector2.zero;
            if (index < 0 || index >= 8) return false;
            if (lanternFixture != null) { if (index >= lanternFixture.Length) return false; at = lanternFixture[index]; return true; }
            if (!(catalog.Scenery is ArenaScenery scenery)) return false;
            if (NightLanternField.StateFor(index, catalog.RunWave, false, catalog.LanternRelitMask) == 2) return false;
            ArenaLayoutPlan plan = ArenaLayoutPlan.For(scenery.Resized(catalog.ArenaSize));
            if (!plan.TryGet("lantern" + index, out ArenaLayoutPlan.Spot spot) || !spot.Visible) return false;
            at = spot.Foot; return true;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------------ spawning and damage hooks
        /// <summary>At most three chairs, letters or sitters and two of each other new kind at once, six in all.</summary>
        private bool WaitingSpawnBlocked(UnitDefinition definition)
        {
            WaitingEnemyKind kind = definition == null ? WaitingEnemyKind.None : definition.WaitingKind;
            if (kind == WaitingEnemyKind.None) return false;
            int same = 0, all = 0;
            foreach (UnitState unit in units)
            {
                if (!unit.Alive || unit.Faction != Faction.Enemy) continue;
                WaitingEnemyKind other = unit.Definition.WaitingKind;
                if (other == kind) same++;
                if (other != WaitingEnemyKind.None && other != WaitingEnemyKind.LetterHalf && other != WaitingEnemyKind.LetterStamp) all++;
            }
            int cap = kind == WaitingEnemyKind.SpareChair || kind == WaitingEnemyKind.SewnLetter || kind == WaitingEnemyKind.WakingSitter ? 3 : 2;
            return same >= cap || all >= 6;
        }

        /// <summary>PAID: an enemy stamped by an Ink Notary takes half of the next hit we deal it.</summary>
        private float WaitingDamage(UnitState target, float damage, Faction source)
        {
            if (target.Faction != Faction.Enemy || source == Faction.Enemy || target.Waiting == null || !target.Waiting.Paid) return damage;
            target.Waiting.Paid = false;
            return damage * PaidShare;
        }

        /// <summary>A Sewn Letter bursts into two halves, a half into two stamps (spawned on the next roster step, never inside
        /// a damage loop); stamps do not split.</summary>
        private void WaitingDeath(UnitState target)
        {
            if (target.Faction != Faction.Enemy) return;
            WaitingEnemyKind kind = target.Definition.WaitingKind;
            if (kind != WaitingEnemyKind.SewnLetter && kind != WaitingEnemyKind.LetterHalf) return;
            SyncWaiting();
            UnitDefinition root = kind == WaitingEnemyKind.SewnLetter ? target.Definition : letterRoots.TryGetValue(target.Definition, out UnitDefinition found) ? found : target.Definition;
            Vector2 away = (target.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude > .0001f ? (target.Position - Champion.Position).normalized : Vector2.up;
            for (int side = -1; side <= 1; side += 2)
                waitingPieces.Add(new PendingPiece { Root = root, Stamp = kind == WaitingEnemyKind.LetterHalf, Position = target.Position, Away = new Vector2(-away.y, away.x) * side });
        }

        private UnitDefinition LetterPiece(UnitDefinition root, bool stamp)
        {
            Dictionary<UnitDefinition, UnitDefinition> cache = stamp ? letterStamps : letterHalves;
            if (cache.TryGetValue(root, out UnitDefinition piece) && piece != null) return piece;
            piece = Object.Instantiate(root);
            piece.name = root.name + (stamp ? " stamp" : " half");
            piece.WaitingKind = stamp ? WaitingEnemyKind.LetterStamp : WaitingEnemyKind.LetterHalf;
            piece.Health = root.Health * (stamp ? StampShare : HalfShare);
            piece.BodyHeight = root.BodyHeight * (stamp ? .5f : .72f); piece.Radius = root.Radius * (stamp ? .6f : .8f);
            piece.Speed = root.Speed * (stamp ? 1.3f : 1.15f); piece.ContactDamage = root.ContactDamage * (stamp ? .5f : .75f);
            piece.KnockbackResistance = 0; piece.DisplayName = stamp ? "Postage Stamp" : "Torn Letter";
            WaitingEnemyRoster roster = WaitingEnemyRoster.Current;
            AuthoredMotionSet motion = roster == null ? null : stamp ? roster.LetterStamp : roster.LetterHalf;
            if (motion != null && motion.Idle != null && motion.Idle.Length >= 2 && motion.Walk != null && motion.Walk.Length >= 2)
            {
                piece.AuthoredMotion = motion; piece.Body = motion.Idle[0];
                piece.AnimationFrames = new[] { motion.Idle[0], motion.Idle[1], motion.Walk[0], motion.Walk[1] };
            }
            cache[root] = piece; letterRoots[piece] = root;
            return piece;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the roster's own step (after the arena's fields)
        private void ProcessWaitingEnemies(float deltaTime)
        {
            SyncWaiting();
            for (int index = 0; index < waitingPieces.Count; index++)
            {
                PendingPiece pending = waitingPieces[index];
                UnitDefinition definition = LetterPiece(pending.Root, pending.Stamp);
                UnitState piece = Spawn(definition, Faction.Enemy, ClampPosition(pending.Position + pending.Away * .45f, definition.Radius));
                piece.SwarmMinion = true; // a piece drops a small coin, like a swarm body
                piece.Waiting = new WaitingEnemyState { Kind = definition.WaitingKind, NextAction = Elapsed + .4f };
                piece.NextContact = piece.NextAttack = Elapsed + .5f;
                piece.Facing = pending.Away;
            }
            waitingPieces.Clear();
            bool anyThread = false;
            for (int index = waitingMarks.Count - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                WaitingMark mark = waitingMarks[index];
                bool sourceGone = mark.Source == null || !mark.Source.Alive;
                if (Elapsed > mark.Until || sourceGone && (mark.Kind == WaitingMarkKind.Cord || mark.Kind == WaitingMarkKind.Thread || Elapsed < mark.At && mark.Kind != WaitingMarkKind.ClosedPatch))
                { waitingMarks.RemoveAt(index); continue; }
                if (Elapsed < mark.At || !Champion.Alive) continue;
                switch (mark.Kind)
                {
                    case WaitingMarkKind.ClosedPatch:
                        if ((Champion.Position - mark.A).magnitude <= mark.Radius + Champion.Definition.Radius) { HeroClosedUntil = Elapsed + ClosedSeconds; mark.Hit = true; }
                        break;
                    case WaitingMarkKind.Cord:
                        if (Elapsed >= mark.NextTick && SegmentDistance(Champion.Position, mark.A, mark.B) <= mark.Radius + Champion.Definition.Radius)
                        {
                            mark.NextTick = Elapsed + .6f; mark.Hit = true;
                            ApplyDamage(Champion, mark.Source.Definition.Weapon.Damage * .8f, Faction.Enemy, mark.Source.Definition.DisplayName + " cord", (Champion.Position - mark.A).normalized, cause: NewCause(mark.Source.Id).Child("party-line-cord"));
                        }
                        break;
                    case WaitingMarkKind.Thread:
                        mark.A = mark.Source.Position; mark.B = Champion.Position;
                        anyThread |= mark.Source.Waiting != null && mark.Source.Waiting.Tethered && (mark.Source.Position - Champion.Position).magnitude <= TetherBreak;
                        break;
                }
            }
            heroTethered = anyThread;
            // a lantern no Snuffer is pinching slowly finds its flame again
            for (int lamp = 0; lamp < lanternDim.Length; lamp++)
            {
                if (lanternDim[lamp] <= 0) continue;
                bool pinched = false;
                foreach (UnitState unit in units)
                    if (unit.Alive && unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy && unit.Waiting != null && unit.Waiting.Kind == WaitingEnemyKind.LampSnuffer && unit.Waiting.Step == 1 && unit.Waiting.Lantern == lamp) { pinched = true; break; }
                if (!pinched) lanternDim[lamp] = Mathf.Max(0, lanternDim[lamp] - deltaTime / 2.5f);
            }
        }

        private static float SegmentDistance(Vector2 point, Vector2 a, Vector2 b)
        {
            Vector2 segment = b - a;
            float t = segment.sqrMagnitude < 1e-6f ? 0 : Mathf.Clamp01(Vector2.Dot(point - a, segment) / segment.sqrMagnitude);
            return Vector2.Distance(point, a + segment * t);
        }

        private WaitingMark Mark(WaitingMarkKind kind, UnitState source, Vector2 a, Vector2 b, float radius, float delay, float duration, int index = 0)
        {
            var mark = new WaitingMark { Kind = kind, Source = source, A = a, B = b, Radius = radius, Created = Elapsed, At = Elapsed + delay, Until = Elapsed + delay + duration, NextTick = Elapsed + delay, Index = index };
            if (waitingMarks.Count >= 160) waitingMarks.RemoveAt(0);
            waitingMarks.Add(mark);
            return mark;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------------ movement and moves
        private float WaitingSpeedScale(UnitState unit)
            => (unit.ChillUntil > Elapsed ? 0.55f : 1f) * (unit.StaggerUntil > Elapsed ? ImpactRules.StaggerSpeed : 1f) * KitEnemySpeed(unit) * EnemySleepScale(unit) * VisitorEnemyScale(unit);

        private void WaitingWalk(UnitState unit, Vector2 goal, float stop, float deltaTime, float pace = 1)
        {
            Vector2 offset = goal - unit.Position; float distance = offset.magnitude;
            if (distance > .001f) unit.Facing = offset / distance;
            if (distance <= stop) return;
            unit.Position = ClampPosition(unit.Position + unit.Facing * Mathf.Min(unit.Definition.Speed * pace * WaitingSpeedScale(unit) * deltaTime, distance - stop), unit.Definition.Radius);
        }

        private bool WaitingCanWindUp()
        {
            int charging = 0;
            foreach (UnitState other in units) if (other.Alive && (other.EvolutionReleaseAt > Elapsed || other.Variant != null && other.Variant.ReleaseAt > Elapsed)) charging++;
            return charging < 4;
        }

        /// <summary>The wind-up pose (crouched then charged frames) plays through the authored motion's evolution timing.</summary>
        private void WaitingWindup(UnitState unit, float seconds, Vector2 aim)
        {
            Vector2 direction = (aim - unit.Position).sqrMagnitude > .0001f ? (aim - unit.Position).normalized : unit.Facing;
            unit.AttackStarted = Elapsed; unit.AttackWindup = seconds; unit.AttackDirection = unit.Facing = direction;
            unit.EvolutionReleaseAt = unit.TelegraphUntil = unit.Waiting.ReleaseAt = Elapsed + seconds;
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, unit.Position, Faction.Enemy, direction: direction, weapon: unit.Definition.Weapon, subject: unit));
        }
        private void WaitingRelease(UnitState unit, float recovery)
        {
            unit.EvolutionReleaseAt = 0; unit.TelegraphUntil = 0; unit.Waiting.ReleaseAt = 0;
            unit.EvolutionRecoveryUntil = Elapsed + recovery;
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, unit.Position, Faction.Enemy, direction: unit.AttackDirection, weapon: unit.Definition.Weapon, subject: unit));
        }

        private bool MoveWaitingEnemy(UnitState unit, float deltaTime)
        {
            if (unit.Faction != Faction.Enemy || unit.Definition.IsBoss) return false;
            WaitingEnemyKind kind = unit.Definition.WaitingKind;
            if (kind == WaitingEnemyKind.None) return false;
            SyncWaiting();
            WaitingEnemyState state = unit.Waiting ??= new WaitingEnemyState();
            if (state.Kind != kind) { state.Kind = kind; state.Step = 0; state.NextAction = Elapsed + 1.2f + unit.Id % 5 * .25f; }
            if (EnemySleepScale(unit) <= 0) return true;
            if (unit.EvolutionRecoveryUntil > Elapsed && state.Step == 0) return true;
            bool evolved = unit.Definition.EvolutionStage > 0;
            Vector2 hero = Champion.Position, goal = OctoberEnemyTarget(unit);
            float reach = (hero - unit.Position).magnitude;
            bool ready = Elapsed >= state.NextAction && unit.EntranceUntil <= Elapsed;
            switch (kind)
            {
                case WaitingEnemyKind.SpareChair:
                    if (state.Step == 1)
                    {
                        if (Elapsed < state.ReleaseAt) return true;
                        // the seat snaps shut: still inside it, the hero is held 0.6 s
                        bool caught = (hero - state.Aim).magnitude <= state.Radius;
                        if (caught) HeroRootedUntil = Mathf.Max(HeroRootedUntil, Elapsed + SeatRoot);
                        foreach (WaitingMark mark in waitingMarks) if (mark.Source == unit && mark.Kind == WaitingMarkKind.SeatRing && !mark.Hit && mark.At <= Elapsed + .001f) mark.Hit = caught;
                        WaitingRelease(unit, .55f); state.Step = 0; state.NextAction = Elapsed + 5 + unit.Id % 3 * .4f;
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (ready && reach <= 3f && WaitingCanWindUp())
                    {
                        state.Step = 1; state.Aim = hero; state.Radius = evolved ? 1.1f : .9f;
                        Mark(WaitingMarkKind.SeatRing, unit, hero, unit.Position, state.Radius, SeatTelegraph, SeatRoot + .25f);
                        WaitingWindup(unit, SeatTelegraph, hero);
                        return true;
                    }
                    WaitingWalk(unit, goal, unit.Definition.Radius + Champion.Definition.Radius, deltaTime);
                    return true;

                case WaitingEnemyKind.WakingSitter:
                    if (state.Step == 1)
                    {
                        if (Elapsed < state.ReleaseAt) return true;
                        WaitingRelease(unit, .4f);
                        if (reach <= TetherBreak)
                        {
                            state.Step = 2; state.Tethered = true; state.TetherUntil = Elapsed + (evolved ? 7 : 6); state.NextTetherTick = Elapsed + 1;
                            Mark(WaitingMarkKind.Thread, unit, unit.Position, hero, .05f, 0, state.TetherUntil - Elapsed);
                            heroTethered = true;
                        }
                        else { state.Step = 0; state.NextAction = Elapsed + 2; }
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (state.Step == 2)
                    {
                        unit.Facing = reach > .001f ? (hero - unit.Position) / reach : unit.Facing;
                        if (reach > TetherBreak || Elapsed > state.TetherUntil)
                        {
                            state.Tethered = false; state.Step = 0; state.NextAction = Elapsed + 4;
                            foreach (WaitingMark mark in waitingMarks) if (mark.Source == unit && mark.Kind == WaitingMarkKind.Thread) mark.Until = Elapsed;
                            return true;
                        }
                        if (Elapsed >= state.NextTetherTick)
                        {
                            state.NextTetherTick = Elapsed + 1;
                            ApplyDamage(Champion, unit.Definition.Weapon.Damage * .3f, Faction.Enemy, unit.Definition.DisplayName + " thread", unit.Facing, cause: NewCause(unit.Id).Child("waking-thread"));
                        }
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (ready && reach <= 4.2f && WaitingCanWindUp()) { state.Step = 1; WaitingWindup(unit, .8f, hero); return true; }
                    WaitingWalk(unit, goal, 3.2f, deltaTime);
                    return true;

                case WaitingEnemyKind.InkNotary:
                {
                    UnitState ally = UnitWithId(state.TargetId);
                    if (ally != null && (!ally.Alive || ally.Faction != Faction.Enemy)) ally = null;
                    if (state.Step == 1 || state.Step == 2)
                    {
                        if (Elapsed < state.ReleaseAt) return true;
                        if (state.Step == 1 && ally != null)
                        {
                            ally.Waiting ??= new WaitingEnemyState();
                            ally.Waiting.Paid = true; ally.Waiting.PaidAt = Elapsed;
                        }
                        WaitingRelease(unit, .45f); state.Count++; state.Step = 0; state.NextAction = Elapsed + 3.5f + unit.Id % 3 * .3f;
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (ally == null || ally.Waiting != null && ally.Waiting.Paid) { ally = NotaryAlly(unit); state.TargetId = ally?.Id ?? 0; }
                    if (ready && WaitingCanWindUp())
                    {
                        if (ally != null && state.Count % 2 == 0 && (ally.Position - unit.Position).magnitude <= 2.2f)
                        { state.Step = 1; WaitingWindup(unit, .7f, ally.Position); return true; }
                        if (reach <= 7f && (ally == null || state.Count % 2 == 1))
                        {
                            state.Step = 2;
                            Mark(WaitingMarkKind.ClosedPatch, unit, hero, unit.Position, evolved ? 1f : .85f, .7f, .5f); // stamped once, never a lingering patch
                            WaitingWindup(unit, .7f, hero);
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    // it works from behind the others: just past its ally, away from the hero; alone, it keeps its distance
                    if (ally != null) WaitingWalk(unit, ally.Position + ((ally.Position - hero).sqrMagnitude > .0001f ? (ally.Position - hero).normalized : Vector2.up) * 1.1f, .2f, deltaTime);
                    else if (reach < 3.4f) WaitingWalk(unit, unit.Position + (unit.Position - hero).normalized * 2, .1f, deltaTime, .8f);
                    else WaitingWalk(unit, goal, 4f, deltaTime);
                    return true;
                }

                case WaitingEnemyKind.PartyLine:
                    // a telephone never walks: it rings, then pins its cord across the floor toward the hero
                    unit.Facing = reach > .001f ? (hero - unit.Position) / reach : unit.Facing;
                    if (state.Step == 1)
                    {
                        if (Elapsed < state.ReleaseAt) return true;
                        Mark(WaitingMarkKind.Cord, unit, unit.Position, state.Aim, .22f, 0, CordSeconds);
                        WaitingRelease(unit, .5f); state.Count++; state.Step = 0; state.NextAction = Elapsed + CordSeconds + 2.4f;
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (ready && reach <= 9f && reach > .8f && WaitingCanWindUp())
                    {
                        Vector2 along = (hero - unit.Position) / reach, side = new Vector2(-along.y, along.x) * (state.Count % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1);
                        Vector2 near = hero + side * .35f;
                        Vector2 end = ClampPosition(unit.Position + (near - unit.Position).normalized * ((near - unit.Position).magnitude + 1.6f), .1f);
                        state.Step = 1; state.Aim = end;
                        Mark(WaitingMarkKind.CordPreview, unit, unit.Position, end, .22f, CordRing, 0);
                        WaitingWindup(unit, CordRing, near);
                    }
                    return true;

                case WaitingEnemyKind.DoorKnocker:
                    if (state.Step == 1)
                    {
                        // the leap: up and over, onto the marked landing spot
                        float progress = Mathf.Clamp01((Elapsed - state.StepAt) / .6f);
                        unit.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.Lerp(state.Origin, state.Aim, Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, progress)), unit.Definition.Radius);
                        unit.BodyLift = Mathf.Sin(progress * Mathf.PI) * .9f;
                        if (progress < 1) return true;
                        unit.BodyLift = 0; state.Step = 2; state.StepAt = Elapsed; state.Count = 0;
                        for (int knock = 0; knock < 3; knock++)
                            Mark(WaitingMarkKind.KnockRing, unit, unit.Position, unit.Position, KnockRadius(knock, evolved), KnockBeat * (knock + 1), .12f, knock);
                        WaitingWindup(unit, KnockBeat, hero);
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (state.Step == 2)
                    {
                        if (Elapsed < state.StepAt + KnockBeat * (state.Count + 1)) return true;
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, unit, unit.Position, KnockRadius(state.Count, evolved), 0, .55f);
                        state.KnockAt[state.Count] = Elapsed; state.Count++;
                        if (state.Count < 3) WaitingWindup(unit, KnockBeat, hero);
                        else { WaitingRelease(unit, .6f); state.Step = 0; state.NextAction = Elapsed + 5.5f + unit.Id % 3 * .4f; }
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (ready && reach <= 5f && WaitingCanWindUp())
                    {
                        Vector2 back = reach > .001f ? (unit.Position - hero) / reach : Vector2.up;
                        state.Step = 1; state.StepAt = Elapsed; state.Origin = unit.Position;
                        state.Aim = ClampPosition(hero + back * 1.6f, unit.Definition.Radius);
                        unit.Facing = -back;
                        return true;
                    }
                    WaitingWalk(unit, goal, unit.Definition.Radius + Champion.Definition.Radius, deltaTime);
                    return true;

                case WaitingEnemyKind.LampSnuffer:
                {
                    if (state.Lantern < 0 || !WaitingLantern(state.Lantern, out Vector2 lamp) || state.Step == 0 && lanternDim[state.Lantern] >= 1)
                    {
                        state.Lantern = NearestLitLantern(unit.Position); state.Step = 0;
                        if (state.Lantern < 0) { WaitingWalk(unit, goal, unit.Definition.Radius + Champion.Definition.Radius, deltaTime); return true; }
                        WaitingLantern(state.Lantern, out lamp);
                    }
                    Vector2 perch = lamp + Vector2.up * .35f;
                    if (state.Step == 0)
                    {
                        WaitingWalk(unit, perch, .05f, deltaTime, .9f);
                        if ((unit.Position - perch).magnitude <= .5f) { state.Step = 1; state.StepAt = Elapsed; }
                        return true;
                    }
                    // pinching the flame: the lantern dims until the Snuffer falls
                    unit.Facing = (lamp - unit.Position).sqrMagnitude > .0001f ? (lamp - unit.Position).normalized : unit.Facing;
                    lanternDim[state.Lantern] = Mathf.Min(1, lanternDim[state.Lantern] + deltaTime / (evolved ? 3.5f : 5f));
                    if ((unit.Position - perch).magnitude > .8f) state.Step = 0;
                    return true;
                }

                case WaitingEnemyKind.LedgerHound:
                    if (state.Step == 1)
                    {
                        // circling the hero, laying a tally mark every beat
                        state.Angle += state.Spin * 75f * deltaTime;
                        Vector2 lap = hero + new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(state.Angle * Mathf.Deg2Rad), Mathf.Sin(state.Angle * Mathf.Deg2Rad)) * 2.6f;
                        WaitingWalk(unit, ClampPosition(lap, unit.Definition.Radius), 0, deltaTime, 3f);
                        if (state.Count < 4 && Elapsed >= state.StepAt + TallyBeat * state.Count)
                        {
                            state.Tallies[state.Count] = unit.Position;
                            Vector2 outward = (unit.Position - hero).sqrMagnitude > .0001f ? (unit.Position - hero).normalized : Vector2.up;
                            Mark(WaitingMarkKind.Tally, unit, unit.Position - outward * .3f, unit.Position + outward * .3f, .06f, 0, 6, state.Count);
                            state.Count++;
                        }
                        if (state.Count >= 4 && Elapsed >= state.StepAt + TallyBeat * 4)
                        {
                            // the fifth stroke: a diagonal slash along the marked line, first tally to last
                            Vector2 axis = state.Tallies[3] - state.Tallies[0];
                            Vector2 dir = axis.sqrMagnitude > .0001f ? axis.normalized : Vector2.right;
                            state.Origin = state.Tallies[0] - dir * .8f; state.Aim = state.Tallies[3] + dir * .8f;
                            state.Step = 2;
                            Mark(WaitingMarkKind.SlashLine, unit, state.Origin, state.Aim, .38f, .7f, 0);
                            WaitingWindup(unit, .7f, state.Aim);
                        }
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (state.Step == 2)
                    {
                        if (Elapsed < state.ReleaseAt) return true;
                        WaitingMark slash = Mark(WaitingMarkKind.Slash, unit, state.Origin, state.Aim, .38f, 0, .45f);
                        state.Slashes++;
                        if (SegmentDistance(hero, state.Origin, state.Aim) <= .38f + Champion.Definition.Radius)
                        {
                            slash.Hit = true;
                            ApplyDamage(Champion, unit.Definition.Weapon.Damage * 1.6f, Faction.Enemy, unit.Definition.DisplayName + " slash", (state.Aim - state.Origin).normalized, cause: NewCause(unit.Id).Child("ledger-slash"));
                        }
                        unit.Position = ClampPosition(state.Aim, unit.Definition.Radius);
                        WaitingRelease(unit, .6f); state.Step = 0; state.Count = 0; state.NextAction = Elapsed + 5 + unit.Id % 3 * .4f;
                        return true;
                    }
                    if (ready && reach >= 1.6f && reach <= 3.6f && WaitingCanWindUp())
                    {
                        state.Step = 1; state.StepAt = Elapsed; state.Count = 0;
                        Vector2 from = unit.Position - hero;
                        state.Angle = Mathf.Atan2(from.y, from.x) * Mathf.Rad2Deg; state.Spin = unit.Id % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1;
                        return true;
                    }
                    WaitingWalk(unit, goal, 2.6f, deltaTime, 1.1f);
                    return true;

                default: // a Sewn Letter and its pieces simply come for the hero
                    WaitingWalk(unit, goal, unit.Definition.Radius + Champion.Definition.Radius, deltaTime);
                    return true;
            }
        }

        private static float KnockRadius(int knock, bool evolved) => (knock >= 2 ? 2.6f : 1.7f) * (evolved ? 1.12f : 1);

        private UnitState NotaryAlly(UnitState notary)
        {
            UnitState best = null; float bestDistance = 36;
            foreach (UnitState other in units)
            {
                if (other == notary || !other.Alive || other.Faction != Faction.Enemy || other.Definition.IsBoss || other.Definition.WaitingKind == WaitingEnemyKind.InkNotary) continue;
                if (other.Waiting != null && other.Waiting.Paid) continue;
                float distance = (other.Position - notary.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                if (distance < bestDistance) { best = other; bestDistance = distance; }
            }
            return best;
        }

        private int NearestLitLantern(Vector2 from)
        {
            int best = -1; float bestDistance = float.PositiveInfinity;
            for (int index = 0; index < 8; index++)
            {
                if (!WaitingLantern(index, out Vector2 at) || lanternDim[index] >= 1) continue;
                float distance = (at - from).sqrMagnitude;
                if (distance < bestDistance) { best = index; bestDistance = distance; }
            }
            return best;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CheckpointCatalog
    {
        /// <summary>Filled by RunSession.PrepareCombat: lanterns relit in Act I (the Lamp Snuffer goes only for lit ones).</summary>
        [NonSerialized] public int LanternRelitMask;
    }

    /// <summary>Where the enemy roster v2 joins a run: each new enemy whose art exists walks into its own zone's waves
    /// (WaitingEnemyRoster.InRegularWaves); the Waking Sitters rise only in the hidden SIT CLOSER fight.</summary>
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        private void AddWaitingEnemies(List<UnitDefinition> pool, float scaling)
        {
            WaitingEnemyRoster roster = WaitingEnemyRoster.Current;
            if (roster == null || roster.Enemies == null) return;
            foreach (UnitDefinition enemy in roster.Enemies)
                if (enemy != null && enemy.Weapon != null && WaitingEnemyRoster.InRegularWaves(enemy.WaitingKind, State.Wave, State.Endless))
                    pool.Add(BuildEnemy(enemy, scaling));
        }

        /// <summary>After the encounter is set: lantern state for the Snuffers, and the seated travellers the Bedside wakes.</summary>
        private void PrepareWaitingEnemies()
        {
            CombatCatalog.LanternRelitMask = State.ActOne?.RelitMask ?? 0;
            if ((State.ActOne?.SitCloser ?? 0) != ActOneProgress.Fighting || !CombatCatalog.ExpandedContent) return;
            UnitDefinition sitter = Array.Find(WaitingEnemyRoster.Current?.Enemies ?? Array.Empty<UnitDefinition>(), unit => unit != null && unit.Weapon != null && unit.WaitingKind == WaitingEnemyKind.WakingSitter);
            if (sitter == null) return;
            int real = State.Wave;
            State.Wave = Mathf.Min(real + ActOneCanon.SitWaveBonus, 40); // as strong as the rest of the fight (PrepareSitCloser)
            UnitDefinition built;
            try { built = BuildEnemy(sitter, (1f + (State.Wave - 1) * 0.10f) * JourneyBalance.EnemyHealth(State.Difficulty, State.Wave)); }
            finally { State.Wave = real; }
            var pool = new List<UnitDefinition>(CombatCatalog.EnemyPool ?? Array.Empty<UnitDefinition>()) { built, built };
            CombatCatalog.EnemyPool = pool.ToArray();
        }
    }
}

using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class WaveCadence
    {
        /// <summary>Act I waves grow from a short first night to a full minute (Brotato-like): 30 s, +2.5 s a wave, 60 s from wave 13.</summary>
        /// <summary>Prices climb with the night: the hall is far busier than it was, and every swarm body drops a coin.</summary>
        public static float PriceRamp(int wave) => 1f + Mathf.Min(0.6f, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 2) * 0.045f);
        /// <summary>Act I story bosses stand long enough for their fight (and its light swarm) to happen: bot builds felled them in 4-14 s.</summary>
        public static float StoryBossBulk(int wave) => wave >= 20 ? 5f : wave >= 15 ? 3.5f : wave >= 10 ? 3f : 2f;
        public static float WaveLength(int wave) => Mathf.Min(60f, 30f + Mathf.Max(0, wave - 1) * 2.5f);
        public static int SwarmBatch(int wave, float time)
        {
            if (wave < 3) return wave == 2 ? 3 : 2; // the first nights already come in small packs
            float beat = Mathf.Repeat(Mathf.Max(0, time - 0.6f), 12);
            int crest = Mathf.Min(36, Mathf.CeilToInt((3 + (wave - 3) / 2) * SwarmPressure(wave)));
            return beat < 6 ? crest : Mathf.Max(2, Mathf.CeilToInt(crest * 0.6f)); // the beat eases but never empties: surges replace the lulls
        }
        public static float SwarmPressure(int wave) => 1 + 2 * Mathf.Clamp01((wave - 3) / 9f);
        public static float SwarmInterval(int wave, float time)
        {
            if (wave < 3) return 1;
            return Mathf.Repeat(Mathf.Max(0, time - 0.6f), 12) < 8 ? 0.9f : 1.25f;
        }
        public static float IntervalMultiplier(int wave, float time)
        {
            if (wave < 3) return 1;
            float phase = Mathf.Repeat(Mathf.Max(0, time), 12);
            return phase < 7 ? 0.88f : phase < 9 ? Mathf.Lerp(0.88f, 1.45f, (phase - 7) / 2) : Mathf.Lerp(1.45f, 0.88f, (phase - 9) / 3);
        }
        public static float Envelope(int wave, float time, float duration)
        {
            if (wave < 3) return 1;
            // a steady climb with no quiet stretch: the interval tightens from the first second to the last
            float progress = Mathf.Clamp01(time / Mathf.Max(1, duration));
            return Mathf.Lerp(1.12f, 0.84f, progress) * 0.7f;
        }
        public static Vector2 Attract(Vector2 position, Vector2 target, float travel, int identity)
        {
            Vector2 difference = target - position;
            if (difference.magnitude <= travel * 2) return Vector2.MoveTowards(position, target, travel);
            Vector2 forward = difference.normalized;
            Vector2 tangent = new Vector2(-forward.y, forward.x) * (identity % 2 == 0 ? 0.24f : -0.24f);
            return position + (forward + tangent).normalized * travel;
        }
    }
}
